publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-22
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies how managers' gender attitudes shape workplace culture and gender inequality. Using data from a multinational firm operating in over 100 countries, we leverage crosscountry manager rotations to identify the effects of male managers' gender attitudes on gender pay gaps within a team. Managers from countries with one standard deviation more progressive gender attitudes reduce the pay gap by 5 percentage points (18%), largely through higher promotion rates for women. These effects persist after managers rotate out and are strongest in more conservative countries. Managers with progressive attitudes also influence the local office culture, as local managers who interact with but are not under the purview of the foreign manager begin to have smaller pay gaps in their teams. Our evidence points to individual managers as critical in shaping corporate culture.

AI.tldr: 研究男性管理者的性别态度如何影响团队内的性别薪酬差距，发现来自性别态度更进步国家的管理者能显著缩小薪酬差距，主要通过提高女性晋升率实现，且这些影响具有持续性
AI.research_question: 管理者的性别态度如何塑造职场文化和性别不平等？具体而言，男性管理者的性别态度如何影响团队内的性别薪酬差距？
AI.motivation: 尽管性别平等问题备受关注，但管理者个人态度在塑造职场文化和性别不平等方面的具体作用尚不清楚。理解管理者如何通过其态度影响组织内的性别差距对于制定有效政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织行为学和社会心理学理论，特别是管理者态度对团队文化的影响、社会规范传播理论，以及跨国文化差异对管理实践的影响。
AI.method: 利用一家在100多个国家运营的跨国公司的数据，采用跨国管理者轮换的自然实验设计，识别男性管理者性别态度对团队内性别薪酬差距的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 来自性别态度更进步国家（标准差高一个单位）的管理者能将性别薪酬差距缩小5个百分点（18%）；2. 主要通过提高女性晋升率实现；3. 影响在管理者轮换后仍然持续；4. 在更保守的国家效果最强；5. 进步态度管理者还能影响当地办公室文化，使与之互动但不受其管辖的当地管理者团队薪酬差距也缩小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次量化证明管理者个人态度对组织内性别不平等的因果影响；2. 揭示管理者态度通过社会规范传播影响组织文化的机制；3. 为管理者作为企业文化塑造者的理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调管理者选拔和培训对促进性别平等的重要性；2. 为跨国公司如何通过管理者轮换政策改善性别平等提供依据；3. 表明进步态度管理者能产生溢出效应，影响整个组织的文化。

title: Online Learning with Survival Data

detail.title: Online Learning with Survival Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Decision-makers frequently utilize adaptive experiments to optimize time-to-event outcomes, such as accelerating healthcare screenings or delaying customer churn. Traditional multi-armed bandit algorithms fail in these settings because they assume outcome delays are non-informative, leading practitioners to rely on dichotomization, a heuristic that collapses continuous timing into binary outcomes at a fixed threshold. We introduce "survival bandits," a principled class of algorithms that integrate the Cox proportional hazards model to utilize the full temporal signal of every event. We analytically contrast the regret of both approaches under a large-n limit with Weibull-distributed survival times satisfying the proportional hazards assumption. Our analytical results prove that dichotomization imposes substantial inefficiency, increasing regret by 41% to 54% even under optimal parameterization. We further demonstrate that survival bandits are uniquely robust to event rate uncertainty, whereas dichotomized approaches suffer significant performance degradation due to fragile threshold dependencies. Even when the proportional hazards assumption is violated, we show that survival bandits effectively identify the best arm under realistic scenarios. Simulations using real-world cervical cancer screening data validate our findings, demonstrating that survival bandits consistently reduce regret relative to the best-performing dichotomized algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生存老虎机"算法，将Cox比例风险模型整合到自适应实验中，利用完整的时间事件信号，相比传统的二分化方法显著降低遗憾
AI.research_question: 在优化时间到事件结果的自适应实验中，如何设计算法来有效利用完整的时间信号，避免传统二分化方法的信息损失和效率低下？
AI.motivation: 决策者经常使用自适应实验来优化时间到事件的结果（如加速医疗筛查或延迟客户流失），但传统的多臂老虎机算法假设结果延迟是非信息性的，导致实践者依赖二分化方法，这种方法将连续时间信息压缩为固定阈值下的二元结果，造成信息损失
AI.theoretical_framework: Cox比例风险模型，生存分析理论，多臂老虎机框架，比例风险假设，Weibull分布生存时间
AI.method: 1. 提出"生存老虎机"算法类，整合Cox比例风险模型；2. 在比例风险假设下，使用Weibull分布生存时间，在大样本极限下分析对比两种方法的遗憾；3. 通过模拟实验验证，使用真实世界宫颈癌筛查数据
AI.findings: 1. 二分化方法即使在最优参数化下也会增加41%-54%的遗憾；2. 生存老虎机对事件率不确定性具有独特鲁棒性，而二分化方法因脆弱的阈值依赖性而性能显著下降；3. 即使比例风险假设被违反，生存老虎机在现实场景下仍能有效识别最佳臂；4. 真实世界数据模拟验证生存老虎机始终优于最佳二分化算法
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将Cox比例风险模型系统整合到多臂老虎机框架中；2. 在理论上证明二分化方法的信息损失和效率低下；3. 建立了生存老虎机算法的理论分析框架；4. 为时间到事件结果的自适应实验提供了新的理论范式
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医疗筛查、客户流失管理等实际应用提供了更有效的算法工具；2. 帮助实践者避免二分化方法的阈值选择困境；3. 提高了时间到事件结果优化实验的效率；4. 提供了对算法鲁棒性的实证验证

title: The Calm Classroom Professional Standard: A Voluntary Canon for Handling Authority Under Pressure

detail.title: The Calm Classroom Professional Standard: A Voluntary Canon for Handling Authority Under Pressure
detail.abstract:
This paper presents the Calm Classroom Professional Standard as a voluntary professional canon for handling authority under pressure in educational settings. From the premise that the human nervous system is input alone—signals may be fast, loud, urgent, or intense, but none confer decisional authority—professionals use three reflexive questions to guide judgment:

  1. What is my next first step? (Nearest reversible action.)
  2. What do I get for free? (De-escalation, clarification, or cooling without commitment.)
  3. Where is the boundary, and how do I allow for duality? (Hold opposing behaviors briefly to prevent premature escalation.)

Delay is recognized as legitimate professional action when signals are loud and uncertainty present. Escalation transfers authority; calm preserves it. The standard introduces no curriculum, emotional instruction, diagnosis, or compliance mechanism. It operates prior to biology, psychology, or policy mandates.

An accompanying Model School Board Template provides optional, opt-in governance language: voluntary adoption, no new duties/liability, full opt-out, and explicit non-claims. The framework is non-teleological, non-prescriptive, and falsifiable structurally: demonstrate a pressure regime where the questions fail to preserve reversibility or authority without boundary commitment. Recognition is sufficient; agreement is optional.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"冷静课堂专业标准"，作为教育环境中处理压力下权威的自愿性专业准则。该标准基于神经系统仅接收输入信号的前提，提供三个反思性问题来指导专业判断，强调延迟作为合法专业行动，旨在保持权威而非转移权威。
AI.research_question: 教育专业人士如何在压力情境下保持权威并做出有效决策？
AI.motivation: 教育环境中专业人士面临压力时，需要有效的权威管理方法。当前方法可能过于依赖心理学、生物学或政策规定，而缺乏一个在压力情境下保持专业判断和权威的操作框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于神经系统输入理论：人类神经系统仅接收输入信号，信号可能快速、响亮、紧急或强烈，但不赋予决策权威。强调延迟作为合法专业行动的理论基础。
AI.method: 提出三个反思性问题的方法框架：1) 我的下一个第一步是什么？(最近的可逆行动)；2) 我能免费获得什么？(降级、澄清或冷却而不承诺)；3) 边界在哪里，如何允许二元性？(短暂保持对立行为以防止过早升级)。
AI.findings: 延迟在信号响亮和不确定性存在时是合法的专业行动。升级会转移权威，冷静能保持权威。该标准不引入课程、情感指导、诊断或合规机制，而是在生物学、心理学或政策要求之前运作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"冷静课堂专业标准"作为自愿性专业准则的理论框架，强调权威保持而非转移，为非目的论、非规定性、可证伪的结构提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了模型学校董事会模板，包含自愿采用、无新职责/责任、完全退出和明确非索赔的治理语言。为教育专业人士在压力情境下保持权威提供了具体操作指南。

title: A New More Intuitive IRT Model 1P—6P Based on Jonhson—SU Reparametrised

detail.title: A New More Intuitive IRT Model 1P—6P Based on Jonhson—SU Reparametrised
detail.abstract: IRT (Item Response Theory) models generally use "θ" as standard deviations of a normal distribution, whereas the parameter "b" is modelled by a logistic distribution. Yet "θ" and "b" are on the same scale. In this article we propose replacing the logistic models from 1PL to 5PL [1] with a reparametrised Jonhson-SU distribution so as to yield the same parameters customarily used {a, b, c, d, e}. We also present a 6P model that emerges naturally from the use of Jonhson-SU, with suitable adjustments so that the new formula affords the same manipulability of the parameters, which are renamed and adjusted so as to bear meanings equivalent to those they had in the traditional logistic models. The result is a more intuitive model, while preserving the other properties equivalent to those of the traditional models with logistic curves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用重参数化的Johnson-SU分布替代传统IRT模型中的逻辑斯蒂分布（从1PL到5PL），并自然衍生出6参数模型。新模型保持传统参数{a,b,c,d,e}的相同含义和可操作性，但提供更直观的建模方式。
AI.research_question: 能否用Johnson-SU分布替代传统IRT模型中的逻辑斯蒂分布，同时保持参数的相同含义和可操作性，并自然扩展出更灵活的6参数模型？
AI.motivation: 传统IRT模型中存在不一致性：θ参数使用正态分布的标准差，而b参数使用逻辑斯蒂分布，尽管两者在同一尺度上。这种不一致性促使研究者寻找更统一的分布框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目反应理论（IRT）、逻辑斯蒂分布、Johnson-SU分布、参数重参数化理论、统计建模框架。
AI.method: 提出用重参数化的Johnson-SU分布替代传统IRT模型中的逻辑斯蒂分布，从1PL到5PL模型进行系统替换。通过参数调整确保新公式保持传统参数{a,b,c,d,e}的相同含义和可操作性，并自然推导出6参数模型。
AI.findings: 成功开发出基于Johnson-SU分布的IRT模型系列，保持了传统参数的相同含义和可操作性，同时提供了更直观的模型。新模型自然衍生出6参数扩展，为IRT建模提供了更灵活的框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为IRT模型提供了统一的分布框架，解决了θ和b参数分布不一致的问题；2) 扩展了IRT模型的理论基础，引入Johnson-SU分布作为替代方案；3) 自然推导出6参数模型，丰富了IRT模型的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为实践者提供了更直观的IRT建模工具；2) 保持了与传统模型的兼容性，便于现有用户迁移；3) 6参数模型为复杂测量情境提供了更灵活的建模选项；4) 提高了模型解释的直观性。

detail.abstract:
India’s dental sector, which has undergone unprecedented expansion since independence, now stands at a critical inflection point marked by paradoxes of growth and structural fragility. From merely three dental colleges in 1947, the country today hosts 329 institutions offering 27,926 annual BDS seats―82 percent of which are concentrated in private colleges. This transformation reflects not only the commodification of dental education but also a broader systemic shift wherein private actors have increasingly assumed control over health-professional training. The passage of the National Dental Commission Act, 2023 was intended to modernise regulation, replace the Dentists Act, 1948, and dissolve the long-criticised Dental Council of India (DCI). Yet, the failure to constitute the National Dental Commission (NDC) has produced a regulatory vacuum, leaving the DCI functioning as an insecure caretaker body without statutory clarity in a rapidly evolving healthcare environment.


India now records 376,721 registered dentists against a 2025 population estimate of 1.46 billion―yielding a dentist-to-population ratio of 1:3,846, nearly double the WHO-recommended ratio of 1:7,500. This numerical surplus conceals major systemic distortions, including extreme urban clustering, rural under-service, rising unemployment among new graduates, and pronounced gender disparities. Private sector–driven expansion, combined with market saturation in metropolitan regions, has intensified professional precarity, diminished earning potential, and fuelled migration aspirations among young dentists. Projections suggest a surplus of over 100,000 dentists in the next decade unless workforce planning is urgently recalibrated. This paper examines the structural, regulatory, demographic, and socio-gendered dimensions shaping India’s dental sector and highlights the urgent need for a coherent national oral-health workforce policy.

AI.tldr: 印度牙科行业在独立后经历了前所未有的扩张，但面临增长悖论和结构性脆弱。私立机构主导教育扩张导致监管真空、城乡分布不均、毕业生失业率上升和性别差异等问题，急需国家口腔健康劳动力政策。
AI.research_question: 印度牙科行业的结构性、监管性、人口和社会性别维度如何塑造当前行业状况？如何解决牙科劳动力过剩与分布不均的矛盾？
AI.motivation: 印度牙科行业经历了从1947年3所牙科学院到2023年329所机构的快速扩张，但私立机构主导的教育商品化、监管真空（国家牙科委员会未成立）、城乡分布不均、毕业生失业等问题凸显了系统性危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗专业教育商品化理论、监管真空理论、劳动力市场失衡理论、城乡医疗资源分布理论、性别差异理论
AI.method: 基于文献分析和统计数据（牙科学院数量、注册牙医数量、人口比例等）的结构性分析，结合政策文件（国家牙科委员会法案）和行业趋势的定性研究
AI.findings: 1. 牙医与人口比例达1:3,846，远超WHO建议的1:7,500，但存在严重城乡分布不均；2. 私立机构占牙科教育82%，导致教育商品化；3. 监管真空导致DCI作为临时机构运作；4. 城市市场饱和导致毕业生失业和收入下降；5. 预计未来十年牙医过剩超10万人；6. 存在显著性别差异
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了医疗专业教育商品化在发展中国家背景下的具体表现；2. 分析了监管改革滞后与行业快速扩张的矛盾；3. 揭示了数字过剩掩盖下的结构性失衡问题；4. 拓展了医疗劳动力市场理论在牙科领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供制定国家口腔健康劳动力政策的依据；2. 揭示需要重新调整牙科教育规模和质量；3. 提出解决城乡分布不均的具体方向；4. 为牙科毕业生职业规划提供参考；5. 推动监管机构改革和完善

title: Head-Start Paradox in Long-Term Goal Pursuit: How Milestone-Based Reference Points Shape Persistence After Setbacks
affiliations: , University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) and University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)

detail.title: Head-Start Paradox in Long-Term Goal Pursuit: How Milestone-Based Reference Points Shape Persistence After Setbacks
detail.abstract:
Many consequential life goals, such as weight management and health behavior change, require sustained self-regulation over extended periods and involve recurrent setbacks rather than discrete completion points. Although prior research has examined goal progress and short-term motivation, less is known about how accumulated experience during goal pursuit shapes subsequent decisions following setbacks. In particular, prior effort and prior achievement are often treated as interchangeable signals of progress, despite their potentially distinct psychological implications.

This research examines how prior effort and achievement differentially shape decision-making in long-term goal pursuit. Using longitudinal self-monitoring data from 12,439 users of a weight-management application (Boohee), supplemented by a laboratory experiment, we conceptualize goal pursuit as a cyclical self-regulation process organized around a personalized milestone—each participant’s lightest recorded weight. Rather than representing a predefined endpoint, this milestone constitutes a psychologically salient turning point that prompts retrospective self-appraisal. We distinguish two forms of pre-milestone experience: persistence duration (time invested) and achievement magnitude (weight loss attained).

Results reveal a systematic dissociation between effort-based and achievement-based experiences. Greater pre-milestone persistence predicts stronger post-milestone behavioral persistence following setbacks, driven by lower performance-related stress and greater goal commitment. In contrast, greater pre-milestone achievement predicts higher tolerance for post-milestone weight regain (i.e., greater outcome endurance), mediated by increased perceived controllability. These findings indicate that accumulated effort and accumulated achievement operate as distinct decision reference points that shape how individuals interpret setbacks and regulate subsequent behavior.

Together, this research demonstrates that milestone-based self-appraisal generates feedback loops through which prior experiences differentially influence motivation, emotional responses, and endurance in later stages of goal pursuit. By integrating a temporal perspective with self-regulation and mindset theories, this work advances understanding of dynamic persistence in self-directed, real-world goal pursuit and clarifies why early success does not reliably translate into long-term maintenance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨在长期目标追求中，先前的努力和成就如何差异化影响挫折后的决策。研究发现，更大的里程碑前坚持度（时间投入）预测更强的挫折后行为坚持，而更大的里程碑前成就（减重幅度）预测更高的体重反弹容忍度。努力和成就作为不同的决策参考点，通过不同心理机制影响后续行为。
AI.research_question: 在长期目标追求中，先前的努力和成就如何差异化影响挫折后的决策制定？
AI.motivation: 许多重要生活目标（如体重管理和健康行为改变）需要长期自我调节，涉及反复挫折而非离散完成点。先前研究关注目标进展和短期动机，但对挫折后决策如何受累积经验影响知之甚少。努力和成就常被视为可互换的进展信号，但可能具有不同的心理含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我调节理论、心态理论、时间视角、里程碑理论、决策参考点理论
AI.method: 使用12,439名体重管理应用（薄荷）用户的纵向自我监测数据，辅以实验室实验。将目标追求概念化为围绕个性化里程碑（最轻记录体重）的循环自我调节过程。区分两种里程碑前经验：坚持时长（时间投入）和成就幅度（减重幅度）。
AI.findings:
1. 更大的里程碑前坚持度预测更强的里程碑后行为坚持（挫折后），由更低的绩效相关压力和更高的目标承诺驱动。
2. 更大的里程碑前成就预测更高的里程碑后体重反弹容忍度，由增加的感知可控性中介。
3. 累积努力和累积成就作为不同的决策参考点，塑造个体如何解释挫折和调节后续行为。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 整合时间视角与自我调节和心态理论，推进对自我导向、现实世界目标追求中动态坚持的理解。
2. 阐明为什么早期成功不能可靠转化为长期维持。
3. 里程碑式自我评估产生反馈循环，先前经验差异化影响后续阶段的动机、情绪反应和耐力。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为设计更有效的行为干预提供见解，区分努力和成就的不同影响。
2. 帮助理解为什么某些人在挫折后能坚持，而其他人则放弃。
3. 为体重管理和健康行为改变项目提供实践指导，强调坚持和成就的不同作用机制。

title: Machine Learning Models for Climate-Resilient Industrial Risk Management

detail.title: Machine Learning Models for Climate-Resilient Industrial Risk Management
detail.abstract: Industrial systems are increasingly vulnerable to climate-related risks, including extreme weather events, supply chain disruptions, and operational failures (Singh & Goyal, 2023). This study investigates the application of machine learning (ML) models to predict and mitigate such climate-induced industrial risks, aiming to enhance operational resilience and support climate-adaptive decision-making (Zulqarnain & Sarker, 2023). Predictive ML models were developed using historical industrial risk datasets, environmental impact metrics, and real-time monitoring data (Ferrara et al., 2024). The models were evaluated on their ability to accurately forecast risk events, identify critical vulnerabilities, and suggest mitigation strategies. Results indicate that ML-based approaches substantially improve risk assessment accuracy, enabling proactive management of industrial operations under climate stressors (Roy, 2024). Moreover, the models facilitate evidence-based decision-making, allowing organizations to prioritize interventions, optimize resource allocation, and strengthen climate resilience strategies. These findings underscore the transformative potential of integrating ML into industrial risk management frameworks. The study concludes that widespread adoption of predictive ML models can not only enhance operational resilience but also inform policy development and regulatory frameworks aimed at mitigating climate risks in industrial sectors (Agbehadji et al., 2023). Overall, this research highlights the critical role of AI-driven predictive tools in preparing industries for the evolving challenges posed by climate variability and extreme events.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨机器学习模型在预测和缓解气候相关工业风险中的应用，结果表明ML方法能显著提高风险评估准确性，支持主动管理和基于证据的决策制定。
AI.research_question: 机器学习模型如何应用于预测和缓解气候相关的工业风险，以增强运营韧性和支持气候适应性决策？
AI.motivation: 工业系统日益面临气候相关风险的威胁，包括极端天气事件、供应链中断和运营故障，需要有效的预测和缓解方法来增强工业韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习理论、风险评估理论和气候适应性决策理论，结合工业风险管理和运营韧性框架。
AI.method: 使用历史工业风险数据集、环境影响指标和实时监测数据开发预测性机器学习模型，评估模型在风险事件预测、关键漏洞识别和缓解策略建议方面的能力。
AI.findings: ML方法显著提高了风险评估准确性，能够主动管理气候压力下的工业运营，促进基于证据的决策制定，帮助组织优先干预、优化资源分配和加强气候韧性策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了机器学习在工业风险管理中的应用理论，为气候适应性决策制定提供了理论框架，丰富了运营韧性和气候风险管理的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的ML预测工具，支持工业组织增强运营韧性，为政策制定和监管框架提供依据，帮助工业部门应对气候变化的挑战。

title: Marketing Strategy for Products and Services in The Digital Era

detail.title: Marketing Strategy for Products and Services in The Digital Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or personal data. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines effective marketing strategies for products and services in the digital era, where rapid technological development has significantly transformed consumer behavior and business competition. The growth of digital platforms such as social media, e-commerce, and data-driven technologies has shifted marketing activities from conventional approaches to more interactive, measurable, and customer-oriented strategies. This study aims to analyze adaptive digital marketing strategies and identify key factors influencing the success of digital marketing on consumer behavior. Using a descriptive qualitative approach based on literature review, this paper discusses the role of digital marketing, consumer behavior, social media, and content strategy in shaping purchasing decisions. The findings indicate that effective digital marketing strategies rely on the selection of appropriate digital platforms, the creation of relevant and engaging content, active consumer engagement, personalization, and positive user experience. Additionally, technological trends, data analysis, and brand reputation play a crucial role in enhancing competitiveness and consumer loyalty. This paper is expected to contribute both theoretically to the development of digital marketing studies and practically as a reference for business actors, particularly micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), in designing sustainable and effective digital marketing strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字时代有效的营销策略，分析数字营销如何适应技术发展和消费者行为变化，识别影响数字营销成功的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 数字时代下，哪些有效的营销策略能够适应技术发展和消费者行为变化？影响数字营销成功的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 快速的技术发展显著改变了消费者行为和商业竞争，数字平台（社交媒体、电子商务、数据驱动技术）的增长使营销活动从传统方法转向更互动、可衡量和以客户为中心的策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字营销理论、消费者行为理论、社交媒体营销理论、内容策略理论
AI.method: 采用基于文献综述的描述性定性方法
AI.findings: 有效的数字营销策略依赖于：1）选择合适的数字平台；2）创造相关且引人入胜的内容；3）积极的消费者参与；4）个性化；5）积极的用户体验。此外，技术趋势、数据分析和品牌声誉在提升竞争力和消费者忠诚度方面发挥关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字营销研究的发展做出理论贡献，丰富了数字营销策略与消费者行为关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商业参与者，特别是微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs），在设计可持续和有效的数字营销策略时提供实践参考。

title: Content Marketing Strategy on Social Media of Mayoutfit Fashion Brand

detail.title: Content Marketing Strategy on Social Media of Mayoutfit Fashion Brand
detail.abstract: Digitalization has driven a change in marketing strategies by utilizing social media and content marketing in the fashion industry. This study will analyze the content marketing strategies used by Mayoutfit, a local fashion brand, in increasing consumer buying interest, and identify the factors that support and hinder it. The author uses qualitative descriptive methods, literature studies and also observations on Mayoutfit's social media activities. Mayoutfit, in this study, was active in the use of social content utilizing visual content, influencer marketing, promotional campaigns, and direct shopping features to stimulate consumer engagement and facilitate purchasing decisions. Mayoutfit, however, looks to have challenges in its digital marketing content strategy due to the high competition as a local fashion brand, the limited resources available to the company, and the ever-changing social media marketing strategy. From the overall content marketing approach implemented by Mayoutfit, a positive increase in buying interest is evident and brand equity has been built.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了本地时尚品牌Mayoutfit在数字化时代如何通过社交媒体内容营销策略提升消费者购买兴趣，识别了其成功因素与面临的挑战。
AI.research_question: Mayoutfit作为本地时尚品牌，采用了哪些内容营销策略来提升消费者购买兴趣？哪些因素支持或阻碍了这些策略的效果？
AI.motivation: 数字化推动了时尚行业营销策略的变革，社交媒体和内容营销成为重要手段。本地时尚品牌在激烈竞争中需要有效的内容营销策略来提升消费者购买兴趣。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内容营销理论、社交媒体营销理论、消费者购买决策理论、品牌资产理论
AI.method: 定性描述方法，包括文献研究和观察Mayoutfit的社交媒体活动
AI.findings: Mayoutfit采用了视觉内容、影响者营销、促销活动和直接购物功能等策略来刺激消费者参与和促进购买决策。虽然面临激烈竞争、资源有限和社交媒体策略快速变化等挑战，但其内容营销方法确实带来了购买兴趣的积极提升和品牌资产的建立。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了本地时尚品牌在数字化环境下的内容营销理论，提供了社交媒体内容营销策略与消费者购买兴趣关系的实证证据，扩展了品牌资产理论在社交媒体环境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为本地时尚品牌提供了可操作的内容营销策略框架，帮助管理者识别有效的社交媒体营销方法，提供了应对资源限制和激烈竞争的实际建议，展示了如何通过内容营销建立品牌资产。

title: The Calm Classroom: Staffing Brief No. 2 — Speed Is a Warning Sign

detail.title: The Calm Classroom: Staffing Brief No. 2 — Speed Is a Warning Sign

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, funding sources, or conflicts of interest related to this work.

detail.abstract:
This brief names a common classroom pattern: fast signals (urgency, intensity, rapid escalation) feel compelling and important, yet speed itself is unreliable as a decision-maker. Speed is a warning sign—information about change, not instruction to act immediately.

The core boundary: Speed ≠ Importance. Fast systems narrow options and reduce deliberation; in non-emergency moments, mistaking speed for authority turns small signals into large conflicts. Treating speed as data rather than command allows adults to pause, defer, and use fewer words without apology.

When this boundary holds:

  • Escalation slows before compounding.
  • Decisions are deferred legitimately.
  • Delay becomes a professional move, not passivity.
  • Calm is permitted to appear quiet.

Optional responses include simple phrases: “We’re moving too fast. Let’s slow this down,” “We can decide later,” or “Nothing needs to happen right now.” Silence and waiting are also valid actions.

This is not a rule, behavior plan, or demand for constant calm. It is recognition of a structural pattern for routing authority under pressure. Signals remain welcome; authority remains separate.

The Calm Classroom series applies a physiological/structural lens to educational settings, focusing on boundaries, signal handling, urgency vs. decision-making, and institutional capacity for calm under uncertainty. Second in the series.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出课堂中常见的"快速信号"模式：紧急感、强度和快速升级虽然感觉重要，但速度本身并不可靠。核心观点是速度不等于重要性，应将速度视为数据而非指令，从而允许教师暂停、延迟决策，减少不必要的冲突。
AI.research_question: 在课堂环境中，如何区分快速信号（紧急感、强度、快速升级）与决策重要性？如何建立有效的边界来处理速度与权威之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 课堂中常见的模式是快速信号（如紧急感、强度、快速升级）感觉很重要，但速度本身并不可靠作为决策依据。教师经常误将速度等同于重要性，导致不必要的冲突升级和决策质量下降。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 信号处理理论：区分信号（数据）与指令（命令）
2. 决策理论：在压力下保持冷静决策的能力
3. 边界理论：建立速度与重要性之间的概念边界
4. 生理/结构视角：从生理和结构角度理解教育环境中的压力反应
AI.method: 概念分析框架，通过识别课堂中的结构性模式，提出理论边界和实用策略。属于"冷静课堂"系列的第二篇，采用生理/结构视角分析教育环境。
AI.findings:
1. 速度是变化的警告信号，而非立即行动的指令
2. 速度≠重要性：快速系统会限制选择并减少深思熟虑
3. 将速度视为数据而非命令，允许教师暂停、延迟决策
4. 延迟可以成为专业行为而非被动
5. 冷静可以表现为安静，无需道歉
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了"速度≠重要性"的理论边界
2. 提出了信号处理与权威分离的概念框架
3. 发展了在压力下保持冷静决策的结构性模式
4. 为教育环境中的压力管理提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供具体应对策略："我们进展太快了，让我们慢下来"、"我们可以稍后决定"、"现在不需要立即行动"
2. 验证沉默和等待作为有效行动
3. 帮助教师区分紧急情况与非紧急情况下的决策
4. 减少不必要的冲突升级
5. 提升教师在压力下的专业决策能力

title: Scapegoat-as-a-Service: Moving from "Human-in-the-Loop" to "Human-in-Command" in Regulated Systems

detail.title: Scapegoat-as-a-Service: Moving from "Human-in-the-Loop" to "Human-in-Command" in Regulated Systems
detail.abstract: Human-in-the-Loop is widely treated as the default safety control for AI in regulated workflows, but in production it can become liability transfer: reviewers must approve high-volume probabilistic outputs they cannot independently verify at operational speed. We name this failure mode Scapegoat-as-a-Service and propose Human-in-Command governance, where humans define and enforce an operating envelope for AI-enabled actions. Minimum Viable HIC requires four pre-execution artifacts: Intent, Inputs (provenance), Constraints (machine-checkable policy), and an Action Preview (deterministic payload)—so that control lives in the integration layer rather than in after-the-fact approvals.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"Human-in-Command"治理框架，以解决传统"Human-in-the-Loop"在实际生产中沦为责任转移工具的问题，要求人类在AI执行前定义可验证的操作边界。
AI.research_question: 如何设计有效的AI治理框架，使人类能够真正控制AI系统，避免传统Human-in-the-Loop模式在实际生产中沦为责任转移工具？
AI.motivation: 当前Human-in-the-Loop模式在监管工作流中被广泛采用，但在实际生产中，由于AI输出量大、概率性且操作速度快，审核者无法独立验证，导致该模式实际上变成了责任转移机制，作者称之为"替罪羊即服务"。
AI.theoretical_framework: Human-in-Command治理框架，强调人类定义和执行AI操作边界，而非事后审批。该框架基于四个执行前要素：意图、输入来源、机器可检查的约束条件、确定性行动预览。
AI.method: 概念性框架开发，通过识别现有Human-in-the-Loop模式的缺陷，提出新的治理架构，强调控制应存在于集成层而非事后审批。
AI.findings: 传统Human-in-the-Loop模式在实际应用中存在系统性缺陷，无法提供真正的安全控制；Human-in-Command框架通过四个执行前要素确保人类对AI系统的实质性控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"Scapegoat-as-a-Service"概念来描述传统Human-in-the-Loop模式的失败机制；发展了Human-in-Command治理理论，强调事前控制而非事后审批。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了Minimum Viable HIC的具体实施指南，包括四个执行前要素的定义和实施方法，帮助组织在实际生产中建立有效的AI治理机制。

title: Backward Target Analysis: AI as a Diagnostic Lens for Inconsistency in Decision Architectures

detail.title: Backward Target Analysis: AI as a Diagnostic Lens for Inconsistency in Decision Architectures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental subjects and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Inconsistent decisions are commonly interpreted as indicators of individual judgment errors or deficiencies in algorithmic performance. This paper proposes an alternative perspective in which decision inconsistency is treated as a diagnostic signal of structural ambiguity within decision architectures. Rather than attributing variance to human bias or model shortcomings, the analysis focuses on the configuration of meanings, constraints, and procedural boundaries that shape decisions.

To operationalize this perspective, the paper introduces Backward Target Analysis (BTA), a diagnostic framework that examines patterns of outcome dispersion across repeated decision instances. BTA is based on a formal separation between meaning spaces, in which goals, interpretations, and normative frames are articulated, and decision spaces, in which executable constraints, rules, and procedures are defined. Inconsistency arises when these spaces are insufficiently aligned or stabilized.

Artificial intelligence systems, particularly large language models, are employed not as decision-makers but as diagnostic instruments. Their reproducible outputs function as measurement signals that make latent ambiguity and instability in decision architectures observable. The applicability of BTA is not limited to AI-driven decisions but extends to human and hybrid decision systems, with AI primarily serving as an amplifier of diagnostic visibility.

BTA is introduced as a diagnostic and analytical method rather than a predictive, prescriptive, or optimization approach. It does not assess the correctness, fairness, or desirability of individual decisions. Instead, it supports organizational reflection, governance, and decision hygiene by providing structured insights into decision consistency and clarity. The paper contributes a conceptual and methodological bridge between decision science, organizational theory, and AI governance, explicitly acknowledging its methodological scope and regulatory limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新视角：决策不一致性不是个体判断错误或算法缺陷，而是决策架构中结构性模糊的信号。作者开发了反向目标分析（BTA）诊断框架，利用AI作为诊断工具来识别决策架构中的潜在模糊性。
AI.research_question: 决策不一致性如何反映决策架构中的结构性模糊，以及如何系统性地诊断这种模糊性？
AI.motivation: 传统上决策不一致性被视为个体错误或算法缺陷，但作者认为这忽略了决策架构本身的结构性问题。需要一种新视角和诊断方法来识别决策架构中的模糊性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于决策架构理论，区分意义空间（目标、解释、规范框架）和决策空间（可执行约束、规则、程序）。不一致性源于这两个空间的对齐不足或不稳定。
AI.method: 反向目标分析（BTA）诊断框架，利用大型语言模型等AI系统作为诊断工具而非决策者，通过可重复输出作为测量信号来观察决策架构中的潜在模糊性。
AI.findings: BTA能够系统性地识别决策架构中的结构性模糊，这种模糊性表现为决策不一致性。AI作为诊断工具可以放大这种诊断可见性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出决策不一致性作为结构性模糊信号的新理论视角；2）开发BTA诊断框架；3）在决策科学、组织理论和AI治理之间建立概念和方法桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为组织提供决策一致性和清晰度的结构化洞察；2）支持组织反思、治理和决策卫生；3）适用于人类、AI和混合决策系统。

title: GIS-Based Supply Chain Optimization for Environmentally Conscious Manufacturing

detail.title: GIS-Based Supply Chain Optimization for Environmentally Conscious Manufacturing
detail.abstract: Manufacturing supply chains are increasingly pressured by environmental regulations, resource scarcity, and spatial inefficiencies that complicate sustainable production planning and logistics coordination (Porter; Sarkis). Existing optimization approaches often overlook spatial-environmental interactions, limiting firms' ability to align operational efficiency with sustainability objectives across geographically dispersed facilities (Christopher; Seuring). This study integrates Geographic Information Systems (GIS) with environmental indicators and operational datasets to model, visualize, and optimize manufacturing supply chain configurations (Longley; Zhu). Spatial data layers, including transportation networks, emission hotspots, resource availability, and facility locations, were analytically combined to support scenario-based decision-making (Goodchild; Miller). The findings demonstrate that GIS-based optimization significantly improves resource allocation accuracy, reduces environmental risk exposure, and strengthens strategic planning across supply chain nodes (Batty; Kannan; Wang). Results further indicate that spatially informed decisions enhance responsiveness to regulatory constraints while minimizing waste, energy consumption, and logistics-related emissions (Hervani; Fahimnia). By enabling real-time spatial analysis and evidence-driven trade-off evaluation, GIS enhances managerial insight and operational transparency in complex manufacturing networks (Tomlinson; Sheffi). Overall, the study concludes that GIS provides a scalable, adaptable, and evidence-based framework for designing environmentally conscious manufacturing supply chains that balance economic performance with sustainability goals (United Nations; Porter).

AI.tldr: 本研究整合地理信息系统(GIS)、环境指标与运营数据，建立制造供应链空间优化模型，通过空间数据层分析显著提升资源配置准确性、降低环境风险，并增强供应链节点间的战略规划协调能力。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合地理信息系统(GIS)与环境指标来优化制造供应链配置，以同时实现运营效率与可持续发展目标？
AI.motivation: 制造供应链面临环境法规、资源稀缺和空间效率低下的多重压力，现有优化方法往往忽视空间-环境交互作用，限制了企业在分散地理设施中协调运营效率与可持续发展目标的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于供应链管理理论、可持续发展理论、空间分析理论，整合Porter的竞争优势理论、Sarkis的环境供应链管理、Christopher的供应链协调理论以及Seuring的可持续供应链框架。
AI.method: 整合地理信息系统(GIS)与环境指标及运营数据集，建立空间数据层分析模型，包括运输网络、排放热点、资源可用性和设施位置等数据层，支持基于场景的决策制定。
AI.findings: GIS优化显著提高资源配置准确性、降低环境风险暴露、增强供应链节点战略规划；空间知情决策提升对法规约束的响应能力，同时减少废物、能耗和物流相关排放；实时空间分析和证据驱动权衡评估增强管理洞察力和运营透明度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出整合空间分析与可持续供应链管理的新理论框架，扩展了传统供应链优化模型，为空间-环境交互研究提供理论基础，丰富了可持续发展与运营管理交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可扩展、适应性强的证据驱动框架，帮助企业设计环境友好型制造供应链，平衡经济绩效与可持续发展目标，增强对法规变化的响应能力，降低运营风险，提高资源配置效率。

title: Circular Economy Integration in Manufacturing Using Predictive Analytics

detail.title: Circular Economy Integration in Manufacturing Using Predictive Analytics
detail.abstract: Manufacturing industries face increasing environmental pressures, including inefficiencies in resource utilization and rising waste generation, which challenge sustainable production practices (Lin and Wei, 2023). The adoption of circular economy principles has been recognized as a critical strategy to enhance resource efficiency and minimize environmental impacts. This study explores the integration of predictive analytics tools, including machine learning and artificial intelligence, within manufacturing processes to support circular economy objectives (Mamudu et al., 2024). By leveraging real-time data and predictive modeling, the approach enables proactive decision-making for resource allocation, process optimization, and waste reduction. The results demonstrate that predictive analytics significantly improves material and energy efficiency, reduces production waste, and facilitates sustainable manufacturing outcomes (Ghaithan et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024). Furthermore, the framework offers scalability across diverse industrial contexts, providing actionable insights for continuous improvement and circularity adoption. These findings suggest that predictive analytics serves as a robust, evidence-based tool for embedding circular economy practices in industrial operations. The study contributes to both theoretical understanding and practical implementation strategies, highlighting the potential of data-driven approaches to advance sustainable manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了预测分析工具（机器学习和人工智能）在制造业中支持循环经济目标的整合应用，通过实时数据和预测建模实现资源分配、流程优化和废物减少的主动决策。
AI.research_question: 预测分析工具（包括机器学习和人工智能）如何整合到制造过程中以支持循环经济目标，并提高资源效率和减少环境影响？
AI.motivation: 制造业面临日益增加的环境压力，包括资源利用效率低下和废物产生增加，这挑战了可持续生产实践。采用循环经济原则被认为是提高资源效率和减少环境影响的关键策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济原则、预测分析理论、可持续制造理论、资源效率理论
AI.method: 整合预测分析工具（机器学习和人工智能），利用实时数据和预测建模方法，支持循环经济目标的实现
AI.findings: 预测分析显著提高了材料和能源效率，减少了生产废物，促进了可持续制造结果。该框架在不同工业环境中具有可扩展性，为持续改进和循环经济采用提供了可操作的见解。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对预测分析在循环经济中作用的理论理解，为数据驱动方法在可持续制造中的应用提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业运营中嵌入循环经济实践提供了基于证据的实用工具，提供了可扩展的实施策略和可操作的见解，支持资源分配、流程优化和废物减少的决策

title: GIS-based Hazard Communication Tools for Community Engagement

detail.title: GIS-based Hazard Communication Tools for Community Engagement
detail.abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of Geographic Information System (GIS)-based hazard communication tools in engaging communities during disasters. As disasters continue to pose significant risks to lives and infrastructure, effective communication and community preparedness are critical components of disaster management. This research employs a mixed-methods approach, including a systematic review of relevant case studies, deployment of GIS tools in selected community settings, and analysis of community feedback on usability, accessibility, and perceived effectiveness. Findings indicate that GIS-based tools significantly enhance public awareness of hazards, improve emergency preparedness, and facilitate more coordinated responses during disaster events. Communities using interactive maps and location-based alerts demonstrated higher levels of engagement, better understanding of local risks, and faster decision-making in simulated emergency scenarios. However, the study identifies several challenges that limit the full potential of these tools. Data accuracy and timeliness, technological accessibility, and variations in digital literacy among community members emerged as critical barriers. These challenges underscore the need for continuous updates to hazard datasets, the inclusive design of user interfaces, and targeted digital literacy initiatives to ensure equitable access to GIS resources. The study concludes that GIS-based hazard communication tools offer significant benefits in fostering community engagement and resilience during disasters. Their effectiveness, however, is contingent on sustained training for both emergency responders and community members, ongoing validation of data sources, and the adoption of inclusive strategies that address technological and educational disparities. By integrating these considerations, GIS tools can serve as a powerful mechanism for enhancing disaster preparedness, supporting informed decision-making, and strengthening overall community resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了基于GIS的灾害沟通工具在灾害期间吸引社区参与的有效性。研究发现GIS工具能显著提高公众意识、改善应急准备并促进协调响应，但面临数据准确性、技术可及性和数字素养差异等挑战。
AI.research_question: 基于地理信息系统(GIS)的灾害沟通工具在灾害期间吸引社区参与的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 灾害持续对生命和基础设施构成重大风险，有效的沟通和社区准备是灾害管理的关键组成部分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害管理理论、社区参与理论、技术采纳理论、数字鸿沟理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：包括相关案例研究的系统回顾、在选定社区环境中部署GIS工具、分析社区对可用性、可及性和感知有效性的反馈
AI.findings:
1. GIS工具显著提高公众对灾害的认识、改善应急准备并促进灾害事件期间的协调响应
2. 使用交互式地图和基于位置警报的社区表现出更高的参与度、更好的本地风险理解和更快的决策制定
3. 数据准确性及时性、技术可及性和社区成员数字素养差异是关键障碍
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了灾害管理中技术工具有效性的理论框架
2. 揭示了数字鸿沟在灾害沟通中的具体表现和影响机制
3. 为社区参与理论提供了技术中介视角的实证支持
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为应急管理人员提供GIS工具部署的具体指导
2. 强调需要持续更新灾害数据集、设计包容性用户界面和实施针对性数字素养计划
3. 提出确保GIS资源公平获取的策略，包括持续培训、数据源验证和包容性策略采纳

title: Score-Driven Long Memory Dynamics of Worldwide Regional Temperature Anomalies
affiliations: Mercer University, Mercer University and University of Navarra - Department of Economics

detail.title: Score-Driven Long Memory Dynamics of Worldwide Regional Temperature Anomalies
detail.abstract: We develop a score-driven fractionally integrated quasi-autoregressive model with Student's t innovations (t-FI-QAR), in which the degree of fractional integration d t , the conditional mean, and the conditional scale evolve via likelihood-based updates. Using monthly U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) land-and-ocean temperature anomalies for six regions (Arctic, Antarctic, Atlantic Ocean, Northeast Pacific Ocean, Northern and Southern Hemispheres) from January 1850 to October 2025, we show that d t rises over time across all regions, implying increasingly persistent temperature dynamics. The increase is strongest in the Arctic and Northern Hemisphere, where we detect a structural shift over the past three decades consistent with a move toward non-stationary behavior. Significant but more moderate increases occur in the Atlantic, Northeast Pacific, and Southern Hemisphere, while the Antarctic exhibits a slight upward trend. Models that allow heavy tails and time-varying scale outperform homoscedastic specifications in likelihood-based criteria and diagnostics. The findings indicate that climate shocks now propagate more durably than in earlier periods, suggesting that stronger and more sustained mitigation and adaptation policies are needed to counter long-lived deviations in regional temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了t-FI-QAR模型，分析全球六个区域1850-2025年月度温度异常数据，发现所有区域的分数整合度d_t随时间上升，表明温度动态的持续性增强，特别是在北极和北半球。气候冲击的传播变得更加持久，需要更强有力的缓解和适应政策。
AI.research_question: 全球不同区域温度异常的持续性（分数整合度）如何随时间变化？气候冲击的传播特性是否发生了变化？
AI.motivation: 理解气候变化的持续性特征对于制定有效的缓解和适应政策至关重要。传统的时间序列模型可能无法充分捕捉温度动态的长期记忆和时变特性，需要开发更灵活的计量经济学模型来分析气候数据的非平稳行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数整合时间序列理论、准自回归模型、得分驱动模型、学生t分布创新项、时变参数建模
AI.method: 开发了t-FI-QAR模型（学生t创新的分数整合准自回归模型），其中分数整合度d_t、条件均值和条件尺度通过基于似然的更新演化。使用NOAA 1850-2025年月度温度异常数据，分析六个区域（北极、南极、大西洋、东北太平洋、北半球、南半球）。
AI.findings: 1. 所有区域的d_t随时间上升，表明温度动态的持续性增强；2. 北极和北半球增长最显著，过去三十年出现结构性转变，趋向非平稳行为；3. 大西洋、东北太平洋和南半球有显著但较温和的增长；4. 南极有轻微上升趋势；5. 允许厚尾和时变尺度的模型在似然准则和诊断中优于同方差设定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了t-FI-QAR模型，将分数整合度、均值和尺度参数都设为时变；2. 扩展了气候经济计量学方法，更好地捕捉温度动态的长期记忆和时变特性；3. 为分析非平稳气候数据提供了新的建模框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 发现气候冲击的传播变得更加持久，需要更强有力的缓解和适应政策；2. 区域差异分析为针对性气候政策提供依据；3. 模型选择建议：考虑厚尾和时变方差能更好地拟合气候数据；4. 为气候风险评估和长期规划提供实证基础。

title: Lost in Aggregation: Behind the Facade of Eurozone Business Cycle Comovement
affiliations: University of Piraeus - Department of Economics and Lazarski University

detail.title: Lost in Aggregation: Behind the Facade of Eurozone Business Cycle Comovement

declarations.funderStatement: This article was prepared within the research project “Bayesian simultaneous equations model averaging - theoretical development and R package,” funded by the Polish National Science Centre, on the basis of the decision No. DEC-2021/43/B/HS4/01745.

detail.abstract: Using data from 51 NUTS 1 regions and six sectors across nine Eurozone countries over 1980-2019, we employ a Bayesian dynamic latent factor model to examine business cycle (BC) synchronization in the Eurozone at a disaggregated regional, sectoral, and national level. We identify four types of factors-Eurozone-wide, country, sectoral, and regionaland focus on the impact of the introduction of the euro. Our results show that, prior to the euro, regional factors were the main drivers of BC fluctuations, whereas after the euro's introduction, sectoral factors became more prominent, indicating increased synchronization driven by horizontal integration. We then estimate a structural VAR model to uncover the sources of these factors. The findings reveal that, post-euro, monetary policy shocks have become the dominant source of BC synchronization in the Eurozone, while sectoral transmission has shifted toward external price and demand channels, especially in tradable sectors. Nevertheless, persistent fiscal and real-side heterogeneity across member states continues to shape asymmetric adjustment. These results highlight the growing role of common monetary and sectoral forces but also underscore the need for policies that address intra-national disparities in future integration efforts.

AI.tldr: 使用1980-2019年欧元区9个国家、51个NUTS 1区域和6个部门的数据，通过贝叶斯动态潜在因子模型分析欧元区商业周期同步性。研究发现欧元引入后，部门因素取代区域因素成为主要驱动力量，表明水平整合增强。结构VAR模型显示，欧元引入后货币政策冲击成为商业周期同步的主要来源，部门传导转向外部价格和需求渠道，但成员国间财政和实际面的异质性持续存在。
AI.research_question: 欧元引入如何影响欧元区商业周期同步性？在区域、部门和国家级层面，商业周期波动的驱动因素发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 理解欧元区经济一体化的实际效果，特别是共同货币对商业周期同步性的影响，对于评估货币联盟的稳定性和制定相关政策至关重要。现有研究多关注国家层面，缺乏对区域和部门层面的细致分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业周期同步理论、最优货币区理论、经济一体化理论、因子模型理论（贝叶斯动态潜在因子模型）、结构向量自回归模型
AI.method: 使用1980-2019年欧元区9个国家、51个NUTS 1区域和6个部门的面板数据，采用贝叶斯动态潜在因子模型识别四种因子：欧元区层面、国家层面、部门层面和区域层面。随后使用结构VAR模型分析这些因子的来源。
AI.findings: 1. 欧元引入前，区域因素是商业周期波动的主要驱动因素；欧元引入后，部门因素变得更加重要，表明水平整合增强。2. 欧元引入后，货币政策冲击成为商业周期同步的主要来源。3. 部门传导机制转向外部价格和需求渠道，特别是在可贸易部门。4. 成员国间财政和实际面的异质性持续存在，导致不对称调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了欧元区商业周期同步性的多层次分析框架（区域、部门、国家）。2. 揭示了共同货币对商业周期驱动因素结构变化的影响。3. 识别了货币政策在促进商业周期同步中的主导作用。4. 强调了部门传导渠道的变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧元区政策制定者提供了关于经济一体化实际效果的证据。2. 强调了需要关注成员国间财政和实际面的异质性。3. 建议未来一体化政策应关注国内区域间的不平衡问题。4. 为评估货币联盟的稳定性和调整机制提供了实证依据。

title: The Tradeoff Theory as a Method of Choosing Capital Structure: Effects of Debt and Tax on the Firm Value

detail.title: The Tradeoff Theory as a Method of Choosing Capital Structure: Effects of Debt and Tax on the Firm Value
detail.abstract: We analyze the trade-off theory and its underpinnings. All those papers commit the same error: While analyzing the influence of debt and tax on the firm value, they do not consider debt redemption. This approach turns the firm into a generator of arbitrage profits, making void all results achieved in the papers. Using the Extended Merton model, which takes account of debt, its redemption, tax, and the tax shield, we compute the asset distributions for an all-equity firm and the identical levered firm. Contrary to the general belief that a medium-size debt is beneficial for the firm, characteristics of the levered firm are inferior to the same characteristics of the unlevered firm. The anticipated gains from tax deductions are the phantoms created by errors in the papers. Our analysis of debt and tax on the firm value can be helpful for managers as a method of computing the consequences of capital structure decisions.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判了传统权衡理论，指出其未考虑债务赎回的缺陷。通过扩展的Merton模型分析，发现杠杆公司的特征实际上劣于无杠杆公司，税收减免的预期收益是文献错误造成的幻象。
AI.research_question: 债务和税收如何影响公司价值？考虑债务赎回后，杠杆公司是否真的比无杠杆公司更有价值？
AI.motivation: 传统权衡理论在分析债务和税收对公司价值影响时存在根本性错误——未考虑债务赎回，这使得公司成为套利利润的生成器，导致所有结果无效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权衡理论、MM理论、扩展的Merton模型（考虑债务、债务赎回、税收和税盾）
AI.method: 使用扩展的Merton模型，计算全权益公司和相同杠杆公司的资产分布，进行对比分析
AI.findings: 与传统观点相反，杠杆公司的特征实际上劣于无杠杆公司。预期的税收减免收益是文献错误造成的幻象，中等规模债务对公司并非有益。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 识别并纠正了传统权衡理论的根本性错误（未考虑债务赎回）
2. 通过扩展Merton模型提供了更完整的分析框架
3. 挑战了"中等债务规模对公司有益"的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了一种计算资本结构决策后果的方法，帮助他们更准确地评估债务和税收对公司价值的影响

title: Importance of Media Sovereignty, Stakeholding, And Narrative Setting for India
affiliations: Symbiosis School for Online and Distance Learning (SSODL), Pune, India

detail.title: Importance of Media Sovereignty, Stakeholding, And Narrative Setting for India
detail.abstract: In an era of intensified geopolitical competition, digital media expansion, and information contestation, the ability of the states to shape and sustain their own narratives has emerged as a critical dimension of contemporary power. This dissertation examines the importance of media sovereignty, domestic stake holding, and narrative setting for India, particularly in relation to national security communication and cultural representation. As a post colonial nation and an emerging global actor, India, operates within a media environment shaped by historical narrative asymmetries, trans-capital flows, and competing international informational interests. The study adopts a mixed-media research design, integrating qualitative audience survey data with qualitative analysis of cinema and news media. The two key narrative domains are examined: Indian cinema and news coverage of security-related events. The analysis traces the evolution of nationalist (war-military/national-security/espionage) India cinema before and after 2014, with particular attention to representations of 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. The findings indicate a post-2014 shift toward more assertive, evidence-based, and Indian-centric narrative constructions. Films such as Dhurandhar are analyzed for their use of archival material and documented references, reflecting a departure from earlier symbolic or indirect portrayals of national security. The dissertation further examines domestic and international media coverage of the 2025 Pahalgham terrorist attack and Operation Sindoor 1.0, highlighting divergences in framing, terminology,evidentiary standards, and narrative emphasis. These differences are analysed in relation to media ownership patterns, stakeholding structures and geopolitical positioning, as well as their impact on public perception and global discourse. The role of social media in amplifying and contesting narratives, alongside audience awareness of media influence, is also assessed. The study concludes that media narratives are not merely reflective but constitutive of national power, underscoring the need for strengthened domestic stakeholding, institutional narrative, capacity, and media literacy to support India’s narrative sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨印度在后殖民时代和新兴全球角色背景下，如何通过媒体主权、国内利益相关者参与和叙事构建来塑造国家安全传播和文化表征。研究采用混合媒体方法分析印度电影和新闻媒体，发现2014年后印度叙事转向更自信、基于证据和以印度为中心的模式，强调加强国内利益相关者参与和媒体素养对维护印度叙事主权的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在日益激烈的地缘政治竞争、数字媒体扩张和信息争夺时代，印度如何通过媒体主权、国内利益相关者参与和叙事构建来塑造国家安全传播和文化表征？
AI.motivation: 在当代权力竞争中，国家塑造和维持自身叙事的能力变得至关重要。作为后殖民国家和新兴全球参与者，印度面临着历史叙事不对称、跨国资本流动和竞争性国际信息利益塑造的媒体环境，需要研究其叙事主权建设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体主权理论、叙事权力理论、后殖民媒体研究、国家安全传播理论、文化表征理论
AI.method: 混合媒体研究设计：整合定性受众调查数据与电影和新闻媒体的定性分析。分析两个关键叙事领域：印度电影和安全相关事件的新闻报道。
AI.findings: 1. 2014年后印度电影叙事转向更自信、基于证据和以印度为中心的模式；2. 电影如Dhurandhar使用档案材料和文献参考，与早期象征性或间接的国家安全描绘不同；3. 国内外媒体对2025年Pahalgham恐怖袭击和Operation Sindoor 1.0的报道在框架、术语、证据标准和叙事重点上存在差异；4. 社交媒体在放大和争夺叙事中发挥重要作用；5. 受众对媒体影响有一定意识。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了后殖民背景下媒体主权理论；2. 深化了叙事作为国家权力构成要素的理论理解；3. 提出了国内利益相关者参与对叙事主权建设的重要性；4. 扩展了国家安全传播与文化表征的整合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度政策制定者提供加强国内利益相关者参与的建议；2. 提出加强机构叙事能力和媒体素养的具体措施；3. 为媒体从业者提供叙事构建的最佳实践；4. 为公众提高媒体批判意识提供指导；5. 为其他国家在类似背景下维护叙事主权提供参考。

title: When Needs Change Norms: Experimental Evidence that Income Shocks Undermine Norm-Driven Cooperation in Forest Commons
affiliations: University of Bonn, University of Bonn, Jimma University (JU) and University of Bonn, Max-Planck-Institut für Verhaltenökonomik

detail.title: When Needs Change Norms: Experimental Evidence that Income Shocks Undermine Norm-Driven Cooperation in Forest Commons

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the Transdisciplinary Research Area (TRA) "Individuals, Institutions and Societies" (University of Bonn) as part of the Excellence Strategy of the federal and state governments.

detail.abstract: Forest protection contributes to climate change mitigation and biodiversity conservation. Yet negative income shocks can induce local forest users to increase extraction in order to cope with economic hardship. We study how social norms shape collaborative forest management when communities face an exogenous income shock. We implement an incentivized framed field experiment with 162 smallholder farmers in rural Ethiopia using an interactive dynamic resource extraction game. Farmers individually decide how many trees to harvest from a community forest: harvested trees yield private income, whereas unharvested trees generate group benefits. They do so under different experimental treatments-either with or without i) the presence of a negative income shock and ii) a previous activation of social norms-allowing us to causally identify mechanisms shaping forest management. We find that the activation of social norms fosters fully sustainable resource management in the absence of an income shock. Moreover, a different norm emerges when the community encounters an income shock: now, harvesting more than can sustainably regrow is considered socially appropriate and harvesting behavior adjusts accordingly. Yet without norm activation, the negative income shock puts even more pressure on deforestation. Taken together, these findings suggest that policymakers should work with local communities to develop complementary institutional mechanisms that sustain collective forest management in times of crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过埃塞俄比亚的实地实验发现，社会规范在森林管理中起关键作用：无收入冲击时，规范激活能促进可持续管理；但收入冲击下会形成新的"过度采伐"规范，若无规范激活则导致更严重毁林。
AI.research_question: 社会规范如何影响社区在面对外生收入冲击时的协作森林管理？
AI.motivation: 森林保护对气候变化缓解和生物多样性保护至关重要，但经济困难可能导致当地居民增加采伐。理解社会规范如何调节这种压力下的森林管理行为具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会规范理论、集体行动理论和行为经济学框架，探讨规范如何塑造资源管理决策，特别是在经济冲击下的规范演变。
AI.method: 在埃塞俄比亚农村对162名小农户进行激励性框架实地实验，采用交互式动态资源采伐游戏，设置有无收入冲击和有无规范激活的2×2实验设计。
AI.findings: 1) 无收入冲击时，规范激活促进完全可持续的资源管理；2) 收入冲击下会形成新的社会规范，认为超过可持续再生水平的采伐是适当的；3) 若无规范激活，收入冲击导致更严重的毁林压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会规范在经济冲击下的动态演变机制，表明规范不是静态的而是会根据环境压力变化，为集体行动理论提供了行为经济学证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者与当地社区合作，建立补充性制度机制，在危机时期维持集体森林管理，避免规范向不可持续方向演变。

title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Latency, Throughput, and Reliability Optimization in Cloud-Native Financial Microservices

detail.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Latency, Throughput, and Reliability Optimization in Cloud-Native Financial Microservices
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of cloud-native financial systems has led to increasing demand for microservices that are energy-efficient, low-latency, and highly reliable (Krishnan & Durairaj, 2024). Traditional resource allocation strategies often struggle to balance these conflicting objectives, resulting in suboptimal system performance. This study develops a multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) framework designed to optimize latency, throughput, and reliability simultaneously in cloud-based financial microservices. The framework dynamically adapts to workload variations and prioritizes resource allocation based on real-time performance metrics. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that the proposed MORL approach significantly reduces response times, improves throughput, and maintains high reliability compared to baseline scheduling methods (Alelyani et al., 2024; Lyu et al., 2025). Moreover, the framework exhibits scalability and robustness under diverse workload patterns, indicating its practical applicability in dynamic cloud environments. These findings suggest that MORL-based scheduling can serve as an effective solution for managing complex performance trade-offs in financial microservices, ensuring optimal service delivery while efficiently utilizing cloud resources. Overall, the study highlights the potential of reinforcement learning techniques to enhance adaptive, efficient, and reliable cloud resource management for next-generation financial applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个多目标强化学习框架，用于同时优化云原生金融微服务的延迟、吞吐量和可靠性，相比传统方法显著提升了性能表现。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个多目标强化学习框架来同时优化云原生金融微服务的延迟、吞吐量和可靠性？
AI.motivation: 云原生金融系统的快速增长对微服务提出了能效、低延迟和高可靠性的需求，而传统资源分配策略难以平衡这些冲突目标，导致系统性能不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多目标强化学习理论，云资源管理理论，微服务性能优化理论
AI.method: 开发了一个多目标强化学习框架，动态适应工作负载变化，基于实时性能指标优先分配资源，并进行实验评估。
AI.findings: 提出的MORL方法相比基线调度方法显著减少了响应时间，提高了吞吐量，并保持了高可靠性；框架在不同工作负载模式下表现出可扩展性和鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个用于云原生金融微服务的多目标强化学习理论框架，为平衡延迟、吞吐量和可靠性等冲突目标提供了理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融微服务提供了有效的资源调度解决方案，确保最优服务交付的同时高效利用云资源，具有在动态云环境中的实际应用价值。

title: An Earnings-based Measure of Firm-level Geopolitical Risk
affiliations: Xiamen University - Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics (WISE),  and Xiamen University

detail.title: An Earnings-based Measure of Firm-level Geopolitical Risk
detail.abstract: We construct an earnings-based measure of firm-level geopolitical risk exposure using financial data from U.S. and Chinese listed firms, the construction of which has major advantages regarding comparability and convenience. Following the methodology of Ball et al. (2022), we first establish that country-level geopolitical risk systematically affects aggregate corporate earnings, confirming earnings contain information about this risk. We then identify book-to-market ratio, firm size, excess cash holdings, and labor expense burden as the four firm characteristics that drive cross-sectional variation in this sensitivity. Using these characteristics, we construct a firm-level indicator of geopolitical risk exposure. Higher firm-level geopolitical risk exposure significantly increases foreign revenue volatility and cash holdings while significantly reducing investment in fixed assets. High-tech and transportation industries exhibit the highest geopolitical risk exposure, whereas the utilities industry shows the lowest. As a complement to Caldara and Iacoviello (2022), our work provides a robust framework for analyzing the microeconomic impact of geopolitical risks and offers a useful tool for exploring how these risks influence firm behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于企业盈利数据的公司层面地缘政治风险暴露指标，该指标在可比性和便利性方面具有优势。研究发现地缘政治风险会影响企业盈利，并识别出驱动这种敏感性差异的四个公司特征，进而构建了公司层面的地缘政治风险暴露指标。高暴露会增加海外收入波动和现金持有，减少固定资产投资，高科技和交通行业暴露最高，公用事业最低。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于企业盈利数据的公司层面地缘政治风险暴露指标？哪些公司特征驱动了地缘政治风险对企业盈利敏感性的横截面差异？公司层面的地缘政治风险暴露如何影响企业行为？
AI.motivation: 现有地缘政治风险研究多集中在宏观层面，缺乏有效的公司层面风险暴露测量工具。需要构建一个具有可比性和便利性的公司层面指标来更好地分析地缘政治风险的微观经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ball et al. (2022)的方法论，确认地缘政治风险会影响企业盈利；借鉴Caldara和Iacoviello (2022)的地缘政治风险研究框架，但聚焦于微观层面的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用美国和中国的上市公司财务数据，首先验证国家层面地缘政治风险对总体企业盈利的系统性影响；然后识别驱动横截面差异的四个公司特征（账面市值比、公司规模、超额现金持有、劳动力费用负担）；基于这些特征构建公司层面的地缘政治风险暴露指标。
AI.findings: 1）地缘政治风险确实影响企业盈利；2）账面市值比、公司规模、超额现金持有和劳动力费用负担是驱动敏感性的关键特征；3）高暴露公司海外收入波动和现金持有显著增加，固定资产投资显著减少；4）高科技和交通行业暴露最高，公用事业最低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一个基于盈利数据的公司层面地缘政治风险暴露测量框架；2）识别了驱动地缘政治风险敏感性的关键公司特征；3）为分析地缘政治风险的微观经济影响提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为投资者和管理者提供了实用的地缘政治风险评估工具；2）帮助企业识别和管理地缘政治风险暴露；3）为政策制定者理解地缘政治风险的微观传导机制提供依据；4）可作为Caldara和Iacoviello (2022)宏观指标的微观补充。

title: Understanding Inflation's Unequal Burden: Evidence from Spanish Households

detail.title: Understanding Inflation's Unequal Burden: Evidence from Spanish Households
detail.abstract: This paper examines the distributional effects of the recent inflationary episode in Spain, with a focus on how price increases have impacted households across the income distribution. Using microdata from the Spanish Household Budget Survey (EPF) from 2016 to 2023, the study constructs household-specific price indices to capture perceived inflation and analyzes changes in budget shares across key expenditure categories. The analysis combines tools from fiscal incidence literature, such as concentration indices and the Reynolds-Smolensky index, with a regression framework based on Engel curves estimated separately by income quintile. The findings reveal that inflation has had a regressive effect: lower-income households not only experienced higher perceived inflation but also shifted their spending toward essential goods such as food and rent. In contrast, higher-income households showed greater resilience, maintaining discretionary expenditures like vehicle use and accommodation services. These results highlight the unequal burden of inflation and underscore the need for targeted policy measures to protect vulnerable households during periods of price instability.

AI.tldr: 西班牙通胀对低收入家庭影响更大，他们面临更高感知通胀且消费向必需品转移，而高收入家庭更具韧性，维持非必需消费，显示通胀负担不平等。
AI.research_question: 西班牙近期通胀对不同收入家庭的影响分布如何？价格增长如何影响不同收入阶层的家庭？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀对不同收入群体的分布影响，揭示通胀负担的不平等性，为保护弱势家庭的政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政影响文献中的集中指数和雷诺兹-斯莫伦斯基指数，结合基于恩格尔曲线的回归框架。
AI.method: 使用2016-2023年西班牙家庭预算调查微观数据，构建家庭特定价格指数，按收入五分位数分别估计恩格尔曲线，分析关键支出类别的预算份额变化。
AI.findings: 通胀具有累退效应：低收入家庭不仅经历更高感知通胀，还将消费转向食品和租金等必需品；高收入家庭更具韧性，维持车辆使用和住宿服务等非必需消费。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财政影响分析工具应用于通胀分布效应研究，发展了按收入分层分析通胀影响的方法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示通胀负担不平等，强调需要针对性政策保护弱势家庭，为政府制定通胀应对措施提供实证依据。

title: AI Grading, Grade Inflation, and Student Satisfaction
affiliations: Case Western Reserve University - Department of Economics, Case Western Reserve University,  and Case Western Reserve University

detail.title: AI Grading, Grade Inflation, and Student Satisfaction
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether artificial intelligence (AI) grading can reduce grading costs and grade inflation without generating independent student dissatisfaction. Using a randomized controlled trial in which identical undergraduate assignments are graded by either human graders or an AI system, with students blinded to grader identity, we document three main results. First, AI graders assign significantly lower grades than human graders to the same work. Second, students are unable to detect whether grading is performed by AI or humans. Third, conditional on the grade received, student satisfaction does not differ by grader type. These findings are robust across specifications with student fixed effects, assignment controls, and interaction tests. The results suggest that AI grading changes grading outcomes by altering evaluators’ incentive constraints rather than through differences in pedagogy or student perceptions.

AI.tldr: AI评分相比人工评分显著降低分数，但学生无法识别评分者身份，且对评分满意度无差异，表明AI通过改变评估者激励约束而非教学差异来改变评分结果。
AI.research_question: AI评分能否在降低评分成本和分数膨胀的同时，不引起学生独立的不满情绪？
AI.motivation: 探索AI评分在教育评估中的实际效果，特别是在成本效益、分数膨胀和学生满意度方面的平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于评估者激励约束理论，而非教学差异或学生感知差异来解释AI评分的影响机制。
AI.method: 随机对照试验：相同本科作业由AI或人工评分，学生不知评分者身份，使用学生固定效应、作业控制和交互检验等稳健性分析。
AI.findings: 1. AI评分显著低于人工评分；2. 学生无法识别评分者是AI还是人类；3. 在相同分数下，学生对评分满意度无差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI评分通过改变评估者激励约束而非教学差异来影响评分结果的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构采用AI评分系统提供实证依据，表明AI可在降低成本和分数膨胀的同时保持学生满意度。

title: Design Citations and Patent Basicness

detail.title: Design Citations and Patent Basicness
detail.abstract: Patents make citations to designs and do receive citations from them. Design are inherently applied, and their citations in a patent or to it imply that the patent should be of an applied nature, too. However, the existing metrics of basicness that rely on citations do not properly take this information into account and may still show these patents as very basic. I begin by showing that design citations to and from patents are more common than thought. They are also more frequent among patents in less basic areas of technology and among patents lodged by businesses in the absence of collaboration with government or other research institutes. Focusing on the generality index, I use a decomposition method to show how it mis-aligns with basicness and where the bias is originating from. Based on the results, I propose a simple fix. I test the revised index on university versus corporate patents. The fix generates a bigger basciness gap between patents registered by academia versus the corporate ones than previously predicted.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有基于引用的基础性指标未能充分考虑设计与专利之间的引用关系，导致对应用型专利的基础性评估存在偏差。作者通过分解方法揭示了这种偏差的来源，并提出简单修正方法，使大学专利与企业专利之间的基础性差距更加明显。
AI.research_question: 现有基于引用的基础性指标（如通用性指数）如何未能准确反映设计与专利之间的引用关系，以及如何修正这些指标以更准确地评估专利的基础性程度？
AI.motivation: 设计与专利之间存在双向引用关系，设计具有应用性质，这些引用应表明相关专利也具有应用性质。然而，现有基于引用的基础性指标未能充分考虑这一信息，可能导致应用型专利被错误地评估为高度基础性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利基础性理论、引用网络分析、设计与专利的交叉引用关系、技术分类理论（基础技术与应用技术）、组织类型对专利性质的影响（大学vs企业）
AI.method: 1. 实证分析设计与专利之间的引用频率；2. 分解方法分析通用性指数与基础性的错配；3. 提出修正指数；4. 在大学专利与企业专利上进行测试比较
AI.findings: 1. 设计与专利之间的引用比想象中更常见；2. 这种引用在技术基础性较低领域更频繁；3. 企业单独申请的专利（无政府或研究机构合作）中此类引用更多；4. 修正后的指数显示大学专利与企业专利之间的基础性差距比先前预测更大
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了现有基础性指标在考虑设计与专利引用关系方面的局限性；2. 提供了分解方法识别指标偏差来源；3. 提出了修正的基础性评估框架；4. 深化了对不同类型组织专利性质差异的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为专利评估提供了更准确的基础性指标；2. 帮助政策制定者更好地区分基础研究与应用研究产出；3. 为企业研发决策提供参考；4. 为大学技术转移评估提供改进工具

title: Togliatti: Centres of Attraction and Revitalisation
affiliations: and Russian Academy of National Economy and Public Administration under the President of the Russian Federation (RANEPA)

detail.title: Togliatti: Centres of Attraction and Revitalisation
detail.abstract: Togliatti, once a flourishing industrial centre of Russia, currently grapples with a multitude of economic and social challenges. This article examines the historical development of the city, commencing with its foundation. Particular attention is devoted to the renovation of key cultural heritage sites, such as the Palace of Culture and Technology and Victory Park, which possess the potential to evolve into focal points for local residents and tourists. The research methodology encompasses an analysis of existing approaches to renovation, including immersive practices and contemporary technologies, which facilitates the creation of interactive and engaging public spaces. As a result of this work, specific recommendations for renovation are proposed, aimed at restoring Togliatti's cultural and social significance, as well as establishing a comfortable urban environment for living and creative pursuits. The article underscores the importance of preserving historical memory and the city's unique identity, which would enable Togliatti not only to overcome its current difficulties but also to serve as a model for other cities confronting analogous challenges.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨俄罗斯工业城市陶里亚蒂的文化遗产修复策略，通过分析历史发展、现有修复方法，提出具体建议以恢复城市文化社会意义，建立宜居创意环境。
AI.research_question: 如何通过关键文化遗产（如文化与技术宫、胜利公园）的修复，使陶里亚蒂恢复文化社会意义并成为宜居创意城市？
AI.motivation: 陶里亚蒂曾是俄罗斯繁荣的工业中心，现面临多重经济社会挑战，需要通过文化遗产修复来振兴城市，恢复其文化社会重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市更新理论、文化遗产保护理论、沉浸式实践理论、公共空间设计理论。
AI.method: 分析现有修复方法，包括沉浸式实践和现代技术应用，研究如何创造互动参与性公共空间。
AI.findings: 提出了具体的文化遗产修复建议，旨在将关键文化遗址转变为当地居民和游客的焦点，恢复城市文化社会意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 为工业城市转型提供了文化遗产修复的理论框架，强调历史记忆保护和城市独特身份的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为陶里亚蒂提供了具体的修复实施方案，可作为其他面临类似挑战城市的参考模型。
