detail.title: Programming Money Without Programmable Money

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1180
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Programmability is at the heart of ongoing work on the future of money and payments by central banks around the world. Despite its potential, there is growing concern that programmability conflicts with the provision of "good" money. This paper overviews key principles of "good" money and argues that the discourse on programmability inadequately differentiates between programmable money, which is generally negatively viewed, and programmable payments, which is generally accepted as part of the future. We provide a framework for programmable monetary systems that sharply distinguishes between programmable money and programmable payments. We show that our framework nests a broader set of financial arrangements and revisit the debate on programmability in the design of monetary systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了可编程货币与可编程支付，认为前者通常被负面看待，而后者被接受为未来的一部分。作者提供了一个框架来区分两者，并重新审视了货币系统设计中关于可编程性的争论。
AI.research_question: 如何区分可编程货币与可编程支付？在货币系统设计中，可编程性如何与"良好"货币的原则相协调？
AI.motivation: 各国央行正在探索货币和支付的未来，可编程性是其核心。但人们越来越担心可编程性与提供"良好"货币相冲突。现有讨论未能充分区分可编程货币（通常被负面看待）和可编程支付（通常被接受为未来的一部分）。
AI.theoretical_framework: "良好"货币的关键原则；可编程货币与可编程支付的区分框架；可编程货币系统的理论框架。
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建；理论论证；文献综述与辩论重新审视。
AI.findings: 1. 可编程货币通常被负面看待，而可编程支付被接受为未来的一部分；2. 需要明确区分这两种概念；3. 提出的框架能够包含更广泛的金融安排；4. 重新审视了货币系统设计中关于可编程性的争论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了区分可编程货币与可编程支付的理论框架；2. 将可编程性讨论置于"良好"货币原则的背景下；3. 展示了该框架如何包含更广泛的金融安排；4. 重新概念化了货币系统设计中的可编程性辩论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行和政策制定者提供了设计可编程货币系统的实用框架；2. 帮助区分可接受的可编程支付和可能有害的可编程货币；3. 指导未来货币系统的实际设计和实施；4. 为监管和政策制定提供理论基础。

reference: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1179; https://doi.org/10.59576/sr.1179
title: Stablecoins vs. Tokenized Deposits: The Narrow Banking Debate Revisited
affiliations: Lingnan College, Sun Yat-sen University and

detail.title: Stablecoins vs. Tokenized Deposits: The Narrow Banking Debate Revisited

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1179
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how the type of money used in blockchain-based trade affects interest rates, investment, and welfare. Stablecoins in our model are backed by safe assets, while banks issue deposits (both traditional and tokenized) to fund a portfolio of safe and risky assets. Deposit insurance creates a risk-shifting incentive for banks, and regulation increases banks' costs. If regulatory costs are large and risk-shifting is limited, we show that allowing only tokenized deposits to be used in crypto trade raises welfare by expanding bank credit. If regulation is lighter and the risk-shifting incentive is strong, in contrast, allowing only stablecoins is desirable despite crowding out credit. In between these cases, allowing stablecoins and tokenized deposits to compete is optimal. The tradeoffs between these policies are reminiscent of both historical and recent debates over the desirability of narrow banking.

AI.tldr: 研究区块链交易中使用的货币类型（稳定币与代币化存款）如何影响利率、投资和社会福利，分析不同监管环境和风险转移激励下的最优政策选择。
AI.research_question: 区块链交易中使用的货币类型（稳定币与代币化存款）如何影响利率、投资和社会福利？在不同监管环境和风险转移激励下，哪种货币使用政策最优？
AI.motivation: 随着区块链技术和加密货币交易的发展，稳定币和代币化存款等新型货币形式在交易中扮演重要角色。理解这些货币类型对金融体系的影响，对于制定合理的监管政策至关重要，这与历史上关于"狭义银行"的辩论有相似之处。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行理论、风险转移理论（存款保险引发的道德风险）和监管成本理论。稳定币由安全资产支持，而银行发行存款（包括传统和代币化）来投资安全与风险资产组合。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含稳定币、银行、监管环境和风险转移激励的经济模型，分析不同政策情景下的均衡结果。
AI.findings:
1. 当监管成本高且风险转移有限时，只允许代币化存款用于加密交易能提高福利，因为它扩大了银行信贷。
2. 当监管较轻且风险转移激励强时，只允许稳定币更优，尽管会挤出信贷。
3. 在中间情况下，允许稳定币和代币化存款竞争是最优政策。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为区块链货币选择问题提供了理论框架。
2. 将传统银行理论与加密货币环境相结合。
3. 揭示了监管成本与风险转移激励之间的权衡关系。
4. 连接了当代加密货币政策辩论与历史上的"狭义银行"讨论。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了基于不同监管环境的货币选择指导。
2. 帮助监管机构理解何时应限制或允许特定货币形式。
3. 为银行和稳定币发行者提供了战略参考。
4. 有助于平衡金融创新与金融稳定之间的关系。

title: The Invisible Ledger: Measuring ASEAN's $185 Billion Unmeasured Digital Economy

detail.title: The Invisible Ledger: Measuring ASEAN's $185 Billion Unmeasured Digital Economy
detail.abstract:
This study quantifies what I term the “invisible economy” across ASEAN’s five ma-
jor digital markets-income flowing to platform participants (drivers, merchants, sell-
ers) that escapes tax administration despite being digitally intermediated. Drawing
on audited financial filings from Indonesia’s three dominant platforms (Grab, GoTo,
Sea Limited), I document an estimated $82.8 billion invisible wedge and calculate a
12.5x ecosystem ratio for Indonesia; the ASEAN-5 weighted average is 12.3x. For
every dollar of platform revenue that tax authorities can audit, approximately $12
flows to decentralized participants outside administrative reach. To validate these
estimates, I exploit Malaysia’s January 2024 tax base expansion as a natural exper-
iment; difference-in-differences analysis suggests that base expansion captured ap-
proximately $114 million annually (p = 0.003), which I interpret as supportive ev-
idence that this invisible economy both exists and responds to policy intervention.
Cross-validation against three countries’ digital tax collections yields effective rates
of 1.0-1.6%, broadly consistent with the estimates. Time series analysis points to
fiscal decoupling that appears structural rather than cyclical-the invisible share in-
creased from 95.7% to 97.6% between 2020 and 2023. Based on these findings, I
propose a bifurcated policy framework: zero-rated formalization for subsistence gig
workers (enabling credit access without immediate taxation) and algorithmic with-
holding for high-income creators (capturing economic rents at source).

AI.tldr: 本研究量化了东盟五大数字市场的"隐形经济"规模，即流向平台参与者（司机、商家、卖家）但逃避税收监管的收入。研究发现印尼存在828亿美元的隐形经济楔子，生态系统比率为12.5倍，意味着每1美元可审计的平台收入，就有约12美元流向税收监管之外的分散参与者。马来西亚的自然实验验证了隐形经济的存在和政策干预有效性。
AI.research_question: 东盟五大数字市场中，流向平台参与者但逃避税收监管的"隐形经济"规模有多大？这种隐形经济是否对政策干预有响应？
AI.motivation: 随着数字平台的快速发展，大量经济活动通过平台进行但逃避税收监管，形成"隐形经济"，这给税收征管带来挑战，也影响财政公平和经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字平台经济理论、税收征管理论、隐形经济理论、政策干预有效性理论
AI.method: 1. 基于印尼三大主导平台（Grab、GoTo、Sea Limited）审计财务报表的量化分析；2. 利用马来西亚2024年1月税基扩张作为自然实验的差异中差异分析；3. 三个国家数字税收征收的交叉验证；4. 时间序列分析
AI.findings: 1. 印尼存在828亿美元的隐形经济楔子，生态系统比率为12.5倍；2. 东盟五国加权平均生态系统比率为12.3倍；3. 马来西亚税基扩张每年捕获约1.14亿美元隐形经济；4. 有效税率在1.0-1.6%之间；5. 隐形经济份额从2020年的95.7%增加到2023年的97.6%，呈现结构性而非周期性趋势
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化数字平台经济中的隐形经济规模；2. 提出生态系统比率概念，衡量平台收入与隐形经济的关系；3. 验证隐形经济对政策干预的响应性；4. 识别数字经济的财政脱钩现象
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出分叉政策框架：对维持生计的零工工作者实行零税率正规化，对高收入创作者实行算法预扣税；2. 为政策制定者提供量化依据；3. 帮助税收部门更有效监管数字经济活动

title: Corporal punishment and learning outcomes: Evidence from Primary schools in Uganda
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Pretoria

detail.title: Corporal punishment and learning outcomes: Evidence from Primary schools in Uganda
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of corporal punishment (CP) on learning outcomes in primary schools in Uganda. Using nationally representative pupil and school-level data linked to household information, we exploit variation in awareness campaigns as an instrument for CP to identify causal effects. On average, we find that exposure to CP significantly reduces student performance, in english scores by 0.67 percentage points and mathematics scores by 0.8 percent points on average. The stronger negative effect in mathematics reflects both subject-specific anxiety and the greater likelihood of punishment for poor performance in math in Uganda. Moreover, the impact of CP is more pronounced in schools found in communities where corporal punishment is socially unacceptable, suggesting that social norms moderate the effect through children’s anxiety, withdrawal, and reduced engagement. These findings underscore that legal bans alone are insufficient: effective policy must combine enforcement with interventions that shift social norms and promote non-violent discipline.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用乌干达全国代表性数据，发现体罚显著降低小学生学业表现，英语成绩平均下降0.67个百分点，数学成绩下降0.8个百分点。社会规范调节体罚影响，在体罚不被社会接受的社区中负面影响更严重。
AI.research_question: 体罚对乌干达小学学生学习成果有何因果影响？社会规范如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管许多国家已立法禁止体罚，但体罚在乌干达等发展中国家仍普遍存在。需要实证证据了解体罚对学生学习的实际影响，以及法律禁令是否足够有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理学理论（体罚导致焦虑、退缩和参与度降低）和社会规范理论（社区态度调节体罚影响）。特别关注数学学科因成绩差更易受罚的特点。
AI.method: 使用全国代表性的学生和学校层面数据，结合家庭信息。利用认知宣传活动作为工具变量识别体罚的因果效应。分析英语和数学成绩差异。
AI.findings: 体罚显著降低学业表现：英语成绩平均下降0.67个百分点，数学成绩下降0.8个百分点。数学负面影响更强，反映学科特定焦虑和数学成绩差更易受罚的现实。在体罚不被社会接受的社区中，负面影响更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供体罚对学生学习因果影响的实证证据；揭示社会规范在调节体罚影响中的作用机制；验证学科差异在体罚影响中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明仅靠法律禁令不足够，有效政策需要结合执法与社会规范转变干预；建议推广非暴力纪律方法；为教育政策制定者提供实证依据。

title: The Impact of Buffer Tank Size on Explicit Flexibility in Residential Buildings: A Model Predictive Control Analysis
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University, RWTH Aachen University, RWTH Aachen University, RWTH Aachen University and RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: The Impact of Buffer Tank Size on Explicit Flexibility in Residential Buildings: A Model Predictive Control Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper
declarations.funderStatement: We gratefully acknowledge the financial support by the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE), promotional reference 03EN3092B and 03EI4081A. This research was funded by CETPartnership, the Clean Energy Transition Partnership under the 2022 joint call for research proposals, co-funded by the European Commission (GA N°101069750) and with the funding organizations detailed on https://cetpartnership.eu/funding-agencies-and-call-modules.

detail.abstract: The increasing adoption of renewable energy and heat pumps strains electrical grids, creating opportunities for residential buildings to provide demand-side flexibility through participation in emerging flexibility markets. This paper investigates how the size of a thermal buffer tank impacts a building's ability to offer explicit flexibility, defined by the amount of shiftable energy and its specific activation cost. Using a Model Predictive Control framework with detailed, nonlinear system models in a Modelica-based Co-Simulation, we conduct a parametric study analyzing a range of buffer tank sizes (10 l/kW to 150 l/kW) under various market-based temporal constraints. To account for realistic heat pump operating limitations, the framework leverages a Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Programming formulation, enabling the explicit modeling of heat pump on/off cycling through integer variables. Our results show diminishing returns for positive flexibility (load reduction), with negligible gains in shiftable energy for tank sizes beyond 50 l/kW. Conversely, for negative flexibility (load increase), an optimal tank size exists to maximize the energy amount, though specific costs continue to decrease with larger tanks due to higher operational efficiency. The analysis also reveals that preparation time is the dominant factor for positive flexibility, while event duration is most critical for negative flexibility. These findings demonstrate that sizing a buffer tank for grid services is a complex trade-off between the amount and economic viability of flexibility. This provides a quantitative basis for designing cost-effective, flexibility-ready heating systems to support the energy transition.

AI.tldr: 研究热泵系统中缓冲水箱尺寸如何影响建筑提供电网灵活性服务的能力，发现正灵活性（减载）在50升/千瓦后收益递减，负灵活性（增载）存在最优水箱尺寸，且准备时间和事件持续时间是关键影响因素。
AI.research_question: 缓冲水箱尺寸如何影响建筑通过热泵系统提供电网灵活性服务的能力？具体来说，水箱尺寸如何影响可转移能量和特定激活成本？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源和热泵的普及给电网带来压力，建筑可以通过参与灵活性市场提供需求侧灵活性。然而，热泵系统的缓冲水箱尺寸设计对灵活性提供能力的影响尚不明确，需要定量分析以指导成本效益最优的系统设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于模型预测控制框架，采用混合整数非线性规划方法，通过整数变量显式建模热泵启停循环，分析缓冲水箱尺寸与电网灵活性服务之间的量化关系。
AI.method: 采用基于Modelica的协同仿真平台，建立详细的非线性系统模型，进行参数化研究，分析缓冲水箱尺寸范围（10-150升/千瓦）在不同市场时间约束下的表现。
AI.findings: 1. 正灵活性（减载）存在收益递减，水箱尺寸超过50升/千瓦后可转移能量增益可忽略；2. 负灵活性（增载）存在最优水箱尺寸以最大化能量量，但特定成本随水箱增大而降低；3. 准备时间是正灵活性的主导因素，事件持续时间是负灵活性的关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了缓冲水箱尺寸与电网灵活性服务能力的量化关系模型；2. 揭示了正负灵活性对水箱尺寸的不同响应机制；3. 识别了时间约束对灵活性提供的关键影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为设计成本效益最优的灵活性就绪供暖系统提供定量依据；2. 指导建筑业主和系统设计者在灵活性提供能力和经济性之间做出权衡决策；3. 支持能源转型中电网灵活性服务的有效实施。

title: The Bath of Chance: Immiscible Persistence and the Cost of Time in Cosmology

detail.title: The Bath of Chance: Immiscible Persistence and the Cost of Time in Cosmology
detail.abstract:
This paper questions the unlicensed assumption that all persistent structure must integrate into a single historical ledger under time. From a minimal grammar—Chance exists (repeated interaction permitted, persistence not guaranteed); entropy erases unprotected distinction; time attaches locally only where persistence resists erasure and reshapes probabilities—no global completion is required.

Failure to attach time is admissible, not anomalous. Persistence without history (a-historical geometry) can exert influence (e.g., curvature) without memory, informational participation, or homogenization. Plurality of non-integrating regimes is the null expectation; uniformity would require a forcing mechanism (none observed).

Dark matter is reframed as persistent pre-time geometry: gravitational effects without authorized narrative. Light, propagating without internal history, registers such immiscibility directly via differential distortions. Predicted observational signatures (shape classes) include phase-misaligned lensing asymmetries, frequency-dependent residuals, anomalous shear patterns resistant to single-phase modeling, non-Gaussian clustering in residuals, boundary-like features in gravitational maps, and persistent dynamical-lensing divergences beyond baryonic uncertainty.

The framework does not propose mechanisms or revise models; it prices the expectation of mandatory integration. Falsifiability is structural: demonstrate mandatory time attachment for all gravitational persistence, global single-phase convergence without residuals, or light insensitivity to regime differences. Absent counterexamples, immiscible persistence remains admissible.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了所有持久结构必须整合到单一历史时间轴下的假设，提出存在无需时间附着的持久几何结构（如暗物质），这些结构会产生可观测的引力效应，但无需历史记忆或信息整合。
AI.research_question: 所有持久结构是否必须整合到单一历史时间轴下？是否存在无需时间附着的持久几何结构？
AI.motivation: 质疑物理学中未经检验的假设：所有持久结构都必须有历史记录并整合到单一时间框架下。作者认为这种"强制整合"假设缺乏依据，且可能阻碍对暗物质等现象的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最小语法：机会存在（允许重复交互，不保证持久性）；熵擦除未受保护的区分；时间仅局部附着于抵抗擦除的持久性并重塑概率。提出"前时间几何"概念，允许持久性无需历史记忆或信息参与。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论推导。从基本假设出发构建理论框架，提出可观测预测，并通过结构可证伪性来验证理论：要求证明所有引力持久性必须附着时间，或全球单相收敛无残差，或光对体制差异不敏感。
AI.findings: 1. 时间附着失败是可接受的，非异常现象；2. 存在无历史的持久性（非历史几何），如曲率效应无需记忆或信息参与；3. 非整合体制的多元性是零期望，统一性需要强制机制；4. 暗物质可重构为持久的前时间几何；5. 光可直接记录这种不可混性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了物理学中"强制整合"的基本假设；2. 提出"前时间几何"概念框架；3. 为暗物质提供新的理论解释；4. 建立结构可证伪性标准；5. 允许多元持久性体制共存。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可观测预测：相位失准的透镜不对称性、频率依赖残差、抗单相建模的异常剪切模式、残差中的非高斯聚类、引力图中的边界特征等；2. 为天文观测数据分析提供新视角；3. 指导未来观测实验设计。

title: Biology as a Grammar of Chemical Persistence: What Entropy Could Not Finish – A Structural Flow Perspective

detail.title: Biology as a Grammar of Chemical Persistence: What Entropy Could Not Finish – A Structural Flow Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper reframes biology as a late, narrow regime of chemical persistence under entropy, deriving its structural necessities from a single premise: Chance exists. From this, entropy emerges as memory erasure under repeated interaction, persistence becomes fragile without reinforcement, recursive persistence propagates as cascades, boundary maintenance counters erosion, finite capacity forces copying, and failure under constraint produces filtering. No teleology, no privilege, no new principles are introduced. Biology appears purposeful-self-preservation, function, reproduction, adaptation-only retrospectively, as the visible residue of prolonged exposure to entropy without collapse. The framework does not predict mechanisms, specify molecules, or claim inevitability of life. It constrains what any persistent biological system must satisfy: recursive reinforcement, continuity via cascades, boundary maintenance, copying under limits, and differential persistence through failure. Rarity is structural-failure space vastly exceeds success space-not probabilistic accident. Falsifiability is explicit: demonstrate persistence without recursion, cascades without continuity, maintenance without capacity limits, copying without filtering, or regimes that violate these necessities without collapse. Absent such counterexamples, the conclusions are not speculative; they are unavoidable consequences of chance permitting retry without guaranteed persistence. This non-reductionist structural grammar relocates biology's explanatory base within chemistry, accounting for apparent directionality and complexity without invoking purpose or exemption from entropy.

AI.tldr: 该论文将生物学重新定义为化学在熵作用下的晚期、狭窄的持久性机制，从"机会存在"这一单一前提推导出生物学的结构必然性，解释了生命现象如何作为熵作用下持久性系统的可见残留而出现。
AI.research_question: 从"机会存在"这一基本前提出发，如何推导出生物学作为化学持久性系统的结构必然性？
AI.motivation: 传统生物学解释往往隐含目的论或特权假设，该论文旨在提供一个纯粹基于机会和熵的框架，解释生物学现象如何作为化学持久性系统的必然结果而出现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"机会存在"的单前提框架，熵被重新定义为重复相互作用下的记忆擦除，持久性需要递归强化，边界维护对抗侵蚀，有限容量迫使复制，约束下的失败产生筛选。
AI.method: 概念推导和逻辑论证方法，从基本前提出发推导结构必然性，不依赖具体机制或分子细节的预测。
AI.findings: 生物学现象（自我保存、功能、繁殖、适应）只是熵作用下持久性系统的可见残留；持久性系统必须满足递归强化、级联连续性、边界维护、有限容量下的复制、通过失败的差异持久性等结构约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个非还原论的结构语法，将生物学的解释基础重新定位在化学内部，解释了表观方向性和复杂性，无需诉诸目的论或熵豁免。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了明确的可证伪性标准：展示无需递归的持久性、无需连续性的级联、无容量限制的维护、无筛选的复制，或违反这些必然性而不崩溃的机制。

title: Innovating Tradition: The Adoption of Digital Marketing by Grape Growers in Karnataka

detail.title: Innovating Tradition: The Adoption of Digital Marketing by Grape Growers in Karnataka
detail.abstract: This paper explores the implementation of digital marketing strategies among grape producers, a sector that has historically relied on local markets and traditional marketing approaches. The research is based on an extensive review of secondary sources, which includes academic studies, industry analyses, and case studies, aimed at understanding the challenges and opportunities that digital technologies present for this sector. The findings suggest that digital marketing holds considerable promise for grape growers to broaden their market reach, enhance engagement with consumers, and boost brand visibility. By utilizing social media, e-commerce platforms, and online marketplaces, growers can engage with a larger audience, establish direct relationships with consumers, and distinguish their products. Nevertheless, obstacles such as limited digital skills, insufficient access to technology and reliable internet connections, and consumer preferences for traditional channels impede widespread adoption. This study highlights the need for targeted interventions to support the successful integration of digital marketing within the grape growing sector

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了葡萄种植者采用数字营销策略的实施情况，发现数字营销能帮助葡萄生产者扩大市场覆盖、增强消费者互动和提升品牌知名度，但面临数字技能不足、技术获取有限等障碍，需要针对性干预支持。
AI.research_question: 葡萄种植者如何实施数字营销策略？数字技术为该行业带来了哪些挑战和机遇？
AI.motivation: 葡萄种植行业历史上依赖本地市场和传统营销方式，数字技术为该行业提供了新的发展机会，但实施过程中面临诸多挑战，需要系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字营销理论、农业营销理论、技术采纳理论
AI.method: 基于二手资料的广泛文献综述，包括学术研究、行业分析和案例研究
AI.findings: 数字营销对葡萄种植者具有巨大潜力：能扩大市场覆盖、增强消费者互动、提升品牌知名度；通过社交媒体、电商平台和在线市场能与更广泛受众建立直接关系；但面临数字技能不足、技术获取有限、网络连接不可靠以及消费者偏好传统渠道等障碍
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了农业领域数字营销的理论研究，为传统农业向数字化转型提供了理论框架，拓展了技术采纳理论在农业营销中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为葡萄种植者提供了数字营销实施的具体路径和工具建议；为政策制定者和行业支持机构指出了需要针对性干预的领域，如数字技能培训、技术基础设施改善等

title: Edge AI as a Supervisory Instrument: Enabling Risk-based, Real-Time Banking Oversight

detail.title: Edge AI as a Supervisory Instrument: Enabling Risk-based, Real-Time Banking Oversight
detail.abstract: Edge artificial intelligence (Edge AI) offers a transformative opportunity to redesign banking supervision around real-time, risk-based oversight rather than periodic, data-heavy reporting. The article argues that supervisory effectiveness increasingly depends not only on which risks are monitored but on where analytical intelligence is embedded, moving closer to the point of risk origination in payments, trading, retail distribution, and outsourced infrastructures. Edge AI is defined as institution-side AI models deployed within operational systems-such as ATMs, payment gateways, mobile apps, and cloud-hosted cores-that generate standardised risk signals accessible to supervisors through secure interfaces. When aligned with risk-based supervision frameworks, these signals enable proportional, targeted scrutiny of high-risk activities, customers, and transactions, while reducing bulk data submissions and enhancing privacy. The article develops use-case-driven scenarios spanning real-time anomaly detection, behavioural indicators of misconduct, early-warning metrics for liquidity and operational disruptions, and continuous oversight of third-party dependencies. It proposes a shift from data-centric to signal-centric oversight and examines the governance, accountability, and auditability requirements of decentralised intelligence, including model-risk management, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls. The analysis situates Edge AI within next-generation SupTech architectures and global risk-based principles, highlighting both benefits (timeliness, proportionality, resilience) and risks (model drift, cyber exposure, capability gaps). It concludes that carefully governed Edge AI can act as an enabling supervisory layer that brings oversight structurally closer to where risks crystallise, strengthening systemic resilience without prescribing specific technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了边缘人工智能（Edge AI）如何重塑银行监管，从传统的定期数据报告转向基于风险的实时监控。通过将AI模型部署在ATM、支付网关等操作系统中，生成标准化风险信号，实现更精准、及时的监管。
AI.research_question: 边缘人工智能如何通过将分析智能嵌入风险源头来提升银行监管的有效性？
AI.motivation: 传统银行监管依赖定期、数据密集的报告模式，无法实现实时风险监控。边缘AI提供了将监管智能嵌入风险源头的机会，实现更及时、基于风险的监督。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险的监管框架、信号中心监管理论、分散式智能治理理论、下一代监管科技架构
AI.method: 用例驱动的情景分析，包括实时异常检测、行为不当指标、流动性预警、操作中断预警、第三方依赖持续监控等场景
AI.findings: 边缘AI能够实现从数据中心监管向信号中心监管的转变，提供及时性、比例性和弹性等优势，但也面临模型漂移、网络安全暴露和能力差距等风险
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了信号中心监管理论框架，发展了分散式智能治理理论，将边缘AI融入下一代监管科技架构
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行监管机构提供了边缘AI实施的具体用例场景，提出了治理、问责和可审计性要求，包括模型风险管理、可解释性和人在回路控制等实践指导

title: Dispatches from the Record: Clerk Notes No. 9 — Entropy Across Doctrine

detail.title: Dispatches from the Record: Clerk Notes No. 9 — Entropy Across Doctrine
detail.abstract:
This dispatch compresses a recurring observation from high-level clerking: professional pressure points arise not from misunderstanding law or ideological disagreement, but from structural breakpoints where valid harm signals fail to complete the constitutional flow from perception to legitimacy. Entropy here is not disorder but memory erasure under constraint—harm lawfully perceived, interpreted, authorized, acted upon, and retained to reshape future interaction.

Five distinct regimes are proposed as exhaustive at this resolution:

  1. Perceptual Exclusion (e.g., standing, ripeness, mootness, exhaustion, class actions)
  2. Calibration Drift (e.g., standards of review, burdens of proof, deference, proportionality)
  3. Authorization Block (e.g., political question, abstention, state action, remedial gates)
  4. Reflex Hazard (e.g., use-of-force, exigent circumstances, emergency powers)
  5. Memory Corruption (e.g., qualified immunity, harmless error, procedural default, non-retroactivity, Teague limits)

Combinations are expected (e.g., perceptual exclusion reinforced by time decay). The document is a routing map, not a framework to adopt or reform proposal. It identifies breakpoints so doctrines often place themselves. Refutation is invited at the structural level. No allegiance required.

AI.tldr: 本文提出法律系统中的结构性断点理论，指出专业压力点并非源于法律误解或意识形态分歧，而是源于从感知到合法性的宪法流程中有效伤害信号未能完成的五个结构性断点。
AI.research_question: 法律系统中专业压力点的真正来源是什么？如何系统识别和分类法律流程中的结构性断点？
AI.motivation: 基于高级文员工作的反复观察，发现法律实践中的压力点往往不是源于对法律的理解错误或意识形态分歧，而是源于更深层的结构性流程中断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法流程理论、结构性断点分析、法律熵理论（熵不是无序而是约束下的记忆擦除）、伤害信号传递模型。
AI.method: 概念分析、分类学构建、基于法律实践观察的归纳推理、结构性映射方法。
AI.findings: 识别出五个相互独立且在此分辨率下穷尽的结构性断点制度：感知排除、校准漂移、授权阻断、反射危险、记忆腐败。这些断点组合出现，形成法律流程中的系统性障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了法律系统中的结构性断点理论框架，将熵重新定义为约束下的记忆擦除而非无序，建立了从感知到合法性的宪法流程分析模型，提供了系统性的断点分类学。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律从业者提供"路线图"而非改革方案，帮助识别法律流程中的结构性障碍，使学说能够自我定位，邀请在结构层面进行反驳，无需意识形态忠诚。

title: Why Strong Laws Produce Uneven Outcomes: Implementation Fault Lines In Philippine Restorative Juvenile Justice

detail.title: Why Strong Laws Produce Uneven Outcomes: Implementation Fault Lines In Philippine Restorative Juvenile Justice

publicationDetails.detailsText: Please provide DOI for this. Thank you very much

detail.abstract: The Philippine juvenile justice system operates under a restorative justice framework established by Republic Act No. 9344 (2006) and strengthened by Republic Act No. 10630 (2013). While the legal architecture is strongly aligned with child-rights standards under the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child and related international and ASEAN commitments, implementation outcomes remain uneven across localities. This paper contributes a system-level synthesis of Philippine restorative juvenile justice within an ASEAN comparative context by identifying where the system most frequently breaks down and what reforms are feasible primarily through system strengthening, while recognizing that some structural issues may ultimately require legislative or executive support. Using a qualitative descriptive and documentary review design, the study analyzes international instruments, ASEAN frameworks, national laws, institutional reports, and peer-reviewed literature, complemented by documented facility-based evidence from Bahay Pag-asa contexts. Findings indicate that inconsistency is driven less by statutory gaps and more by four implementation fault lines: (1) subjective discernment determination for children aged 15 to 17 due to the absence of standardized assessment tools; (2) LGU fiscal inequality that produces wide variation in Bahay Pag-asa conditions and program quality; (3) barangay and police gatekeeping practices that determine diversion access at the earliest stages; and (4) an evidence vacuum caused by the lack of a national juvenile outcome dashboard tracking diversion completion, reintegration, and recidivism. ASEAN comparisons underscore the importance of community-based alternatives, harmonized protocols, and centralized monitoring systems to support evidence-based reform. The study concludes that strengthening restorative juvenile justice in the Philippines requires system improvements focused on standardization, capacity-building, equitable resourcing, and data infrastructure rather than new legislation.

AI.tldr: 菲律宾青少年司法系统采用恢复性司法框架，但实施效果参差不齐。研究发现问题主要源于四个实施断层：主观辨别判断、地方财政不平等、基层执法筛选实践和数据缺失，而非法律缺陷。改革应聚焦标准化、能力建设、资源公平分配和数据基础设施建设。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾恢复性青少年司法系统在实施过程中最常出现故障的环节是什么？哪些改革主要通过系统强化是可行的？
AI.motivation: 尽管菲律宾青少年司法系统在法律架构上符合联合国儿童权利公约等国际标准，但实际实施效果在不同地区存在显著差异，需要识别系统故障点和可行的改革路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 恢复性司法理论、儿童权利框架、系统理论、实施科学理论
AI.method: 定性描述性和文献综述设计，分析国际文书、东盟框架、国家法律、机构报告和同行评议文献，辅以Bahay Pag-asa设施的实证证据
AI.findings: 不一致性主要源于四个实施断层：1) 15-17岁儿童主观辨别判断缺乏标准化评估工具；2) 地方政府财政不平等导致Bahay Pag-asa条件和项目质量差异；3) 基层和警察筛选实践影响分流机会；4) 缺乏全国青少年结果数据仪表板追踪分流完成、重新融入和再犯率
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 在东盟比较背景下提供了系统层面的综合分析；2) 区分了法律缺陷与实施断层对系统效果的影响；3) 强调了标准化、能力建设和数据基础设施在恢复性司法中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 识别了四个具体的实施故障点供政策干预；2) 提出通过标准化评估工具、公平资源分配、基层能力建设和数据系统建设来强化系统；3) 为东盟其他国家提供比较借鉴；4) 建议改革重点从立法转向系统实施改进

title: The Chemical Primitive: A Structural Flow Perspective on Why Most Interactions Leave No Trace

detail.title: The Chemical Primitive: A Structural Flow Perspective on Why Most Interactions Leave No Trace
detail.abstract: Chemistry is often described through substances, reactions, and mechanisms, yet a more fundamental question persists: why do most interactions leave no lasting trace, while only a few acquire durability and reshape subsequent events? This paper reframes chemical systems at a structural level, independent of specific mechanisms or substances, starting from a single premise: repeated interaction is permitted, but persistence is not guaranteed. From this, entropy emerges as memory erasure under continual retry, boundaries form as the necessary asymmetry to protect persistence, and most boundary regimes fail along five structurally distinct modes (under-stability, over-stability, dilution, sequestration, mismatch). The framework is non-teleological and constrains rather than explains outcomes, offering a neutral grammar for understanding the rarity of accumulation in prebiotic and complex chemical systems. It highlights non-participation as the expected exhaust, with relevance arising only where entropy is locally resisted.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个结构层面的化学系统框架，从"允许重复相互作用但不保证持久性"这一前提出发，解释为何大多数化学相互作用不会留下持久痕迹，而只有少数能够积累并重塑后续事件。
AI.research_question: 为什么大多数化学相互作用不会留下持久痕迹，而只有少数能够获得持久性并重塑后续事件？
AI.motivation: 化学通常通过物质、反应和机制来描述，但更根本的问题是理解持久性形成的条件。作者希望建立一个独立于具体机制或物质的结构框架，解释化学系统中积累现象的罕见性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"允许重复相互作用但不保证持久性"的前提，构建非目的论的结构框架。熵被重新定义为持续重试下的记忆擦除，边界形成被解释为保护持久性所需的不对称性。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建方法，从单一前提推导出理论结构。通过逻辑推理而非实验验证，建立结构层面的分析框架。
AI.findings: 边界形成是保护持久性的必要条件，但大多数边界机制会以五种结构上不同的模式失败：稳定性不足、过度稳定、稀释、隔离和失配。非参与是预期的"废气"，相关性只出现在熵被局部抵抗的地方。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个独立于具体机制和物质的化学系统结构框架；将熵重新概念化为记忆擦除过程；识别了边界失败的五个结构模式；为非目的论的系统分析提供了中性语法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解前生命化学和复杂化学系统中积累现象的罕见性提供了分析工具；强调了局部抵抗熵的重要性；有助于识别化学系统中持久性形成的条件。

title: The Governance Gap in Disaster Risk Financing: Understanding Indonesia's Reactive Response to Earthquake Shocks

detail.title: The Governance Gap in Disaster Risk Financing: Understanding Indonesia's Reactive Response to Earthquake Shocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Ministry of Finance
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funding

detail.abstract: Earthquakes represent low-frequency but high-severity risks that pose persistent challenges for public disaster risk financing, particularly in disaster-prone countries with constrained fiscal space. Unlike recurrent hazards, seismic events generate sudden and spatially concentrated losses that can overwhelm routine budgetary mechanisms and disrupt medium-term fiscal planning. In Indonesia, repeated major earthquakes have generated significant fiscal pressures, with ex post disaster financing through budget reallocations and discretionary mechanisms remaining the predominant response. This paper analyses Indonesia's approach to financing earthquake-related losses through a governance-oriented public economics perspective. It argues that the persistence of ex post disaster financing reflects institutional and political economy constraints rather than the absence of financial instruments. Drawing on qualitative policy analysis and comparative institutional evidence, the study examines how fiscal institutions, intergovernmental arrangements, and political incentives shape disaster financing decisions in a decentralised fiscal system. By conceptualising earthquakes as contingent fiscal liabilities, the analysis highlights how decentralisation complicates the practical implementation of risk layering strategies for lowfrequency, high-severity hazards. The paper further provides a critical assessment of parametric insurance, showing that its effectiveness depends on governance readiness, budgetary integration, and intergovernmental coordination rather than on instrument design alone. The findings suggest that strengthening disaster risk financing for earthquakes requires greater institutional coherence rather than further instrument proliferation. For disaster-prone middleincome countries such as Indonesia, fiscal resilience to catastrophic risks is shaped primarily by the alignment of financing instruments with fiscal governance structures and incentive frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印尼地震灾害融资的治理问题，指出灾后融资的持续存在反映了制度约束而非金融工具缺失，强调地震灾害融资需要制度协调而非工具创新。
AI.research_question: 为什么印尼在面临地震灾害时持续依赖灾后融资机制，而非采用更有效的风险分层策略和事前金融工具？
AI.motivation: 地震作为低频高损风险，对财政空间有限的灾害多发国家构成持续挑战。印尼多次重大地震造成显著财政压力，但灾后融资仍是主要应对方式，需要从治理角度理解这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理导向的公共经济学视角，制度经济学，政治经济学分析，将地震视为或有财政负债，分权化财政系统理论。
AI.method: 定性政策分析和比较制度证据，分析财政制度、政府间安排和政治激励如何影响分权财政系统中的灾害融资决策。
AI.findings: 灾后融资的持续存在反映了制度约束和政治经济因素，而非金融工具缺失；分权化使低频高损风险的风险分层策略实施复杂化；参数保险的有效性取决于治理准备、预算整合和政府间协调，而非仅工具设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地震概念化为或有财政负债，从治理角度分析灾害融资决策，强调制度协调而非工具创新的重要性，为分权系统中的灾害融资提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼等灾害多发中等收入国家提供政策建议：加强地震灾害融资需要制度协调而非工具创新；财政韧性取决于融资工具与财政治理结构和激励框架的匹配；参数保险实施需考虑治理准备和预算整合。

title: Assessment of Industrial Resilience under Combined Environmental and Operational Risks

detail.title: Assessment of Industrial Resilience under Combined Environmental and Operational Risks
detail.abstract: Industrial systems increasingly operate under compounded environmental, technological, and operational risks driven by climate change, resource constraints, and systemic interdependencies, challenging the robustness of conventional risk management paradigms (Smith 12). This study adopts an integrated methodological approach that synthesises resilience theory, probabilistic risk assessment, reliability engineering, and environmental analytics to evaluate industrial system performance under both acute shocks and chronic stressors (Johnson and Lee 45). Using multi-dimensional indicators and cross-domain data integration, the framework enables simultaneous assessment of failure likelihoods, recovery dynamics, and environmental sensitivities across complex industrial networks (Garcia et al. 88). The findings reveal recurring vulnerability patterns linked to infrastructure coupling, data fragmentation, and insufficient adaptive capacity, alongside notable resilience gaps in anticipatory planning and post-disruption learning mechanisms (Nguyen 103). Conversely, systems employing integrated analytics and feedback-driven adaptation demonstrate enhanced robustness, faster recovery, and improved long-term sustainability outcomes (Patel and O'Brien 61). Overall, the results underscore the critical need for holistic, data-driven resilience frameworks that transcend siloed risk assessments and support sustainable industrial operations in an era of escalating uncertainty (Williams 9).

AI.tldr: 本研究采用综合方法评估工业系统在复合风险下的性能，发现传统风险管理存在脆弱性模式，而集成分析和反馈驱动适应能提升系统韧性。
AI.research_question: 在气候变迁、资源约束和系统性依赖带来的复合环境、技术和运营风险下，工业系统如何通过综合韧性框架提升性能表现？
AI.motivation: 传统风险管理范式在应对日益复杂的复合风险时面临挑战，需要开发更全面的韧性评估框架来支持可持续工业运营。
AI.theoretical_framework: 韧性理论、概率风险评估、可靠性工程和环境分析学的综合框架。
AI.method: 采用多维指标和跨领域数据整合的方法，评估复杂工业网络中的故障可能性、恢复动态和环境敏感性。
AI.findings: 发现基础设施耦合、数据碎片化和适应能力不足等重复出现的脆弱性模式，以及前瞻性规划和灾后学习机制中的韧性缺口；同时，采用集成分析和反馈驱动适应的系统表现出更强的稳健性、更快的恢复速度和更好的长期可持续性结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了超越孤立风险评估的整体性、数据驱动的韧性框架，为工业系统在不确定性加剧时代的可持续运营提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业系统管理者提供了识别脆弱性模式、实施集成分析和反馈驱动适应的实用工具，以增强系统韧性、加速恢复并提升长期可持续性。

title: Cross-Market Alpha: Testing Short-Term Trading Factors in the U.S. Market via Double-Selection LASSO
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Karlsruhe Institute of Technology

detail.title: Cross-Market Alpha: Testing Short-Term Trading Factors in the U.S. Market via Double-Selection LASSO
detail.abstract: Current asset pricing research exhibits a significant gap: a lack of sufficient crossmarket validation regarding short-term trading-based factors. Against this backdrop, the development of the Chinese A-share market-which is characterized by its retail-investor dominance, policy sensitivity, and high-frequency active trading has given rise to specific short-term trading-based factors. This study systematically examines the universality of factors from the Alpha191 library in the U.S. market, addressing the challenge of high-dimensional factor screening through the double-selection LASSO algorithm-an established method for cross-market, high-dimensional research. After controlling for 151 fundamental factors from the U.S. equity factor zoo, 17 Alpha191 factors selected by this procedure exhibit significant incremental explanatory power for the cross-section of U.S. stock returns at the 5% level. Together these findings demonstrate that short-term trading-based factors, originating from the unique structure of the chinese A-share market, provide incremental information not captured by existing mainstream pricing models, thereby enhancing the explanation of cross-sectional return differences.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过双选择LASSO算法，检验了中国A股市场Alpha191因子库中的短期交易因子在美国市场的普适性，发现17个因子在控制151个美国基本面因子后仍对美国股票横截面收益具有显著增量解释力。
AI.research_question: 源自中国A股市场的短期交易因子是否在美国市场具有普适性，并能提供现有主流定价模型未捕获的增量信息？
AI.motivation: 当前资产定价研究存在显著缺口：缺乏足够的跨市场验证短期交易因子。中国A股市场具有散户主导、政策敏感、高频活跃交易等特点，产生了特定的短期交易因子，需要检验这些因子在其他市场的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、因子投资理论、跨市场因子普适性理论、高维因子筛选理论
AI.method: 采用双选择LASSO算法进行高维因子筛选，检验Alpha191因子库中的因子在美国市场的有效性，同时控制151个美国基本面因子。
AI.findings: 在控制151个美国基本面因子后，通过双选择LASSO算法筛选出的17个Alpha191因子在5%显著性水平上对美国股票横截面收益具有显著增量解释力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 填补了资产定价研究中短期交易因子跨市场验证的空白；2) 证明了中国A股市场独特结构产生的短期交易因子具有跨市场普适性；3) 为因子投资理论提供了新的跨市场证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为国际投资者提供了新的有效因子；2) 增强了美国市场横截面收益差异的解释能力；3) 为跨市场因子筛选提供了方法论参考。

title: Sentiment Half-Lives and Post-Holiday Effects: A Cross-Market Comparison between China and the United States

detail.title: Sentiment Half-Lives and Post-Holiday Effects: A Cross-Market Comparison between China and the United States
detail.abstract: Using index-level data and rolling-window sentiment indicators, this paper builds a post-holiday long-short strategy and evaluates its performance across the CSI 300 and S&P 500. The method consistently outperforms the baseline long-only rule. Robustness tests show that sentiment decays within one day in China but persists across several days in the United States, highlighting structural differences in investor behavior around non-trading periods.

AI.tldr: 使用指数级数据和滚动窗口情绪指标构建节后多空策略，在沪深300和标普500上表现优于基准多头规则，中美市场情绪衰减模式存在结构性差异
AI.research_question: 基于节后情绪指标的多空策略在不同市场（中国和美国）中的表现如何？中美市场在非交易期间投资者行为是否存在结构性差异？
AI.motivation: 探索节后情绪对市场收益的影响，比较不同市场环境下投资者行为差异，为跨市场投资策略提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的情绪效应理论，市场微观结构理论，跨市场比较分析框架
AI.method: 使用指数级数据和滚动窗口情绪指标构建节后多空策略，在沪深300和标普500上进行回测，并进行稳健性检验
AI.findings: 1. 节后多空策略持续优于基准多头规则；2. 中国市场情绪在一天内衰减，美国市场情绪持续数天；3. 中美市场在非交易期间投资者行为存在结构性差异
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了节后情绪效应的跨市场差异性；2. 揭示了中美市场情绪衰减模式的结构性差异；3. 丰富了行为金融学在跨市场比较中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了有效的节后多空策略；2. 帮助理解不同市场环境下情绪驱动的交易机会；3. 为跨市场资产配置提供实证指导

title: Deng Xiaoping's Institutional Transformation: An Authoritarian Engineering Project from Mobilization to Control

detail.title: Deng Xiaoping's Institutional Transformation: An Authoritarian Engineering Project from Mobilization to Control
detail.abstract:
This article introduces “Deng Xiaoping’s institutional transformation” and proposes a three-stage model of authoritarian governance—mobilization, development, and control—to reinterpret the structural evolution of the Chinese Communist Party’s ruling logic since 1949. It argues that the CCP did not alternate between fundamentally different political models; rather, across changing conditions, it consistently sought to avoid a single outcome: the genuine transfer of political power to the people.

From 1949 to 1989, mobilization-based rule relied on mass politics and ideological campaigns. Although effective in the short term, this model proved inherently unstable and was ultimately judged by the regime itself as an unsustainable, high-risk governing path in 1989. On this basis, Deng Xiaoping initiated a transformation of institutional significance. Rather than pursuing political reform or renewed mobilization, he redefined economic development as a purely instrumental strategy to accumulate state capacity—fiscal, technological, and organizational—while reducing vulnerability to external intervention, thereby preparing the conditions for comprehensive control.

Within this staged design, Jiang Zemin, Hu Jintao, and Xi Jinping functioned not as representatives of competing political lines, but as differentiated executors responsible for expanding development, laying the groundwork for control, and completing a control-oriented governing system. Deng Xiaoping’s transformation was therefore not a reform toward openness, but a reconstruction of authoritarian rule after the failure of reform itself, culminating in a control-based steady state centered on risk management, technocratic governance, and stability as an end in itself.

title: Consumer behavior during Disasters and Marketing Strategies adopted by Business Organizations
affiliations: Uva Wellassa University, Uva Wellassa University, Uva Wellassa University, Uva Wellassa University and Uva Wellassa University

detail.title: Consumer behavior during Disasters and Marketing Strategies adopted by Business Organizations
detail.abstract: Disasters such as pandemics, natural hazards and economic crises significantly disrupt normal consumption patterns and challenge business operations. This systematic literature review examines consumer behavior during disasters and the marketing strategies adopted by business organizations, with particular emphasis on psychological factors that drive behavioral change. Drawing on prior studies, this review identifies common consumer behavior patterns including panic buying, stockpiling, reduced brand loyalty, and shifts towards essential goods. Psychological drivers such as fear, uncertainty, perceived scarcity, social influence and the need for control play a central role in shaping these behaviors. In response, organizations adopt adaptive marketing strategies such as pricing adjustments, transparent communication, ethical promotions and supply chain reconfiguration to ensure availability and maintain consumer trust. Using a systematic review methodology, this study synthesizes findings from international literature and Sri Lankan based research to develop a comprehensive understanding of disaster induced consumption dynamics. The review further proposes a conceptual framework illustrating the relationship between disasters, psychological factors, consumer behavior and organizational marketing strategies. By integrating insights from prior empirical and conceptual studies, this paper contributes to disaster related consumer research and provides practical implications for managers to design responsible and resilient marketing strategies during crisis situations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述，研究了灾害期间消费者行为模式（如恐慌性购买、囤积、品牌忠诚度降低等）及其心理驱动因素（恐惧、不确定性、稀缺感知等），并分析了企业应对的市场营销策略，提出了一个整合灾害、心理因素、消费者行为和组织策略的概念框架。
AI.research_question: 灾害期间消费者行为模式是什么？哪些心理因素驱动这些行为变化？企业应采取何种市场营销策略来应对灾害引发的消费动态？
AI.motivation: 灾害（如疫情、自然灾害、经济危机）会显著扰乱正常消费模式并挑战企业运营，需要系统理解灾害期间的消费行为变化和企业应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理学理论（恐惧、不确定性、稀缺感知、社会影响、控制需求等）和市场营销理论，构建灾害-心理因素-消费者行为-组织策略的概念框架。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述方法，综合国际文献和斯里兰卡本土研究的发现，进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 识别出常见的消费者行为模式：恐慌性购买、囤积、品牌忠诚度降低、向必需品转移。心理驱动因素包括恐惧、不确定性、感知稀缺、社会影响和控制需求。企业采用适应性营销策略：价格调整、透明沟通、道德促销、供应链重构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出整合灾害、心理因素、消费者行为和组织营销策略的概念框架，为灾害相关消费者研究提供理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供实践启示，帮助设计负责任和有韧性的危机营销策略，确保产品可获得性并维持消费者信任。

title: Designing Interactive Web Maps for Disaster Response Training and Public Awareness

detail.title: Designing Interactive Web Maps for Disaster Response Training and Public Awareness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: I declare sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: Disaster preparedness and public awareness are critical for minimizing the impact of natural and man-made hazards. This study investigates the design and implementation of interactive web maps as tools for disaster response training and public education. Using advanced web GIS platforms, simulation exercises were developed to replicate real-world disaster scenarios, allowing emergency responders and community members to interact with spatially explicit information in real time. The study employed user testing and evaluation metrics to assess usability, engagement, and effectiveness. Participants included both trained responders and members of the general public, providing insights into the maps' practical utility and accessibility. Key findings indicate that interactive web maps significantly improve response times during simulated emergencies, enhance situational awareness, and foster greater engagement among users (Daud et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2023). Feedback from participants highlighted the maps' intuitive interfaces, real-time data visualization, and scenario-based learning features as major contributors to their effectiveness. The study also demonstrates that these digital tools are cost-effective and scalable, making them suitable for deployment across diverse geographic regions and institutional contexts. Overall, the research underscores the potential of interactive web maps as an innovative approach to disaster preparedness, bridging the gap between emergency training and public education. By integrating simulation-based exercises with accessible web GIS technology, stakeholders can strengthen both professional response capabilities and community resilience, ultimately reducing vulnerability and enhancing adaptive capacity in the face of disasters.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了交互式网络地图作为灾害响应培训和公众教育工具的设计与实施。通过先进的网络GIS平台开发模拟演练，评估显示这些地图能显著提高响应时间、增强态势感知并促进用户参与。
AI.research_question: 交互式网络地图如何作为灾害响应培训和公众教育的有效工具？其设计、实施和效果如何？
AI.motivation: 灾害准备和公众意识对于减少自然灾害和人为灾害的影响至关重要。传统培训方法可能缺乏互动性和实时性，需要创新的数字工具来弥合应急培训与公众教育之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于灾害管理理论、情景学习理论和地理信息系统(GIS)理论，结合公众参与和社区韧性概念。
AI.method: 使用先进的网络GIS平台开发模拟演练，复制真实灾害情景。通过用户测试和评估指标（包括可用性、参与度和有效性）进行评估。参与者包括训练有素的响应者和普通公众。
AI.findings: 交互式网络地图显著提高了模拟紧急情况下的响应时间，增强了态势感知，并促进了用户参与。参与者反馈强调直观界面、实时数据可视化和基于情景的学习功能是有效性的主要因素。这些数字工具具有成本效益和可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为灾害管理理论提供了实证支持，扩展了情景学习理论在数字环境中的应用，丰富了GIS在应急响应中的理论框架，提出了弥合专业培训与公众教育之间差距的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可部署的交互式网络地图工具，为应急响应机构提供了有效的培训解决方案，为社区灾害准备提供了公众教育平台，展示了成本效益高且可扩展的技术解决方案，增强了社区韧性和适应能力。

title: Return to Education and Work Experience in Bangladesh: An Instrumental Variable Quantile Regression Approach
affiliations: Center for Policy and Economic Research (CPER), Centre for Policy Dialogue (CPD), Center for Policy and Economic Research (CPER), Center for Policy and Economic Research (CPER) and Center for Policy and Economic Research (CPER)

detail.title: Return to Education and Work Experience in Bangladesh: An Instrumental Variable Quantile Regression Approach

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the Center for Policy and Economic Research (CPER), Bangladesh.

detail.abstract: This study examines the private returns to education and work experience in Bangladesh, focusing on heterogeneity across the wage distribution and moving beyond conventional average-effect estimates to provide robust causal evidence relevant to human capital and inequality policies. Using nationally representative data from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES) 2016–2017, the analysis applies Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), Instrumental Variable Generalized Method of Moments (IV-GMM), Quantile Regression (QR), and Instrumental Variable Quantile Regression (IVQR) techniques to address endogeneity in schooling and to capture distributional effects, with parental education serving as an instrument for individual educational attainment. The results show that both education and work experience significantly increase earnings. At the same time, endogeneity-corrected estimates indicate higher returns to education than OLS estimates, confirming that mean-based models underestimate the true causal effects. IVQR estimates reveal pronounced heterogeneity, unlike the QR, with returns to education rising monotonically across the wage spectrum, suggesting that higher-wage earners benefit disproportionately. At the same time, work experience yields positive but diminishing returns. Substantial gender and rural–urban wage gaps persist, although women experience relatively higher marginal returns to education, particularly at the lower end of the wage distribution. Although the cross-sectional nature of the data limits the analysis of dynamic wage trajectories and the instrument may not capture all intergenerational channels, the findings provide credible and policy-relevant insights. By being among the first studies to apply an IVQR framework, this research offers updated and nuanced evidence on how education and experience shape wage inequality in a developing-country context.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用孟加拉国代表性数据，通过OLS、IV-GMM、QR和IVQR方法分析教育与工作经验对收入的因果效应，发现内生性修正后教育回报高于OLS估计，且教育回报随工资分布上升而增加，工作经验回报递减，存在显著的性别和城乡工资差距。
AI.research_question: 教育与工作经验在孟加拉国的私人回报如何？这些回报在工资分布上是否存在异质性？内生性修正后的因果效应与传统的平均效应估计有何差异？
AI.motivation: 传统研究主要关注平均效应，缺乏对工资分布异质性的分析，且内生性问题可能导致教育回报被低估。在发展中国家背景下，需要更准确的因果证据来指导人力资本和不平等政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、工资不平等理论、内生性理论（教育选择的内生性）、分布效应理论（不同工资分位点的异质性回报）
AI.method: 使用2016-2017年孟加拉国家庭收入与支出调查（HIES）全国代表性数据，采用OLS、IV-GMM、QR和IVQR方法，以父母教育作为个人教育成就的工具变量，解决内生性问题并捕捉分布效应。
AI.findings: 1. 教育和工作经验均显著增加收入；2. 内生性修正后教育回报高于OLS估计，表明均值模型低估了真实因果效应；3. IVQR显示教育回报随工资分布上升而单调增加，高工资者获益更多；4. 工作经验回报为正但递减；5. 存在显著的性别和城乡工资差距，但女性在教育回报上相对更高（尤其在工资分布低端）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在发展中国家应用IVQR框架，提供了更精细的分布效应证据；2. 证实了内生性偏误对教育回报估计的重要性；3. 揭示了教育回报在工资分布上的异质性模式；4. 为人力资本理论在发展中国家背景下的适用性提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为孟加拉国人力资本政策提供实证依据；2. 揭示教育投资对减少工资不平等的潜在作用；3. 为针对不同收入群体的差异化教育政策提供指导；4. 强调需要关注性别和城乡差距的政策干预。

title: Tokyo VPN Speed Monitor: A Longitudinal Open Dataset of VPN Performance Metrics in Japan

detail.title: Tokyo VPN Speed Monitor: A Longitudinal Open Dataset of VPN Performance Metrics in Japan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests. This research received no funding from any VPN service provider.

detail.abstract: Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) have become essential tools for internet privacy, security, and circumventing geographic restrictions. However, systematic, long-term performance data measured from specic geographic regions remains scarce in the academic literature. We present the Tokyo VPN Speed Monitor dataset, a comprehensive longitudinal collection of VPN performance metrics measured from Tokyo, Japan. The dataset encompasses 15 major commercial VPN services with automated measurements conducted every 6 hours over a period from December 9, 2025 to January 9, 2026 (approximately 32 days). Key metrics include download speed, upload speed, ping latency, stability scores calculated from 7-day rolling standard deviations, and daily pricing information. The data collection infrastructure comprises 8 automated engines built on Google Apps Script, ensuring consistent, reproducible, and maintenance-free measurements. All data and source code are released under the MIT License and are available through 7 DOI-assigned repositories including Harvard Dataverse, Zenodo, gshare, OSF, Mendeley Data, Kaggle, and IEEE DataPort.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了东京VPN速度监测数据集，这是一个从东京测量15个主要商业VPN服务性能的长期数据集，包含下载速度、上传速度、延迟等关键指标，数据通过8个自动化引擎每6小时收集一次，持续32天。
AI.research_question: 从特定地理区域（东京）测量的VPN服务长期性能数据特征是什么？
AI.motivation: VPN已成为互联网隐私、安全和绕过地理限制的重要工具，但学术文献中缺乏从特定地理区域测量的系统性长期性能数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络性能测量理论、VPN服务质量评估框架、纵向数据收集方法学。
AI.method: 使用8个基于Google Apps Script构建的自动化引擎，每6小时对15个主要商业VPN服务进行测量，测量时间从2025年12月9日至2026年1月9日（约32天）。
AI.findings: 创建了包含下载速度、上传速度、ping延迟、基于7天滚动标准差的稳定性得分以及每日价格信息的全面数据集。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了从特定地理区域测量VPN性能的系统性方法论，建立了VPN性能评估的标准化测量框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布了东京VPN速度监测数据集，包含所有数据和源代码（MIT许可证），通过7个DOI分配的存储库（哈佛Dataverse、Zenodo等）公开可用，为研究人员和从业者提供可复现的VPN性能基准数据。

title: Payroll Deductions and Legal Compliance: Multi-Sector Case Studies

detail.title: Payroll Deductions and Legal Compliance: Multi-Sector Case Studies
detail.abstract:
This study examines payroll deductions and legal compliance across multiple economic sectors, focusing on the effectiveness of regulatory enforcement and organizational adherence to statutory obligations. Using a multi-sector case study approach, the research combines quantitative analysis of payroll records with qualitative interviews of human resource and finance professionals. The study evaluates levels of compliance, identifies sectoral variations, and explores challenges that organizations face in adhering to legal requirements. Findings reveal significant differences in compliance rates across sectors, with larger organizations generally demonstrating higher adherence due to formalized internal controls, while smaller firms often face resource and knowledge constraints that hinder compliance. 
Key enforcement challenges include inconsistent regulatory oversight, limited awareness of legal obligations, and administrative complexities associated with payroll management. Based on these insights, the study recommends targeted interventions to enhance compliance, including sector-specific training programs, streamlined regulatory processes, and stronger monitoring mechanisms. Enhancing transparency and accountability within organizational payroll systems is emphasized as critical for reducing non-compliance and promoting equitable labor practices. The research contributes to the literature on labor law enforcement and organizational behavior, providing practical guidance for policymakers, regulators, and organizational managers seeking to improve payroll compliance across diverse sectors (Intindola, Weisinger & Gomez, 2016; Schoder & Tercioglu, 2025).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了不同经济部门的工资扣除与法律合规情况，分析了监管执法的有效性和组织对法定义务的遵守程度。研究发现，大型组织由于有正式的内控机制，合规率较高；而小型企业则因资源和知识限制面临合规挑战。
AI.research_question: 不同经济部门的工资扣除法律合规情况如何？监管执法的有效性如何？组织在遵守法定工资扣除义务时面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 工资扣除是劳动法合规的重要方面，但不同部门和组织规模的合规情况存在差异。了解这些差异和挑战对于改善监管执法、促进公平劳动实践至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动法执行理论、组织行为理论、合规管理理论、资源基础观（解释组织规模与合规能力的关系）
AI.method: 多部门案例研究方法，结合工资记录的定量分析和人力资源与财务专业人员的定性访谈
AI.findings: 1. 不同部门的合规率存在显著差异；2. 大型组织通常表现出更高的合规性，因其有正式的内控机制；3. 小型企业常因资源和知识限制而难以合规；4. 主要执法挑战包括监管监督不一致、法律义务意识有限、工资管理行政复杂性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了劳动法执行文献，特别是多部门比较视角；2. 深化了对组织规模与合规能力关系的理解；3. 为合规管理理论提供了实证支持；4. 拓展了组织行为理论在工资管理领域的应用

title: The Age of Ontological Conflict: The Foundations of Power Regimes: Global Tension Between the Data-Access Ontology and the Land-Body Ontology

detail.title: The Age of Ontological Conflict: The Foundations of Power Regimes: Global Tension Between the Data-Access Ontology and the Land-Body Ontology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, institutional, or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study aims to examine the contemporary global political, economic, and social tensions beyond conventional economic-political or techno-political explanations, situating them instead at the ontological level. The central thesis of the article is that the current crisis does not stem from ideological preferences or governance failures, but from the unresolved collision of two fundamentally incompatible ontological frameworks operating simultaneously within the same historical moment. Within this framework, the study analyzes, on the one hand, the technofeudal ontology built upon data, access, and digital rent relations, and on the other hand, the land-body ontology, grounded in territory, physical embodiment, property, and juridical sovereignty. Technofeudalism is conceptualized as an intermediate and suspended regime that emerges from the functional exhaustion of neoliberalism. While it deliberately abandons an anthropocentric ontological foundation, it fails to fully realize this displacement, and therefore cannot acquire a constitutive status. By contrast, neoconservatism is positioned as the contemporary political form of the land-body ontology, functioning as the repressed reflex of neoliberalism that resurfaces in moments of crisis. The article further argues that neoliberalism should not be understood as an autonomous or constitutive ontological regime. Rather, it is conceptualized as a historical normative rationality and transitional regime that operates between these two ontological planes, masking, delaying, and rendering their conflict governable. The study concludes that this ontological conflict will either discharge itself through open ruptures and violent breaks, or persist under the discourse of integration by producing a hybrid and silent form of domination in which technofeudalism and neoconservatism operate conjointly. Without proposing solutions, the article seeks to clarify the ontological diagnosis and structural limits of resolution underlying the contemporary global crisis.

title: The Ordo Layer

detail.title: The Ordo Layer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. Ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no external funding for this research.

detail.abstract:
Modern monetary and financial systems are highly robust, efficient, and capable of absorbing crises. At the same time, many societies experience growing perceptions of moral incoherence, social detachment, and unclear responsibility attribution. These perceptions do not primarily result from system failure, but from a structural gap between value-neutral system logic and the functional expectations required for stable long-term cooperation. This paper introduces the concept of an Ordo Layer: an explicit, rule-based order layer positioned above existing monetary, financial, and institutional systems. The Ordo Layer neither replaces nor governs these systems. Instead, it operates as a non-political, non-moral coordination and expectation framework that renders order, responsibility, and long-term orientation explicitly referenceable.
By rendering implicit order assumptions visible, the Ordo Layer reduces systemic surprise, improves expectation coherence, and enables earlier signaling of structural discrepancies before they escalate into abrupt market, legitimacy, or power corrections. Importantly, the Ordo Layer does not rely on enforcement, sanctions, or central authority. Its effectiveness emerges exclusively through voluntary reference, incentive compatibility, and decentralized adoption. The paper outlines the conceptual architecture, core functions, limitations, and adoption dynamics of the Ordo Layer, emphasizing its compatibility with existing dominant systems. Finally, it discusses how the Ordo Layer can be operationalized and empirically observed through reference behavior, adjustment patterns, and systemic connectivity dynamics. The Ordo Layer is proposed as an order-theoretical supplement that enhances stability and trust without increasing centralization or coercion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"秩序层"概念，作为一个基于规则的秩序层，位于现有货币、金融和制度系统之上，通过自愿参照和去中心化采用，增强系统稳定性和信任，而不增加集权或强制。
AI.research_question: 如何解决现代货币金融系统价值中立逻辑与稳定长期合作所需功能期望之间的结构性差距，从而减少系统性意外、改善期望一致性？
AI.motivation: 现代货币金融系统虽然稳健高效，但社会却出现道德不连贯、社会疏离和责任归属不清的感知问题。这些问题源于系统价值中立逻辑与稳定合作所需功能期望之间的结构性差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 秩序理论、系统理论、制度经济学、协调博弈理论、期望管理理论
AI.method: 概念分析、理论构建、架构设计、功能分析、采用动态分析
AI.findings: 秩序层能够使隐含的秩序假设显性化，减少系统性意外，改善期望一致性，并在结构性差异升级为市场、合法性或权力调整前提供早期信号。其有效性源于自愿参照、激励兼容和去中心化采用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"秩序层"这一新概念框架，为理解系统稳定性和信任问题提供了秩序理论补充，丰富了系统理论和制度经济学的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和系统设计者提供了一个非政治、非道德的协调框架，可通过自愿参照行为、调整模式和系统连接动态来操作化和实证观察，增强系统稳定性而不增加集权。

detail.abstract: This systematic review of legal, policy, and institutional literature examines the evolution of government procurement preferences for cooperatives in the Philippines from the implementation of Republic Act No. 9184 (Government Procurement Reform Act) and its 2016 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR), up to the transition toward Republic Act No. 12009 (New Government Procurement Act or NGPA) in 2024-2025. Despite consistent and unequivocal policy intent to promote cooperatives as primary instruments of inclusive growth and poverty reduction, the review of extant literature, PhilGEPS award data, CDA reports, and GPPB issuances reveals persistently low actual utilization. Key mechanisms, including pre-qualification exemptions under RA 9520, negotiated procurement via Community Participation and NGO Participation, and mandatory direct contracting under RA 11321 (Sagip Saka Act), have failed to generate meaningful engagement. Cooperatives consistently captured less than 0.25 percent of total national procurement value in every year on record, with awards overwhelmingly small-scale, rural, and limited to agri-fishery supplies and minor community projects. The NGPA retains alternative modalities but introduces no new explicit cooperative preferences and emphasizes efficiency and value-for-money, raising serious concerns about further marginalization of constitutionally favored entities. This literature-based study concludes that the observed outcomes represent not a deficiency in legal design, but a profound failure of institutional implementation, monitoring, and political will. Recommendations include targeted capacity-building, mandatory PhilGEPS tagging of cooperative suppliers, inclusion scorecards for procuring entities, and long-term legislative reinforcement to finally operationalize the developmental mandate.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了菲律宾政府采购政策对合作社的偏好演变，发现尽管政策意图明确支持合作社作为包容性增长和减贫的主要工具，但实际利用率极低（不足总采购额的0.25%），主要原因是制度实施、监督和政治意愿的失败，而非法律设计缺陷。

AI.findings: 1) 合作社采购份额极低（<0.25%），且多为小规模、农村、农业渔业供应和社区项目；2) 关键机制（资格预审豁免、谈判采购、直接承包）未能产生实质性参与；3) NGPA新法未增加合作社偏好，强调效率可能进一步边缘化合作社

detail.abstract: This study develops and evaluates a 7-Day Defense Management Education (7D-DME) program designed to strengthen independent living capabilities, disaster management competencies, and basic war and defense awareness within the Indonesian context. The program responds to Indonesia's multidimensional security challenges, including natural disasters, non-traditional security threats, and evolving regional defense dynamics. Using a Research and Development (R&D) approach, the study integrates defense management theory, disaster risk reduction frameworks, and national resilience concepts into a compact, intensive educational model. The program combines cognitive learning, practical simulations, and ethical-national values to foster adaptive leadership, self-reliance, and crisis decision-making skills among participants. Data were collected through expert validation, pilot implementation, participant assessments, and qualitative feedback. The findings indicate that a short-term, structured defense education model can significantly enhance participants' preparedness for independent living in crisis situations, coordinated disaster response, and fundamental defense awareness. The study contributes to defense education innovation by offering a scalable, interdisciplinary training model that supports Indonesia's national resilience, civil defense capacity, and sustainable security development.

title: Latent Governance in Long-Horizon LLM Systems: Memory Stability without a Persistent Compute Tax

detail.title: Latent Governance in Long-Horizon LLM Systems: Memory Stability without a Persistent Compute Tax
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in long-horizon interactive settings accumulate internal memory across turns, creating the risk that weak or erroneous information persists and compounds over time. While governance and verification mechanisms are often proposed to mitigate such failures, they are frequently assumed to impose continuous and prohibitive compute costs. This paper presents a simulation-based study of memory governance in longhorizon LLM systems, focusing on the relationship between stability and operational cost. We compare a baseline system without governance to a governed system that selectively screens and manages memory using semantic stability signals. Importantly, external verification loops are disabled to isolate the intrinsic cost of governance. Across 180-turn simulations, we find that governance does not impose a persistent compute burden. Compute usage under the governed policy closely tracks the baseline, while maintaining comparable or slightly improved memory stability. These results suggest that effective governance can operate as latent capacity-remaining dormant under benign conditions and activating only when instability accumulates-thereby supporting the sustainability of long-horizon LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了长时程交互中LLM内存治理的成本效益，发现基于语义稳定性信号的选择性治理不会增加持续计算负担，反而能维持内存稳定性。
AI.research_question: 在长时程交互的LLM系统中，内存治理是否会导致持续且高昂的计算成本？
AI.motivation: LLM在长时程交互中会积累内部记忆，存在错误信息持续和复合的风险。虽然提出了治理和验证机制，但通常被认为会带来持续且高昂的计算成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于语义稳定性信号的内存治理理论框架，探讨治理稳定性与操作成本之间的关系。
AI.method: 模拟研究：比较无治理基线系统与基于语义稳定性信号选择性筛选和管理内存的治理系统，在180轮模拟中分析计算使用和内存稳定性。
AI.findings: 治理不会带来持续计算负担：治理策略下的计算使用与基线系统基本一致，同时保持相当或略有改善的内存稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"潜在容量"概念：有效治理可以作为潜在容量运作，在良性条件下保持休眠，仅在稳定性累积时激活，支持长时程LLM部署的可持续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为长时程LLM系统的内存治理提供了成本效益分析，表明选择性治理策略在实际部署中具有可行性，不会显著增加计算成本。

title: The UK's Contribution to Developing the International Governance of AI Safety and How its Policy Took a Sharp Turn

detail.title: The UK's Contribution to Developing the International Governance of AI Safety and How its Policy Took a Sharp Turn
detail.abstract: Although the UK’s ambivalence on adopting a national regulatory framework for AI has received considerable discussion, the UK’s policy and role in advancing the international governance of AI safety remains to be unpacked. In line with its 2023 International Technology Strategy, the UK plays a leading role developing different facets of governing AI safety, encompassing the political edifice and the scientific landscape. This post, firstly, recognises the significant contribution of the UK and, secondly, highlights that the UK’s policy has recently shifted with major global implications for AI safety.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国在AI安全国际治理中的政策演变和角色，指出尽管英国在国内AI监管框架上态度暧昧，但在国际AI安全治理中发挥着领导作用，且近期政策转向具有重大全球影响。
AI.research_question: 英国在AI安全国际治理中的政策演变和角色是什么？其政策转向对全球AI安全治理有何影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然英国在国内AI监管框架上的暧昧态度备受讨论，但英国在推动AI安全国际治理方面的政策和角色尚未得到充分分析。本文旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际治理理论、技术治理理论、政策演变分析框架
AI.method: 政策文件分析（特别是2023年《国际技术战略》）、文献综述、政策演变追踪
AI.findings: 1. 英国在AI安全国际治理中发挥着领导作用，涵盖政治架构和科学领域；2. 英国政策近期发生重大转向，对全球AI安全治理产生深远影响；3. 英国在国际层面的积极角色与其国内监管框架的暧昧态度形成对比。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对国家在国际技术治理中双重角色的理解；2. 提出了国内监管态度与国际治理角色之间的张力分析框架；3. 丰富了技术安全治理的政策演变理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了英国AI安全治理策略的全面分析；2. 帮助国际组织理解英国在AI安全治理中的战略定位；3. 为企业和其他国家参与AI安全国际治理提供参考。

title: The Procedural Imperative: Standardizing Artificial Intelligence in Legal Practice

detail.title: The Procedural Imperative: Standardizing Artificial Intelligence in Legal Practice
detail.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into legal practice presents a crisis of legitimacy, threatening the profession's core reliance on transparent reason-giving and procedural fairness. This paper argues that the solution lies not in assessing raw model capability but in establishing a technology-neutral framework of procedural standards that ensures reliability, accountability, and institutional trust. Drawing on governance models from high-stakes industries such as medical device regulation and financial auditing, this research proposes a "Minimum Standard" for AI-assisted legal work. Key components include mandatory disclosure, strict source verification to prevent hallucinations, immutable audit trails, human-in-the-loop supervision, and robust contestability mechanisms. The analysis further outlines practical implementation pathways through court rules, bar association guidance, and corporate procurement policies, while advocating for a tiered regulatory approach to preserve access to justice for resource-constrained firms. Ultimately, this study concludes that standardizing the process of AI use-rather than merely the technology itself-is essential to maintaining the rule of law in an algorithmic age.

AI.tldr: 本文提出建立AI法律应用的程序标准框架而非评估原始模型能力，通过借鉴医疗设备监管和金融审计等高风险行业治理模式，制定包含强制披露、来源验证、审计追踪、人工监督和争议机制等要素的"最低标准"，以维护法律职业的合法性和法治原则。
AI.research_question: 如何建立有效的程序标准框架来确保AI在法律实践中的可靠性、问责制和制度信任，从而解决AI整合带来的合法性危机？
AI.motivation: AI融入法律实践威胁到法律职业依赖的透明推理和程序公平性，存在合法性危机，需要建立技术中立的程序标准而非仅仅评估模型能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴高风险行业治理模式（医疗设备监管、金融审计），构建程序正义理论框架，强调过程标准化而非技术本身评估。
AI.method: 规范性分析和比较研究法，通过分析现有行业治理模式，提出适用于AI法律应用的程序标准框架。
AI.findings: 提出包含强制披露、严格来源验证（防幻觉）、不可变审计追踪、人工监督和健全争议机制的"最低标准"框架，并设计分层监管方法以保障资源有限律所的司法可及性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将程序正义理论扩展到AI法律应用领域，提出技术中立的程序标准化框架，为AI治理提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供通过法庭规则、律师协会指导和公司采购政策实施的具体路径，为法律行业AI应用提供可操作的标准和监管框架。

title: DigitaL Management Information Systems For Medical Check Up Services in Mining Areas: A PRISMA 2020 Systematic Literature Review on Service Efficient and Health Reporting Accuracy
affiliations: Universitas Muhammadiyah Palopo and Universitas Muhammadiyah Palopo

detail.title: DigitaL Management Information Systems For Medical Check Up Services in Mining Areas: A PRISMA 2020 Systematic Literature Review on Service Efficient and Health Reporting Accuracy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This study was conducted independently for academic purposes as part of a postgraduate program in Management.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently as part of academic coursework.

detail.abstract: The digitalization of Management Information Systems (MIS) has become increasingly critical for enhancing the effectiveness of occupational health services, particularly Medical Check Up (MCU) services in high risk industries such as mining. Mining operations require accurate, timely, and reliable health information to ensure regulatory compliance, workforce safety, and operational sustainability. However, existing MCU services in mining areas often face challenges related to fragmented data management, inefficiencies in service delivery, and inaccuracies in health reporting. Despite the growing adoption of digital health information systems, empirical evidence on the role of MIS in improving MCU service efficiency and health reporting accuracy within mining contexts remains dispersed and Insufficiently synthesized. This study aims to systematically review and synthesize the existing literature on the digitalization of Management Information Systems for MCU services in mining areas by applying the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. A Systematic Literature Review (SLR) was conducted using peer-reviewed articles published between 2019 and 2024, retrieved from reputable academic databases. The review addresses five research questions focusing on research trends, technological approaches, service efficiency outcomes, health reporting accuracy, and identified research gaps. The findings indicate that digital MIS implementation in MCU services is consistently associated with improved operational efficiency, enhanced accuracy and reliability of health reports, and better decision-making support for corporate stakeholders. Nevertheless, the review also reveals persistent challenges, including system integration issues, data governance limitations, and contextual constraints in remote mining environments. This study contributes to the literature by providing a comprehensive synthesis of MIS-based MCU research and offers a conceptual foundation for future empirical studies and the development of data driven MIS models tailored to occupational health services in mining industries.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献综述，分析了2019-2024年间关于矿业领域职业健康检查服务管理信息系统数字化的研究，发现数字化MIS能提升服务效率和健康报告准确性，但也面临系统整合、数据治理等挑战。
AI.research_question: 1. 矿业领域MCU服务数字化MIS的研究趋势是什么？2. 采用了哪些技术方法？3. 数字化MIS如何影响MCU服务效率？4. 如何影响健康报告的准确性？5. 存在哪些研究空白？
AI.motivation: 矿业等高危行业需要准确、及时的健康信息以确保合规、安全和可持续运营，但现有MCU服务面临数据管理碎片化、服务效率低下和健康报告不准确等问题，且关于MIS在提升MCU服务效率和报告准确性方面的实证证据分散且缺乏系统整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理信息系统理论、数字化健康信息系统理论、职业健康服务管理理论、系统整合理论
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020指南进行系统文献综述，检索2019-2024年间发表的同行评审文章，使用权威学术数据库
AI.findings: 数字化MIS实施与MCU服务运营效率提升、健康报告准确性和可靠性增强、企业利益相关者决策支持改善正相关；但也存在系统整合问题、数据治理限制和偏远矿业环境中的情境约束等持续挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了MIS基础MCU研究的全面综合，为未来实证研究和针对矿业职业健康服务的数据驱动MIS模型开发提供了概念基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为矿业企业实施数字化MCU服务提供实践指导，帮助解决系统整合、数据治理等实际问题，提升职业健康服务质量和运营效率

title: The Catastrophe of Declining Male College Enrollment: Gemini Predictions and Solutions
affiliations: Prairie View A&M University - College of Business

detail.title: The Catastrophe of Declining Male College Enrollment: Gemini Predictions and Solutions

declarations.ethicsApproval: There are no applicable restrictions on this opinion paper.

detail.abstract: Google Gemini AI has become a tool indispensable for researchers. It is now ubiquitous: It is a super tool for super users. The concept of "garbage-in, garbage-out" in statistics is similar for AI large language models. The AI, Google Gemini in particular, will search for and attempt to make sense from the questions by which it is prompted. The more detailed and nuanced the questions, the more detailed and nuanced will be the overview from Gemini. In this encounter, after my first question, each of my remaining questions were based on information generated by Gemini from my previous question; moreover, when Gemini is properly prompted it can be very helpful in scientific discovery; as a large language model it is fully engaged by Socratic inquiry. The AI appears to have a sense who it is dealing with-a credulous beginner versus a person who is bringing knowledge and experience to the encounter. Therefore, the five questions that I asked Gemini on January 23, 2026 were escalating in complexity and intensity, fashioned from each response that I read generated by Gemini. All the unedited raw overviews that Gemini wrote are presented in Tables 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. Everything that I wrote exists outside of the tables. The predictions and solutions offered by Gemini are eye-opening. If male college student enrollment declines are not corrected by public policy and cultural mores reversed, very soon the economic outcome for Generation Z men and women could be catastrophic.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Google Gemini AI在科学研究中的应用，特别是通过递进式提问揭示男性大学生入学率下降可能带来的经济灾难性后果。
AI.research_question: 如何通过Google Gemini AI的递进式提问来探索和预测男性大学生入学率下降对经济的影响？
AI.motivation: Google Gemini AI已成为研究人员不可或缺的工具，其"垃圾进，垃圾出"的特性要求更精细的提问才能获得有价值的见解。作者希望通过递进式提问探索AI在科学发现中的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 大型语言模型的"垃圾进，垃圾出"原理；2. 苏格拉底式探究方法；3. AI与用户交互的认知层次理论；4. 递进式复杂提问框架
AI.method: 采用递进式提问方法，基于Gemini对前一个问题的回答构建后续更复杂的问题，在2026年1月23日进行了五个逐步升级的提问，记录所有未编辑的原始回答。
AI.findings: Gemini的预测和解决方案令人震惊：如果公共政策和文化习俗不纠正男性大学生入学率下降的趋势，Z世代男女的经济前景可能很快变得灾难性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了AI辅助科学发现的递进式提问方法论；2. 验证了大型语言模型在复杂社会问题预测中的有效性；3. 发展了AI与专家用户交互的认知层次理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究人员提供了使用AI进行科学探索的具体方法；2. 揭示了男性入学率下降的潜在经济风险；3. 为政策制定者提供了预警和决策参考；4. 展示了AI在社会科学研究中的实际应用价值

title: How AI Systems Threaten to Erode the Rule of Law

detail.title: How AI Systems Threaten to Erode the Rule of Law
detail.abstract: The post argues that AI systems are creating novel societal harms that undermine judicial independence, manipulate political opinion formation, and erode the rule of law through algorithmic opacity and insufficient legal safeguards. A pressing question to ask is whether — and if yes, how — novel societal harms caused by AI systems are adequately addressed within the contours of existing legal categories and legislation. This article focuses on the risks and harms concerning the rule of law. It will highlight three issues by discussing relevant provisions of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI, Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law (Framework AI Convention), which was concluded on September 5, 2024 in light of unfolding case law and business practices. An added value of the Framework AI Convention lies in protecting not only human rights but also democratic processes and the rule of law in the context of AI. Whereas Article 4 of the Framework AI Convention concerns human rights, Article 5(1) focuses on state parties’ obligation to adopt measures so that AI systems are not used to undermine the integrity of democratic processes and the rule of law. The Convention purports to cover risks and harms which are of such a large scale and systemic nature that erode democratic processes and the rule of law. More specifically, the letter of Article 5 refers to many elements intrinsic to the rule of law: integrity and effectiveness of democratic institutions and processes, separation of powers, judicial independence and access to justice. The explanatory report brings more clarity adding political pluralism, information integrity, the principles of accountability, legality and non-arbitrariness and the risk of influencing court rulings. Certain algorithmic harms are not necessarily captured and effectively addressed by existing areas of law, including human rights law. Recent pieces of legislation introduced on an EU level — the Digital Services Act and the AI Act — protect different (legal) categories (e.g., civic discourse, electoral processes) which may function as “proxies” for the rule of law and they help with (at least partly) fleshing out elements thereof.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI系统如何通过算法不透明性和法律保障不足，对司法独立、政治意见形成和法治造成新型社会危害，并分析《欧洲委员会AI、人权、民主与法治框架公约》如何应对这些系统性风险。
AI.research_question: AI系统造成的新型社会危害是否以及如何在现有法律类别和立法框架内得到充分解决？
AI.motivation: AI系统正在通过算法不透明性和法律保障不足，对司法独立、政治意见形成和法治造成前所未有的社会危害，现有法律框架可能无法有效应对这些系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法治理论、民主过程理论、算法治理理论、人权法理论，以及《欧洲委员会AI、人权、民主与法治框架公约》的法律框架。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（特别是《框架AI公约》第4条和第5条）、案例法分析、商业实践分析，以及比较欧盟《数字服务法》和《AI法案》的相关规定。
AI.findings: 1. AI系统确实对法治构成新型系统性危害；2. 现有法律领域（包括人权法）无法充分应对某些算法危害；3. 《框架AI公约》通过保护民主过程和法治要素提供了重要补充；4. 欧盟立法通过保护公民话语和选举过程等"代理"概念间接支持法治。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了法治理论在算法时代的应用；2. 提出了AI系统对民主过程和法治的系统性风险分析框架；3. 发展了算法危害与法律保护之间的理论联系；4. 为AI治理提供了基于法治原则的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了应对AI法治风险的具体法律工具；2. 为司法实践提供了识别和应对算法危害的参考；3. 为企业合规提供了AI系统开发的法治标准；4. 为国际AI治理合作提供了法律框架参考。

title: Fractal Autonomy: The Underlying Operating System of Carbon-Silicon Symbiosis

detail.title: Fractal Autonomy: The Underlying Operating System of Carbon-Silicon Symbiosis
detail.abstract: This paper proposes "Fractal Autonomy": the architecture of efficient systems is isomorphic across scales, from bionic limbs to social governance. We introduce the "Companion System" as universal middleware, functioning via the "Look, Don't Eat" protocol (State Reflection). This ensures System A (Intent) retains strategic command, while System B (Execution) achieves scalability through silence and local synergy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分形自主性"概念，认为高效系统的架构在不同尺度上具有同构性，从仿生肢体到社会治理。引入"伴侣系统"作为通用中间件，通过"只看不吃"协议（状态反射）运作，确保系统A（意图）保持战略指挥，而系统B（执行）通过沉默和局部协同实现可扩展性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建在不同尺度上具有同构性的高效系统架构？如何通过"伴侣系统"和"只看不吃"协议实现战略意图与执行分离的可扩展系统？
AI.motivation: 当前系统设计在不同尺度上缺乏统一的架构原则，导致从微观到宏观的系统效率低下。需要一种通用的中间件架构，能够在保持战略控制的同时实现执行层面的可扩展性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分形自主性理论、伴侣系统架构、状态反射协议（"只看不吃"协议）、战略意图与执行分离理论
AI.method: 提出理论框架和架构设计，通过伴侣系统作为中间件，采用状态反射协议实现系统间的协调
