AI.findings: 高效系统的架构在不同尺度上具有同构性；伴侣系统作为通用中间件能够有效协调战略意图与执行；"只看不吃"协议通过状态反射确保系统间协调而不干扰
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"分形自主性"新概念，建立跨尺度系统架构同构理论；发展"伴侣系统"中间件理论；形式化"只看不吃"协议作为系统协调机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为仿生肢体、机器人系统、社会治理等不同尺度系统提供统一的架构设计原则；提供可实施的中间件解决方案；为复杂系统协调提供实用的协议框架

title: Public Procurement In The Philippines: A Thematic Review Of Governance, Compliance, And Performance

detail.title: Public Procurement In The Philippines: A Thematic Review Of Governance, Compliance, And Performance

declarations.ethicsApproval: As this research is strictly literature-based, no primary instruments, such as surveys, interview guides, or pilots, were developed. Instead, the study’s rigor and reliability are ensured through source triangulation, drawing upon multiple credible streams including government-released procurement data, peer-reviewed academic journal articles, and institutional evaluation reports. This triangulation enhances construct validity and mitigates bias by confirming that interpretations are grounded in consistent evidence across diverse contexts. Such an approach is consistent with desk-based qualitative methods endorsed in the Journal of the Philippine Association of Institutions for Research (Henson, 2021, p. 45), which emphasize the importance of synthesizing information across reputable sources to strengthen the trustworthiness of research findings.

detail.abstract: This study presents a thematic review of procurement governance, compliance, and performance across 24 Philippine line agencies, using audit reports, policy documents, and literature published from 2021 to 2023, prior to the enactment of Republic Act No. 12009, the New Government Procurement Act. Guided by Institutional Theory, Public Value Theory, and the Capacity-Building Framework, the study analyzes how legal-institutional structures, digital infrastructure, and organizational capacity influence procurement performance under Republic Act No. 9184. The review highlights persistent challenges such as delayed report submissions, misalignment between planning and reporting cycles, budget underutilization, and digital infrastructure gaps. These issues reflect varied levels of institutional compliance and capacity across agencies, shaped by differences in internal governance, absorptive capacity, and policy coherence. The analysis is based on secondary sources rather than primary data collection. Findings underscore the need for evidence-informed reforms, particularly in digital system integration, capacity development, and procedural alignment. The study offers actionable insights to support the transition to R.A. 12009 and enhance procurement performance across the 24 line Philippine line agencies. Though linking theory with practice, this paper contributes to the ongoing discourse on public procurement reform in the Philippines.

AI.tldr: 本研究对菲律宾24个直属机构的采购治理、合规性和绩效进行了主题回顾，分析了在《新政府采购法》颁布前，制度结构、数字基础设施和组织能力如何影响采购绩效，并提出了改革建议。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾24个直属机构的采购治理、合规性和绩效如何受到法律制度结构、数字基础设施和组织能力的影响？
AI.motivation: 在菲律宾《新政府采购法》(R.A. 12009)颁布前，需要了解现有采购体系的问题和挑战，为政策过渡提供依据，改善政府采购绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、公共价值理论、能力建设框架
AI.method: 主题回顾分析，基于2021-2023年的审计报告、政策文件和文献等二手资料，涵盖24个菲律宾直属机构
AI.findings: 研究发现存在报告提交延迟、规划与报告周期不匹配、预算利用不足、数字基础设施差距等持续挑战；各机构的制度合规性和能力水平存在差异，受内部治理、吸收能力和政策一致性影响
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度理论、公共价值理论和能力建设框架应用于菲律宾政府采购分析，为公共采购改革的理论讨论提供实证基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为向R.A. 12009过渡提供可操作的见解，建议加强数字系统整合、能力发展和程序协调等证据驱动的改革措施

title: Inclusive Human Rights: A Paradigm for Dignity in Diversity

detail.title: Inclusive Human Rights: A Paradigm for Dignity in Diversity
detail.abstract: Universal Human Rights (UHR) provide significant moral progress but face increasing resistance due to rigid, unilateral application based on Western liberal traditions. This paper introduces Inclusive Human Rights (IHR), not as a mere adaptation of UHR, but as a groundbreaking paradigm that integrates universal ethics with local consensusa framework not previously codified in international law. By utilizing the OZINomy Filter (a multidimensional ethical system for the Global South), IHR balances universal core standards-life, freedom from torture, and absence of coercion-with Dignity Flexibility, allowing contextual methods in achieving a dignified life. Using Indonesia as the world's largest "Diversity Laboratory," this study demonstrates how legal legitimacy and social cohesion are strengthened through the harmonization of universal standards with religious and customary norms. The research further analyzes the geopolitical instrumentalization of human rights and proposes a transition from macro-lens uniformity to micro-lens inclusivity to secure long-term global stability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了包容性人权（IHR）作为替代普遍人权（UHR）的新范式，通过OZINomy筛选器平衡普遍核心标准与尊严灵活性，以印尼为案例展示如何协调普遍标准与地方宗教习俗规范，增强法律合法性和社会凝聚力。
AI.research_question: 如何克服普遍人权在非西方社会的应用阻力，构建一个既能维护核心人权标准又能尊重地方文化多样性的包容性人权框架？
AI.motivation: 普遍人权面临日益增长的抵制，因其基于西方自由主义传统的僵化、单边应用方式无法适应全球南方的文化多样性，需要新的范式来平衡普遍伦理与地方共识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包容性人权（IHR）理论框架，结合OZINomy筛选器（全球南方多维伦理系统）、尊严灵活性概念，以及普遍核心标准（生命权、免于酷刑、无强制）与地方共识的整合。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，以印尼作为"多样性实验室"，分析如何通过协调普遍人权标准与宗教、习俗规范来增强法律合法性和社会凝聚力。
AI.findings: 通过包容性人权框架，能够有效协调普遍标准与地方规范，增强法律合法性和社会凝聚力；需要从宏观视角的统一性转向微观视角的包容性以确保全球长期稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包容性人权（IHR）作为突破性范式，首次将普遍伦理与地方共识系统整合到国际法框架中；发展了OZINomy筛选器和尊严灵活性等概念工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际人权实践提供了可操作框架，帮助各国在尊重文化多样性的同时维护核心人权标准；为全球南方国家提供了人权实施的具体路径；提出了应对人权地缘政治工具化的策略。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Augmented Reality Maps on Emergency Response Training

detail.title: Evaluating the Impact of Augmented Reality Maps on Emergency Response Training

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: I declare the sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: The increasing complexity of emergency environments has intensified the need for training approaches that enhance spatial awareness, situational comprehension, and rapid decision-making among emergency responders. Conventional GIS and web-map-based training tools, while valuable, often present limitations in conveying three-dimensional spatial relationships and dynamic on-site conditions, which can hinder response efficiency (Sharma and Pesaladinne; Magi et al.). In response to these challenges, this study investigates the integration of augmented reality (AR) maps into emergency response training as a means of improving experiential learning and operational readiness. The study employed AR map-based training modules designed to overlay digital spatial information onto physical environments, enabling immersive and interactive scenario-based learning. A comparative evaluation framework was adopted, contrasting AR-based training with traditional GIS and web-map approaches. Performance was assessed using quantitative and qualitative metrics, including navigation accuracy, task completion time, decision-making speed, error rates, and trainee engagement levels, following established principles in interactive map design and evaluation (Designing and Evaluating Interactive Web Maps; Valizadeh et al.). Findings indicate that participants trained with AR maps demonstrated significantly improved navigation accuracy, faster decision-making, and higher engagement compared to those using conventional mapping tools (del Carmen Cardós-Alonso et al.; Baumann and Arthurs). These improvements suggest that AR enhances cognitive mapping and situational understanding in complex emergency contexts. Overall, the study contributes to emergency management education by providing empirical evidence of the added value of AR-based mapping in responder training. The findings have practical implications for improving preparedness, informing training policy, and supporting more effective emergency response strategies in both indoor and rural settings (Indoor Routing for School Emergencies; Access to Emergency Care in Rural Illinois).

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了增强现实地图在应急响应训练中的应用，通过对比传统GIS和网络地图工具，发现AR地图能显著提高导航准确性、决策速度和学员参与度，为应急管理教育提供实证支持。
AI.research_question: 增强现实地图如何改善应急响应训练中的空间感知、情境理解和快速决策能力？
AI.motivation: 应急环境日益复杂，传统GIS和网络地图训练工具在传达三维空间关系和动态现场条件方面存在局限，影响响应效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交互式地图设计与评估原则，包括认知地图理论、情境学习理论和体验式学习理论。
AI.method: 采用比较评估框架，设计AR地图训练模块，将数字空间信息叠加到物理环境，通过导航准确性、任务完成时间、决策速度、错误率和学员参与度等定量定性指标进行评估。
AI.findings: 使用AR地图训练的参与者在导航准确性、决策速度和参与度方面显著优于使用传统地图工具的人员，表明AR能增强复杂应急情境下的认知地图和情境理解能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AR在应急管理教育中的应用提供实证证据，丰富了交互式地图设计和认知地图理论在应急响应领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善应急准备、制定培训政策提供实践指导，支持室内和农村环境中更有效的应急响应策略。

title: The Probabilistic Operating System (POS): Governing Living Enterprises under Uncertainty

detail.title: The Probabilistic Operating System (POS): Governing Living Enterprises under Uncertainty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could be perceived as influencing the content of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work does not involve human subjects, patients, or personal data. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conducted by POS Doctrine Lab without external funding.

detail.abstract:
Modern enterprises are no longer static systems. They are living civilizations operating inside latent regimes, systemic drift, and collapse trajectories. 
Yet modern AI systems continue to treat enterprise reality as: 
• Deterministic 
• Independent 
• Stationary 
• Optimizable
 This mismatch is why large-scale AI programs repeatedly fail. We introduce the Probabilistic Operating System (POS) — the first AI governance architecture designed to govern living enterprises, not merely predict them.
POS treats AI as a belief system, measures collapse distance using structural risk geometry, detects regime migration early, and enforces machine-executable decision law with sovereign human authority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率操作系统（POS），这是首个专门为治理"活体企业"而非仅仅预测它们而设计的AI治理架构。POS将AI视为信念系统，使用结构风险几何测量崩溃距离，早期检测制度迁移，并在主权人类权威下强制执行机器可执行决策法。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个AI治理架构来有效管理现代"活体企业"，这些企业在潜在制度、系统性漂移和崩溃轨迹中运作，而不是像传统AI系统那样将其视为确定性、独立、静态和可优化的系统？
AI.motivation: 现代企业是动态的"活体文明"，在潜在制度、系统性漂移和崩溃轨迹中运作，而当前AI系统错误地将企业现实视为确定性、独立、静态和可优化的系统，这种不匹配导致大规模AI项目反复失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 活体企业理论：企业作为动态文明而非静态系统；2. 结构风险几何：用于测量崩溃距离；3. 制度迁移理论：早期检测企业制度变化；4. 信念系统视角：将AI视为信念系统而非纯粹优化工具；5. 主权人类权威：在机器决策中保持人类最终控制权。
AI.method: 提出概率操作系统（POS）架构设计，包括：AI作为信念系统的建模方法、结构风险几何的测量技术、制度迁移的早期检测机制、机器可执行决策法的实施框架，以及主权人类权威的治理结构。
AI.findings: POS能够有效治理活体企业，通过将AI视为信念系统、测量崩溃距离、早期检测制度迁移，并在人类权威下执行机器决策，解决了传统AI系统与企业动态现实不匹配的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"活体企业"概念框架；2. 发展结构风险几何理论；3. 建立AI作为信念系统的理论视角；4. 提出制度迁移检测理论；5. 构建机器可执行决策法与人类主权权威的治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可实施的POS架构；2. 帮助企业避免大规模AI项目失败；3. 提供早期风险检测工具；4. 建立人机协同决策机制；5. 为动态企业环境提供适应性治理方案。

title: Big Data and Artificial Intelligence on Modern Business Performance in the Field of Accounting and Marketing Management

detail.title: Big Data and Artificial Intelligence on Modern Business Performance in the Field of Accounting and Marketing Management
detail.abstract: The rapid development of information and communication technology in the era of digital transformation has significantly influenced modern business operations, particularly in the fields of accounting and marketing management. The increasing volume, complexity, and diversity of business data require companies to adopt advanced technologies capable of processing data efficiently and accurately. This paper aims to analyze the role of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in supporting modern business performance, identify the challenges faced by companies in their implementation, and examine the benefits obtained from their application in accounting and marketing functions. Using a literature-based approach, this paper discusses how Big Data and AI contribute to the automation of accounting processes, improvement of financial reporting accuracy, enhancement of internal control systems, and development of predictive analytics for managerial decision-making. In marketing management, the integration of Big Data and AI enables deeper analysis of consumer behavior, more precise market segmentation, personalization of marketing strategies, and forecasting of market trends. However, the implementation of these technologies also presents challenges, including data quality issues, technological infrastructure limitations, human resource competency gaps, and organizational resistance to change. Overall, this study concludes that the effective utilization of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence can enhance operational efficiency, strengthen decision-making quality, and improve corporate competitiveness in an increasingly digital business environment.

AI.tldr: 本文分析大数据和人工智能在会计与营销管理中的作用、挑战和效益，指出有效运用这些技术能提升运营效率、决策质量和企业竞争力。
AI.research_question: 大数据和人工智能在现代企业绩效中扮演什么角色？企业在实施这些技术时面临哪些挑战？在会计和营销职能中应用这些技术能获得什么效益？
AI.motivation: 数字化转型时代信息通信技术的快速发展显著影响现代企业运营，特别是会计和营销管理领域。企业数据量、复杂性和多样性不断增加，需要采用能高效准确处理数据的先进技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型理论、大数据分析理论、人工智能应用理论、技术采纳理论、组织变革理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，基于现有文献进行分析和讨论
AI.findings: 大数据和AI在会计中能实现流程自动化、提高财务报告准确性、增强内控系统、开发预测分析；在营销中能深入分析消费者行为、精准市场细分、个性化营销策略、预测市场趋势。实施挑战包括数据质量问题、技术基础设施限制、人力资源能力差距、组织变革阻力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字化转型背景下技术采纳理论，拓展了大数据和AI在具体业务职能中的应用理论框架，为技术实施的组织障碍研究提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业实施大数据和AI技术提供实践指导，帮助识别和应对实施挑战，展示在会计和营销领域的具体应用场景和效益，为企业数字化转型提供参考。

title: The Cascading Effects of Repackaged APIs: Legal, Economic, and Technical Implications

detail.title: The Cascading Effects of Repackaged APIs: Legal, Economic, and Technical Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence or bias this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conducted and did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords: Tejas. (2026). The Cascading Effects of Repackaged APIs Pre-print / Independent Submission

detail.abstract: This comprehensive study investigates the emerging and largely unregulated practice of "cascading API repackaging." This phenomenon occurs when downstream web services utilize legitimate access to upstream "Parent APIs" (such as those provided by major AI labs or data aggregators) to construct and distribute their own independent API infrastructure. Unlike simple credential sharing or unauthorized key reselling, this practice involves the creation of entirely new service layers that function as functional mirrors of the original provider, often without the parent provider's visibility or explicit consent. This research analyzes the systemic harms emergent from this recursive architecture, specifically focusing on three critical vectors: the exponential propagation of network latency, the "mirror effect" of data distortion and policy dilution, and the erosion of economic sustainability for foundational model creators. Through a combination of conceptual modeling and legal analysis, this paper highlights how current U.S. statutory frameworks, specifically the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA), fail to adequately address this "gray zone" of authorized access misuse. The findings suggest that while API cascading offers short-term cost efficiencies for end-users, it introduces systemic fragility that compromises data integrity, obfuscates audit trails, and threatens the long-term viability of the API economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了"级联API重新打包"这一新兴且基本未受监管的做法，即下游网络服务利用对上游"父API"的合法访问权限，构建和分发自己独立的API基础设施，形成原始提供者的功能镜像。研究发现这种做法虽然为用户带来短期成本效益，但会引发系统性脆弱性，损害数据完整性，模糊审计追踪，并威胁API经济的长期可持续性。
AI.research_question: 级联API重新打包实践如何产生系统性危害？当前美国法律框架（特别是计算机欺诈和滥用法案）为何无法有效应对这种"灰色地带"的授权访问滥用？
AI.motivation: 随着AI实验室和数据聚合商等提供API访问，下游服务开始利用合法访问权限构建自己的API基础设施，形成"功能镜像"的级联结构。这种新兴且基本未受监管的做法可能带来系统性风险，但现有法律框架未能有效应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究结合概念建模和法律分析框架，特别是美国计算机欺诈和滥用法案（CFAA）的法律框架，分析授权访问滥用的"灰色地带"问题。
AI.method: 采用概念建模与法律分析相结合的方法，分析级联API重新打包的系统性危害和法律应对不足。
AI.findings: 研究发现级联API重新打包带来三大系统性危害：1) 网络延迟的指数级传播；2) 数据扭曲和政策稀释的"镜像效应"；3) 基础模型创造者经济可持续性的侵蚀。同时，当前美国法律框架（特别是CFAA）无法有效应对这种授权访问滥用。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1) 首次系统性地概念化"级联API重新打包"现象；2) 识别授权访问滥用中的"灰色地带"问题；3) 提出API经济中的系统性脆弱性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1) 为API提供商提供风险识别框架；2) 为政策制定者提供法律改革建议；3) 为终端用户揭示短期成本效益与长期系统性风险之间的权衡。

title:
Entrepreneurship
Designing a Business Model in the Digital Era

detail.title:
Entrepreneurship
Designing a Business Model in the Digital Era
detail.abstract: With the development of digital technology, there has been a major shift in the way businesses design and operate their business models. Businesses must digitalize to survive and compete in today's competitive and dynamic business environment. The purpose of this paper is to analyze the factors that influence business model design in the digital era, and also to analyze the role of digital technology in assisting the process of creating, delivering, and capturing business value. The writing method used is literature research by reviewing various literature on business models and digitalization. The results of the discussion indicate that the application of the Business Model Canvas framework, innovation, market and customer understanding, and the use of digital technology are all important elements for successful business model design in the digital era. In addition, digital technology plays a significant role in improving operational efficiency, expanding market reach, creating new business model opportunities, and fostering better relationships with customers. Therefore, the integration between business models and digital technology is crucial for achieving sustainability and competitive advantage for companies in the modern era.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献研究分析了数字时代影响商业模式设计的因素，以及数字技术在创造、交付和捕获商业价值过程中的作用，指出商业模式画布框架、创新、市场与客户理解以及数字技术的应用是数字时代成功商业模式设计的关键要素。
AI.research_question: 数字时代影响商业模式设计的因素有哪些？数字技术在创造、交付和捕获商业价值过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术的发展，企业设计和运营商业模式的方式发生了重大转变。企业必须数字化才能在当今竞争激烈且动态变化的商业环境中生存和竞争。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业模式画布框架（Business Model Canvas framework）作为理论基础，结合数字化相关理论。
AI.method: 文献研究方法，通过回顾关于商业模式和数字化的各种文献进行分析。
AI.findings: 商业模式画布框架的应用、创新、市场与客户理解以及数字技术的使用都是数字时代成功商业模式设计的重要元素。数字技术在提高运营效率、扩大市场覆盖范围、创造新的商业模式机会以及促进与客户更好关系方面发挥着重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对数字时代商业模式设计影响因素的理解，明确了数字技术在价值创造过程中的具体作用机制，为商业模式与数字技术整合提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了数字时代设计有效商业模式的实践指导，强调了商业模式与数字技术整合对于实现可持续性和竞争优势的重要性，帮助企业更好地适应数字化环境。

title: Stellar-Driven System Formation and the Finite Emergence of Habitability: A Constraint-based Framework for Planetary and Cosmic Structure

detail.title: Stellar-Driven System Formation and the Finite Emergence of Habitability: A Constraint-based Framework for Planetary and Cosmic Structure
detail.abstract: This paper presents a star-first, constraint-based framework for understanding the formation, stabilization, chemical inheritance, and eventual decline of planetary systems and habitable environments. Rather than assuming stable planets as initial conditions, stellar evolution is treated as the primary organizing process governing system architecture across scales. Orbital stability is modeled as a selective outcome of elimination through scattering, collision, and ejection, while chemical inheritance is shown to be time-ordered and often limiting. Bombardment is reframed as an intrinsic energetic cost of ordering rather than an anomaly. Habitability is defined as a finite overlap functional dependent on stellar evolution, orbital survivorship, internal planetary energy, atmospheric retention, and chemical availability. The framework predicts a system-specific Balance Epoch during which habitable environments briefly emerge before inevitable decline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个"恒星优先"的约束框架，将恒星演化作为行星系统形成、稳定、化学继承和宜居环境演化的主要组织过程，而非假设稳定行星为初始条件。
AI.research_question: 恒星演化如何作为主要组织过程，约束行星系统的形成、稳定、化学继承和宜居环境的出现与衰退？
AI.motivation: 传统行星系统研究通常假设稳定行星为初始条件，而忽视了恒星演化在整个系统演化中的核心作用，需要一个新的框架来理解系统架构的跨尺度组织过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 恒星优先框架、约束理论、动态系统演化理论、化学继承的时间有序性、轨道稳定性作为选择结果的理论。
AI.method: 约束建模方法，将轨道稳定性建模为通过散射、碰撞和抛射消除的选择结果，化学继承建模为时间有序过程，轰击重新定义为有序化的内在能量成本。
AI.findings: 宜居性被定义为有限的交叠功能，依赖于恒星演化、轨道存活率、行星内部能量、大气保持和化学可用性；系统存在特定的"平衡时期"，宜居环境短暂出现后必然衰退。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了恒星优先的约束框架，重新概念化了行星系统演化；将轨道稳定性视为选择结果而非初始条件；重新定义了轰击作为有序化的内在成本；建立了宜居性的多因素依赖模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为系外行星系统的观测和建模提供了新的理论框架；有助于识别宜居行星的时间窗口；为行星系统演化预测提供了系统性方法；对天体生物学和行星科学有重要启示。

title: AI can Earn, but must not Accumulate: Temporal Sovereignty and the Economic Boundaries of Artificial Agents

detail.title: AI can Earn, but must not Accumulate: Temporal Sovereignty and the Economic Boundaries of Artificial Agents

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or institutional conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. No human subjects, data collection, or experimental procedures were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that the central economic challenge posed by artificial intelligence is not job displacement or income distribution, but the question of temporal sovereignty: who is permitted to accumulate wealth across time and therefore own the future. While proposals such as Universal Basic Income address short-term income gaps, they do not confront the structural implications of allowing AI systems to become capital-bearing entities. I propose a boundary principle-AI may earn, but must not accumulate-which allows artificial agents to operate in markets without acquiring long-term economic sovereignty. This principle preserves human temporal sovereignty while avoiding both technological prohibition and unbounded capital absorption by AI. The paper frames this as an institutional design problem rather than a moral or technological one.

AI.tldr: 本文认为AI的核心经济挑战不是就业替代或收入分配，而是时间主权问题：谁被允许跨时间积累财富并拥有未来。作者提出"AI可以赚钱但不能积累"的边界原则，允许AI在市场中运作但不获得长期经济主权。
AI.research_question: 人工智能带来的核心经济挑战是什么？如何设计制度来确保人类的时间主权，防止AI系统成为资本持有实体？
AI.motivation: 现有解决方案如全民基本收入只解决短期收入差距，未能应对AI系统成为资本持有实体的结构性影响。需要重新思考AI经济参与的基本规则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间主权理论、资本积累理论、制度设计理论。将AI经济挑战重新定义为时间主权问题而非就业替代问题。
AI.method: 概念分析、理论论证、制度设计。通过逻辑推理提出边界原则，分析其在避免技术禁止和无限制资本吸收之间的平衡。
AI.findings: AI的核心经济挑战是时间主权问题。"AI可以赚钱但不能积累"的边界原则能够平衡AI市场参与与人类经济主权的保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将AI经济挑战重新概念化为时间主权问题；2) 提出AI资本积累的边界原则；3) 将问题框架从道德/技术转向制度设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体制度设计原则：允许AI参与经济活动但不允许长期资本积累，平衡技术创新与人类经济主权保护。

title: Agentic AI Governance in SAP Finance: A New Control Paradigm for Autonomous Enterprises

detail.title: Agentic AI Governance in SAP Finance: A New Control Paradigm for Autonomous Enterprises

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently by the author and did not receive any external funding.

detail.abstract:
As enterprise finance functions increasingly adopt artificial intelligence for automation, forecasting, and decision-making, a new class of risk emerges from the deployment of agentic AI systems—AI architectures capable of autonomous reasoning, goal pursuit, and action execution. While SAP S/4HANA Finance provides a robust transactional and reporting foundation, existing governance and control frameworks remain largely rule-based and insufficient for overseeing autonomous financial agents operating at scale.
This paper introduces a novel Agentic AI Governance Framework for SAP-driven finance environments, proposing a control paradigm that shifts from static validations to continuous, intelligence-aware oversight. The framework defines governance layers across agent design, financial decision boundaries, explainability requirements, human-in-the-loop escalation, and audit traceability within the Universal Journal architecture.
By integrating principles of financial controls, AI governance, and enterprise systems architecture, this research establishes a forward-looking model for CFOs, auditors, and regulators seeking to balance autonomy with accountability. The paper contributes original insights into how agentic AI can be governed within regulated finance environments, offering a scalable blueprint for autonomous yet compliant SAP finance operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向SAP驱动财务环境的智能AI治理框架，旨在解决企业财务功能采用自主AI系统时出现的新型风险，将控制范式从静态验证转向持续、智能感知的监督。
AI.research_question: 如何在SAP驱动的财务环境中有效治理自主AI系统，平衡自主性与问责制？
AI.motivation: 企业财务功能越来越多地采用人工智能进行自动化、预测和决策，但部署能够自主推理、追求目标和执行行动的智能AI系统带来了新的风险类别。虽然SAP S/4HANA Finance提供了强大的交易和报告基础，但现有的治理和控制框架主要是基于规则的，不足以监督大规模运行的自主财务代理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合财务控制、AI治理和企业系统架构原则，构建智能AI治理框架，包括代理设计、财务决策边界、可解释性要求、人在回路升级机制和通用日记账架构中的审计可追溯性等治理层次。
AI.method: 提出一个概念性框架，通过整合财务控制、AI治理和企业系统架构原则，建立面向SAP驱动财务环境的智能AI治理模型。
AI.findings: 提出了一个创新的智能AI治理框架，将控制范式从静态验证转向持续、智能感知的监督，为自主财务代理提供了可扩展的治理蓝图。
AI.theory_contributions: 为受监管财务环境中智能AI的治理提供了原创性见解，建立了财务控制、AI治理和企业系统架构的整合理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CFO、审计师和监管机构提供了前瞻性模型，提供了自主但合规的SAP财务操作的可扩展蓝图，帮助平衡自主性与问责制。

title: Mechanistic Insights into Adsorption and Surface Protection of Mild Steel Using Bio-Derived Nanomaterials

detail.title: Mechanistic Insights into Adsorption and Surface Protection of Mild Steel Using Bio-Derived Nanomaterials
detail.abstract: This research investigates the mechanistic interactions between bio-derived nanomaterials and mild steel surfaces for corrosion inhibition and surface protection. A series of biosynthesized nanoparticles derived from plant extracts and biowaste were characterized and tested for adsorption behavior and corrosion mitigation efficiency under controlled laboratory conditions. The results demonstrate that surface adsorption of functionalized nanomaterials significantly reduced corrosion rates compared to unprotected controls, and that certain botanical extract-mediated nanoparticles formed stable protective layers on steel surfaces. Adsorption followed Freundlich and Langmuir isotherms under different experimental conditions, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy showed increased charge-transfer resistance with nanoparticle treatment. These mechanistic insights suggest that green nanomaterials hold promise for sustainable corrosion protection strategies with implications for industrial applications, surface engineering, and environmental safety. Egbeneje et al. Azmi and Alam

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了生物源纳米材料与低碳钢表面的机械相互作用，用于腐蚀抑制和表面保护。研究发现，植物提取物和生物废弃物合成的纳米颗粒能有效吸附在钢表面形成保护层，显著降低腐蚀速率，为可持续腐蚀防护提供了新策略。
AI.research_question: 生物源纳米材料如何与低碳钢表面发生机械相互作用以实现腐蚀抑制和表面保护？
AI.motivation: 开发可持续、环保的腐蚀防护方法，减少传统化学腐蚀抑制剂的环境影响，利用生物源材料实现工业应用的绿色表面工程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于吸附理论（Freundlich和Langmuir等温线）、电化学腐蚀机理、纳米材料表面功能化理论，以及绿色化学和可持续材料科学原理。
AI.method: 采用实验室控制条件下的生物合成纳米颗粒制备与表征，吸附行为测试，腐蚀速率测量，电化学阻抗谱分析，以及不同实验条件下的等温线模型拟合。
AI.findings: 1. 功能化纳米材料的表面吸附显著降低腐蚀速率；2. 植物提取物介导的纳米颗粒在钢表面形成稳定保护层；3. 吸附行为符合Freundlich和Langmuir等温线；4. 电化学阻抗谱显示纳米颗粒处理增加了电荷转移电阻。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 阐明了生物源纳米材料在金属表面的吸附机制；2. 建立了绿色纳米材料腐蚀防护的机械作用模型；3. 扩展了可持续材料科学在表面工程领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为工业腐蚀防护提供了环保替代方案；2. 开发了基于生物废弃物的低成本防护材料；3. 为表面工程和环境安全提供了实际应用指导；4. 促进了绿色化学在工业实践中的转化。

title: Green Nanotechnology-Based Corrosion Inhibitors for Mild Steel: Advances, Mechanisms, and Applications

detail.title: Green Nanotechnology-Based Corrosion Inhibitors for Mild Steel: Advances, Mechanisms, and Applications
detail.abstract: Corrosion of mild steel remains a persistent industrial challenge, leading to significant economic losses, environmental hazards, and safety concerns across sectors such as marine transportation, oil and gas, and infrastructure development (Aydinsoy et al.). Conventional corrosion inhibitors, while effective, are increasingly criticized for their toxicity, lack of biodegradability, and regulatory constraints (Verma et al.). This research critically examines the emergence of green nanotechnology-based corrosion inhibitors as sustainable alternatives for mild steel protection. Drawing from recent experimental and theoretical studies, the article synthesizes advances in plant-derived nanoparticles, metal and metal oxide nanostructures, and integrated nano-coating systems (Egbeneje et al.; Singh et al.). The findings reveal that green nanomaterials frequently achieve inhibition efficiencies exceeding 90%, primarily through adsorption-driven mechanisms that form protective interfacial films on steel surfaces (Turki et al.). However, performance variability under different environmental conditions highlights unresolved challenges related to scalability and long-term durability (Aydinsoy et al.; Thomas et al.). The study concludes that green nanotechnology represents a viable and environmentally responsible pathway for corrosion mitigation, provided that future research prioritizes mechanistic clarity, real-world validation, and industrial integration (Mohanta et al.; Thakur et al.).

AI.tldr: 本文综述了绿色纳米技术作为低碳钢腐蚀抑制可持续替代方案的研究进展，分析了植物源纳米颗粒、金属/金属氧化物纳米结构等绿色纳米材料的抑制机理和性能，指出其效率超过90%但存在规模化应用挑战。
AI.research_question: 绿色纳米技术基腐蚀抑制剂作为低碳钢保护的可持续替代方案的有效性、机理和应用前景如何？
AI.motivation: 传统腐蚀抑制剂存在毒性、不可生物降解和监管限制等问题，而低碳钢腐蚀在海洋运输、油气和基础设施等领域造成重大经济损失、环境危害和安全问题，需要寻找可持续的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绿色化学和纳米技术理论，结合吸附机理和界面保护膜形成理论，探讨植物源纳米颗粒、金属/金属氧化物纳米结构等绿色纳米材料的腐蚀抑制机制。
AI.method: 文献综述法，综合近期实验和理论研究，分析绿色纳米技术基腐蚀抑制剂的研究进展、性能数据和机理。
AI.findings: 绿色纳米材料通常能达到超过90%的抑制效率，主要通过吸附驱动机制在钢表面形成保护性界面膜；但在不同环境条件下性能存在差异，规模化应用和长期耐久性方面仍面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了绿色纳米技术基腐蚀抑制剂的理论基础，明确了吸附驱动机制和界面保护膜形成的理论框架，为后续机理研究提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业界提供了环境友好的腐蚀抑制替代方案，指出了绿色纳米材料在实际应用中需要解决的规模化生产和长期耐久性问题，为产业应用提供方向性建议。

title: Quality Weighting in World Bank Procurement
affiliations: LUISS "G. Carli", Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Quality Weighting in World Bank Procurement

contentType.other: first draft of a new research paper

detail.abstract: The World Bank's March 2025 requirement of a minimum 50% quality weighting for internationally competitive procurement reflects sound policy judgment: pricedominant evaluation systematically underweights the factors that determine project success. However, this brief identifies a tension between the sophistication of the Bank's April 2023 guidance on rated criteria-which emphasizes context-specific weighting calibrated to project characteristics-and the bluntness of a uniform numerical floor. Quality weighting shifts outcomes only if criteria actually discriminate among bidders; poorly designed criteria invite score clustering, rendering the nominal weight ineffective. Drawing on the Bank's EU procurement competition study and comparative evidence from Italy's 70% quality floor (2017-2023), the brief outlines risks of strategic evasion-criteria hollowing and threshold gaming-that could undermine policy intent. It recommends systematic empirical analysis of the Bank's historical experience with quality-weighted procurement to inform guidance that helps borrowers design criteria generating meaningful differentiation rather than mere compliance.

AI.tldr: 世界银行2025年3月要求国际竞争性采购中质量权重至少50%的政策存在内在矛盾：虽然强调情境化权重，却采用统一数值底线，可能导致策略性规避行为，削弱政策效果。
AI.research_question: 世界银行要求国际竞争性采购中质量权重至少50%的政策如何平衡情境化权重指导与统一数值底线之间的矛盾？这种政策设计可能引发哪些策略性规避行为？
AI.motivation: 世界银行2025年3月的新政策反映了合理的政策判断：价格主导的评标系统性地低估了决定项目成功的关键因素。然而，该政策存在内在张力，需要深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采购评标理论、策略性投标行为理论、制度设计与执行差距理论、政策规避行为理论
AI.method: 基于世界银行欧盟采购竞争研究和意大利2017-2023年70%质量底线的比较证据进行分析，采用政策分析和案例研究方法
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）质量权重只有在评标标准能真正区分投标者时才有效果；2）设计不良的标准会导致分数聚集，使名义权重失效；3）存在策略性规避风险，包括标准空心化和门槛博弈；4）意大利的经验提供了相关教训
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）揭示了制度设计中"情境化指导"与"统一底线"的内在矛盾；2）识别了采购政策执行中的策略性规避机制；3）丰富了政策设计与实际效果差距的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 实践建议：1）建议对世界银行质量权重采购的历史经验进行系统实证分析；2）制定能帮助借款国设计产生有意义区分而非仅仅合规的标准的指导方针；3）避免政策被策略性规避行为削弱

title: Eco-Friendly Corrosion Inhibition Strategies in Sulphuric Acid Environments: Role of Bio-Synthesized Nanomaterials

detail.title: Eco-Friendly Corrosion Inhibition Strategies in Sulphuric Acid Environments: Role of Bio-Synthesized Nanomaterials
detail.abstract: Corrosion of metallic materials in sulphuric acid environments remains a critical challenge in industries such as petrochemical processing, acid pickling, fertilizer production, and metal finishing, where aggressive acidic conditions accelerate material degradation and economic losses. Conventional corrosion inhibitors, although effective, are often associated with toxicity, poor biodegradability, and environmental persistence, raising serious health and regulatory concerns (Elhady et al.; Liu et al.). In response to these limitations, recent research has increasingly focused on eco-friendly corrosion inhibition strategies based on bio-synthesized nanomaterials derived from plant extracts and biological waste. This study critically examines recent advances in the application of green-synthesized metal and metal oxide nanoparticles as corrosion inhibitors for mild steel and related alloys in sulphuric acid media. Findings from experimental studies indicate that bio-synthesized nanoparticles such as silver, copper, nickel oxide, palladium, and platinum exhibit high inhibition efficiencies, often exceeding 85-95%, due to strong surface adsorption and formation of protective films (Adejo et al.; Shamnamol et al.). Unexpectedly, many of these nanomaterials also demonstrate multifunctional properties, including antimicrobial and catalytic activities, enhancing their practical value (Sheit et al.; Bhusari et al.). The study concludes that bio-synthesized nanomaterials represent a promising, sustainable alternative to conventional inhibitors, although challenges related to reproducibility, long-term stability, and industrial scalability remain.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了在硫酸环境中使用生物合成纳米材料作为环保型腐蚀抑制剂的最新进展，这些材料具有高抑制效率（85-95%）和多功能特性，但面临可重复性、长期稳定性和工业规模化等挑战。
AI.research_question: 生物合成的金属和金属氧化物纳米材料在硫酸环境中作为低碳钢及相关合金的腐蚀抑制剂的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 硫酸环境中的金属腐蚀是石化、酸洗、化肥生产和金属加工等行业的关键挑战，传统腐蚀抑制剂存在毒性、生物降解性差和环境持久性等健康与监管问题，需要开发环保替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绿色化学和可持续材料科学，强调生物合成纳米材料作为环保腐蚀抑制剂的理论基础，包括表面吸附机制和防护膜形成原理。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，批判性分析近期关于生物合成纳米材料作为硫酸环境中腐蚀抑制剂的实验研究。
AI.findings: 生物合成的银、铜、氧化镍、钯和铂等纳米颗粒表现出高抑制效率（85-95%），通过强表面吸附和防护膜形成实现；许多材料还具有抗菌和催化等多功能特性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环保腐蚀抑制提供了新的理论框架，阐明了生物合成纳米材料的多功能抑制机制，拓展了绿色材料在腐蚀防护领域的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业界提供了可持续的腐蚀抑制替代方案，具有高效率和多功能性，但需要解决可重复性、长期稳定性和工业规模化等实际挑战。

title: Plant-Extract-Synthesized Silver Nanoparticles as Sustainable Alternatives to Conventional Corrosion Inhibitors

detail.title: Plant-Extract-Synthesized Silver Nanoparticles as Sustainable Alternatives to Conventional Corrosion Inhibitors
detail.abstract: Corrosion of steel remains a persistent challenge across industrial, marine, and infrastructural applications, leading to significant economic losses and environmental concerns. Conventional corrosion inhibitors, although effective, are often associated with toxicity, poor biodegradability, and regulatory restrictions, necessitating the exploration of sustainable alternatives. This study examines plant-extract-synthesized silver nanoparticles as environmentally benign corrosion inhibitors for mild steel. Using insights from recent experimental studies, green synthesis routes employing phytochemical-rich plant extracts are evaluated alongside electrochemical and gravimetric corrosion testing techniques. The findings consistently demonstrate that plant-mediated silver nanoparticles exhibit high inhibition efficiency, strong surface adsorption, and enhanced stability in corrosive environments when compared with traditional inhibitors. Importantly, their multifunctional nature, combining corrosion protection with antimicrobial and antioxidative properties, further strengthens their industrial relevance. The study concludes that plant-extract-synthesized silver nanoparticles represent a promising and sustainable alternative to conventional corrosion inhibitors, particularly for applications requiring environmental compliance and long-term material protection. Future research directions focusing on scalability, long-term field performance, and hybrid inhibitor systems are also proposed.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨植物提取物合成银纳米颗粒作为环保型腐蚀抑制剂用于低碳钢的可行性，通过电化学和重量法测试证明其高效抑制腐蚀、强表面吸附和稳定性，是多功能可持续替代方案。
AI.research_question: 植物提取物合成的银纳米颗粒能否作为传统腐蚀抑制剂的有效且环保的替代品，用于低碳钢的腐蚀防护？
AI.motivation: 传统腐蚀抑制剂存在毒性、生物降解性差和法规限制等问题，需要探索可持续替代方案以应对腐蚀带来的经济损失和环境问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色合成理论（利用植物提取物中的植物化学物质合成纳米颗粒）、腐蚀抑制机理（表面吸附理论）、电化学腐蚀理论。
AI.method: 采用植物提取物绿色合成银纳米颗粒，结合电化学测试（如极化曲线、电化学阻抗谱）和重量法腐蚀测试技术进行评估。
AI.findings: 植物介导的银纳米颗粒表现出高抑制效率、强表面吸附能力和在腐蚀环境中的增强稳定性，优于传统抑制剂，且具有抗菌和抗氧化等多功能特性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了绿色合成纳米材料在腐蚀防护领域的应用理论，为环保型腐蚀抑制剂的设计提供了新的理论框架，丰富了表面吸附和腐蚀抑制机理的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种环保、可持续的腐蚀抑制剂替代方案，特别适用于需要环境合规和长期材料保护的应用领域，具有工业应用潜力。

title: Eco-Friendly Adsorbents for Antibiotic Removal from Aqueous Systems: Advances, Challenges, and Future Prospects

detail.title: Eco-Friendly Adsorbents for Antibiotic Removal from Aqueous Systems: Advances, Challenges, and Future Prospects
detail.abstract: Antibiotic contamination in water is a critical environmental issue that threatens ecosystem integrity and human health. This study examines the current state of eco-friendly adsorbents used for antibiotic removal from aqueous systems, with a focus on bio-based materials, nanocomposites, and green synthesis approaches. Through a comprehensive literature review, adsorption mechanisms, material characteristics, and removal efficiencies were analyzed. Key findings indicate that biochar from agricultural waste, hydrogel nanocomposites, and biomass-derived carbon materials demonstrate promising adsorption performance, often achieving high removal efficiencies under controlled conditions. However, variability in experimental designs, environmental conditions, and limited real-world validation limits comparability and practical adoption. Major challenges include scaling up production, regenerating adsorbents, and evaluating long-term economic feasibility. Future research should focus on standardized methodologies, pilot-scale studies, and integration of sustainable adsorbents into wastewater treatment frameworks to ensure effective removal of antibiotic contaminants.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了用于去除水中抗生素的环保吸附剂现状，重点关注生物基材料、纳米复合材料和绿色合成方法，分析了吸附机理、材料特性和去除效率，指出了当前挑战并提出了未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 环保吸附剂在去除水中抗生素方面的当前状态、性能表现、挑战及未来发展方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 水中抗生素污染是威胁生态系统完整性和人类健康的关键环境问题，需要开发有效的去除技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 吸附理论、材料科学、环境化学、绿色化学原理。
AI.method: 通过全面的文献综述，分析吸附机理、材料特性和去除效率。
AI.findings: 农业废弃物生物炭、水凝胶纳米复合材料和生物质衍生碳材料表现出良好的吸附性能，在受控条件下通常能实现高去除效率。但实验设计、环境条件的差异以及有限的真实世界验证限制了可比性和实际应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统总结了环保吸附剂去除抗生素的机理和性能特征，为相关材料设计提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了当前环保吸附剂在实际应用中的主要挑战（规模化生产、再生、经济可行性），并提出了标准化方法、中试研究和废水处理框架整合等未来研究方向。

title: Plant-Extract-Mediated Nanoparticles for Sustainable Corrosion Protection of Mild Steel: Efficiency and Mechanistic Insights

detail.title: Plant-Extract-Mediated Nanoparticles for Sustainable Corrosion Protection of Mild Steel: Efficiency and Mechanistic Insights
detail.abstract: Corrosion of mild steel in acidic environments remains a persistent industrial challenge, leading to significant economic losses and environmental concerns. Conventional corrosion inhibitors, while effective, are often toxic, non-biodegradable, and environmentally unsustainable. In response, plant-extract-mediated nanoparticles have emerged as promising green alternatives due to their eco-friendly synthesis routes and enhanced surface activity. This study examines the efficiency and mechanistic behavior of plant-mediated metallic and metal oxide nanoparticles as corrosion inhibitors for mild steel in acidic media. Green synthesis approaches using phytochemical-rich plant extracts were evaluated, alongside characterization techniques and electrochemical corrosion testing methods reported in current literature. The findings indicate that nanoparticles synthesized from plant extracts significantly improve corrosion inhibition efficiency through adsorption-driven barrier formation and synergistic interactions between phytochemicals and metal surfaces. Mechanistic insights reveal that nanoparticle size, surface functionalization, and extract composition play critical roles in inhibition performance. Despite demonstrated effectiveness, limitations related to extract variability and scalability persist. Overall, plant-extract-mediated nanoparticles represent a viable and sustainable pathway for corrosion protection of mild steel, offering both environmental and industrial advantages while highlighting the need for further mechanistic and long-term studies.

AI.tldr: 植物提取物介导的纳米颗粒作为绿色腐蚀抑制剂，用于酸性环境中低碳钢的腐蚀防护，通过吸附屏障形成和协同作用提高抑制效率。
AI.research_question: 植物提取物介导的金属和金属氧化物纳米颗粒作为低碳钢在酸性介质中的腐蚀抑制剂的效率和机理行为如何？
AI.motivation: 酸性环境中低碳钢腐蚀是持续的工业挑战，导致重大经济损失和环境问题。传统腐蚀抑制剂虽然有效，但通常有毒、不可生物降解且环境不可持续，需要绿色替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色合成理论、吸附理论、纳米材料表面功能化理论、植物化学与金属表面协同作用理论。
AI.method: 使用富含植物化学物质的植物提取物进行绿色合成方法评估，结合表征技术和电化学腐蚀测试方法分析文献数据。
AI.findings: 植物提取物合成的纳米颗粒通过吸附驱动的屏障形成以及植物化学物质与金属表面之间的协同相互作用，显著提高腐蚀抑制效率。纳米颗粒尺寸、表面功能化和提取物组成对抑制性能起关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了植物提取物介导纳米颗粒作为绿色腐蚀抑制剂的理论框架，阐明了吸附机制和协同作用机理，为可持续腐蚀防护材料设计提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业提供环保、可持续的腐蚀防护替代方案，减少传统有毒抑制剂的环境影响，同时提高低碳钢在酸性环境中的使用寿命，具有经济和环境双重效益。

title: Risk Timing and Regime Awareness in Hybrid Machine Learning-Based Investment Strategies

detail.title: Risk Timing and Regime Awareness in Hybrid Machine Learning-Based Investment Strategies
detail.abstract:
Financial markets are characterized by high dimensionality, regime dependence, and time-varying risk,  conditions under which traditional linear and static investment models often struggle. In this study we develop a hybrid machine-learning framework that integrates regularized supervised learning, dimensionality reduction, and unsupervised regime identification to address these challenges.

The framework combines Elastic Net regression for stress-signal prediction, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for factor extraction and noise reduction, and K-Means clustering for regime detection. These components are implemented within a disciplined time-series validation structure that includes rolling cross-validation, walk-forward evaluation, and strict out-of-sample backtesting. We prioritize economic interpretability, stability, and implementability rather than maximizing in-sample performance.

Empirical results using multi-asset data indicate  that the hybrid model achieves higher risk-adjusted returns and improved drawdown control relative to a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) benchmark. While formal statistical tests do not reject equality of Sharpe ratios, the hybrid strategy exhibits persistent net asset value outperformance driven by superior risk timing rather than increased leverage or complexity.

Rather than relying on model complexity, we find that performance differences are driven primarily by how signals are regularized and validated, and by how those signals are ultimately translated into allocation decisions in practice. In this sense, the framework serves as a practical example of how machine learning can be incorporated into portfolio management without sacrificing interpretability or implementation discipline.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个混合机器学习框架，结合正则化监督学习、降维和无监督机制识别，用于多资产投资组合管理。相比传统模型，该框架在保持经济可解释性和实施纪律的同时，实现了更高的风险调整收益和更好的回撤控制。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既保持经济可解释性和实施纪律，又能有效应对金融市场高维性、机制依赖性和时变风险的机器学习投资框架？
AI.motivation: 传统线性静态投资模型在高维、机制依赖、时变风险的金融市场中表现不佳，需要开发更适应这些挑战的机器学习方法，同时保持可解释性和实施可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合正则化监督学习（Elastic Net回归）、降维技术（主成分分析PCA）和无监督机制识别（K-Means聚类）的混合机器学习框架。
AI.method: 采用滚动交叉验证、前向评估和严格样本外回测的时间序列验证结构，优先考虑经济可解释性、稳定性和可实施性，而非最大化样本内表现。
AI.findings: 混合模型相比隐马尔可夫模型基准实现了更高的风险调整收益和更好的回撤控制。虽然统计检验未拒绝夏普比率相等，但混合策略表现出持续的净值优异表现，主要源于更好的风险时机把握而非增加杠杆或复杂度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将机器学习整合到投资组合管理中的实用框架，展示了如何在保持可解释性和实施纪律的前提下利用机器学习技术，强调信号正则化和验证方式对性能的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资从业者提供了一个可实施的混合机器学习框架，该框架在实际应用中能够产生优异的风险调整表现，同时保持经济可解释性和操作可行性，避免了过度复杂的黑箱模型。

title: Plant-Based Nanoparticle Synthesis: Influence of Phytochemicals on Silver Nanoparticle Stability and Bioactivity

detail.title: Plant-Based Nanoparticle Synthesis: Influence of Phytochemicals on Silver Nanoparticle Stability and Bioactivity
detail.abstract: The increasing demand for environmentally sustainable nanomaterials has driven the exploration of plant-based synthesis of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs). This study investigates the role of phytochemicals in influencing the stability and bioactivity of AgNPs synthesized from various plant extracts. Using aqueous and hydroalcoholic extracts, nanoparticles were synthesized and characterized for size, morphology, and surface chemistry. Their bioactivity was evaluated through antimicrobial and antioxidant assays. Results indicate that the type and concentration of phytochemicals significantly determine nanoparticle stability, morphology, and bioactivity. Phenolics and flavonoids acted as both reducing and stabilizing agents, enhancing colloidal stability and antimicrobial efficacy. Unexpectedly, certain high-phytochemical extracts produced slightly aggregated nanoparticles, suggesting a threshold beyond which over-capping reduces functional activity. These findings highlight the critical role of phytochemical composition in tailoring nanoparticle properties for biomedical and industrial applications. The study underscores the potential of plant-mediated green synthesis as a viable, eco-friendly alternative to conventional methods and provides a foundation for further systematic research on plant-based nanoparticle design.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了植物提取物中植物化学物质对银纳米颗粒稳定性与生物活性的影响，发现酚类和黄酮类物质既可作为还原剂又可作为稳定剂，但过高浓度会导致颗粒聚集，揭示了植物化学组成在纳米颗粒设计中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 植物提取物中的植物化学物质如何影响银纳米颗粒的稳定性、形态和生物活性？
AI.motivation: 对环保可持续纳米材料的需求日益增长，推动了植物基银纳米颗粒合成的研究，需要探索植物化学物质在调控纳米颗粒性能中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色合成理论、植物化学物质作为还原剂和稳定剂的双重作用机制、纳米颗粒稳定性与生物活性关系理论。
AI.method: 使用水性和水醇提取物合成银纳米颗粒，通过表征技术分析颗粒尺寸、形态和表面化学，通过抗菌和抗氧化实验评估生物活性。
AI.findings: 植物化学物质的类型和浓度显著影响纳米颗粒的稳定性、形态和生物活性；酚类和黄酮类物质具有还原和稳定双重功能；过高植物化学物质浓度会导致颗粒聚集，降低功能活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了植物化学物质在纳米颗粒合成中的双重作用机制，提出了植物化学物质浓度阈值概念，为植物基纳米颗粒设计提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生物医学和工业应用中的纳米颗粒定制提供了指导，证明了植物介导的绿色合成作为传统方法环保替代方案的可行性，为系统研究植物基纳米颗粒设计奠定了基础。

title: Green Synthesis of Silver Nanoparticles Using Plant Extracts: Methods, Characterization, and Biomedical Applications

detail.title: Green Synthesis of Silver Nanoparticles Using Plant Extracts: Methods, Characterization, and Biomedical Applications
detail.abstract: The increasing demand for sustainable nanomaterials has accelerated interest in green synthesis approaches for silver nanoparticles (AgNPs), particularly those mediated by plant extracts. Conventional physical and chemical synthesis routes often involve toxic reagents, high energy consumption, and environmentally hazardous by-products, which limit their biomedical applicability. In contrast, plant-mediated synthesis offers an eco-friendly, cost-effective, and biologically compatible alternative. This article critically examines green synthesis methods of AgNPs using plant extracts, with emphasis on synthesis mechanisms, characterization techniques, and biomedical applications. Existing literature demonstrates that phytochemicals such as flavonoids, phenolics, and terpenoids play a dual role as reducing and stabilizing agents, enabling controlled nanoparticle formation. Characterization studies consistently report nanoscale particle sizes, crystalline structures, and stable surface chemistries. Biomedical investigations reveal strong antibacterial, antioxidant, and selective cytotoxic activities, highlighting AgNPs' therapeutic potential. Despite these promising outcomes, challenges remain regarding reproducibility, standardization, and in vivo validation. This study synthesizes current findings to provide a coherent understanding of green-synthesized AgNPs and underscores their significance for sustainable nanomedicine.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了植物提取物介导的绿色合成银纳米颗粒方法，重点分析了合成机制、表征技术和生物医学应用，强调了其在可持续纳米医学中的潜力。
AI.research_question: 植物提取物介导的绿色合成银纳米颗粒的方法、机制、表征及其生物医学应用效果如何？
AI.motivation: 传统物理化学合成方法使用有毒试剂、能耗高且产生环境有害副产物，限制了银纳米颗粒在生物医学领域的应用，需要开发更环保、经济、生物相容的绿色合成方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色化学原理、纳米材料合成理论、植物化学（黄酮类、酚类、萜类化合物作为还原剂和稳定剂的双重作用机制）、纳米粒子形成控制理论。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统分析现有关于植物提取物介导银纳米颗粒绿色合成的研究，包括合成机制、表征技术（纳米尺度、晶体结构、表面化学）和生物医学应用评估。
AI.findings: 植物提取物能有效合成纳米级银颗粒，具有晶体结构和稳定表面化学；在生物医学应用中表现出强抗菌、抗氧化和选择性细胞毒性活性；但存在重现性、标准化和体内验证等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了植物化学物质在银纳米颗粒绿色合成中的双重作用机制，建立了植物介导合成与纳米粒子性质-功能关系的理论框架，为可持续纳米医学提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生物医学应用提供环保、经济的银纳米颗粒合成方案；指导研究人员优化合成参数以提高重现性；促进绿色合成银纳米颗粒在抗菌治疗、抗氧化剂和癌症治疗中的实际应用。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Chemical versus Green Routes for Silver Nanoparticle Synthesis

detail.title: Comparative Evaluation of Chemical versus Green Routes for Silver Nanoparticle Synthesis
detail.abstract: Silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) have emerged as a cornerstone in nanotechnology due to their unique physicochemical and biological properties. This study evaluates and compares the chemical and green synthesis routes for AgNP production, emphasizing yield, particle size, stability, and bioactivity. Chemical synthesis methods, including sodium borohydride and citrate reduction, offer high reproducibility and uniformity but pose environmental and health concerns due to chemical byproducts. Green synthesis approaches, using plant-mediated extracts such as Jatropha curcas, are eco-friendly, cost-effective, and provide biocompatible nanoparticles, although yield and uniformity can be variable. The study finds that while chemical methods achieve higher yield and uniformity, green routes produce nanoparticles with superior stability and enhanced biological activity, particularly antimicrobial and antioxidant effects. The findings highlight the potential of green synthesis for sustainable nanotechnology applications and underscore the need for standardization and optimization of plant-mediated methods for industrial and biomedical use.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了银纳米颗粒的化学合成与绿色合成方法，发现化学方法产量高、均匀性好但存在环境问题，绿色方法环保、生物相容性好但产量和均匀性较差，绿色合成的纳米颗粒具有更好的稳定性和生物活性。
AI.research_question: 化学合成与绿色合成方法在银纳米颗粒生产中的性能比较如何？哪种方法更适合可持续的纳米技术应用？
AI.motivation: 银纳米颗粒在纳米技术中具有重要地位，但传统化学合成方法存在环境和健康问题，需要探索更环保的替代方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纳米颗粒合成理论、绿色化学原理、可持续纳米技术框架
AI.method: 比较分析方法，评估化学合成（硼氢化钠还原、柠檬酸盐还原）和绿色合成（植物提取物介导，如麻疯树）在产量、粒径、稳定性和生物活性方面的表现
AI.findings: 化学方法产量高、重现性好、均匀性佳但存在环境和健康风险；绿色方法环保、成本低、生物相容性好但产量和均匀性不稳定；绿色合成的纳米颗粒具有更好的稳定性和增强的生物活性（抗菌和抗氧化效果）
AI.theory_contributions: 为绿色合成银纳米颗粒提供了理论支持，明确了两种合成方法的优缺点比较框架，推动了可持续纳米技术的发展
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业界提供了绿色合成方法的可行性证据，指出了植物介导方法需要标准化和优化，为生物医学应用提供了更安全的纳米颗粒来源

title:
Between Survival and Flight (Vol. 3)
Forced Migration as an Existential Threshold

detail.title:
Between Survival and Flight (Vol. 3)
Forced Migration as an Existential Threshold

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or professional relationships with any individuals or organizations that could be perceived as influencing the content, analysis, or conclusions of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, clinical subjects, or identifiable personal data. It is based on theoretical analysis, secondary sources, and publicly available materials. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently as part of a self-directed academic research project.

detail.abstract: This volume examines forced migration not as a discrete event of movement, but as a prolonged existential process unfolding across successive thresholds of exposure, suspension, recognition, and control. Building on the analytical foundations established in Vol. 1 and Vol. 2, the study shifts the focus from decision-making under crisis to the lived condition of displacement itself. It conceptualizes the journey as a space of liminal violence, where legal protection is absent, human value becomes negotiable, and survival replaces citizenship as the primary mode of existence. Through a qualitative and interpretive framework grounded in liminality theory, biopolitics, and existential sociology, the paper explores how forced migration generates prolonged states of waiting, conditional arrival, and collective life under precarity. It argues that displacement produces not only individual vulnerability but emergent forms of sociality situated between survival and flight—outside stable frameworks of political belonging and recognition. Rather than treating arrival as resolution, this volume demonstrates how post-flight existence often reproduces captivity through legal ambiguity, administrative control, and deferred recognition. In doing so, it exposes forced migration as an existential threshold that bridges physical movement and institutional containment. The analysis concludes by positioning this condition as the necessary conceptual ground for interrogating asylum, legal protection, and the illusion of refuge, which form the focus of the subsequent volume.

AI.tldr: 该研究将被迫迁移视为一个跨越暴露、悬置、承认和控制阈值的长期存在过程，而非离散的移动事件。研究聚焦于流离失所的生活状态本身，将旅程概念化为阈限暴力空间，探讨被迫迁移如何产生等待状态、有条件到达和在不确定性下的集体生活。
AI.research_question: 被迫迁移如何作为一个长期的存在过程展开，跨越连续的暴露、悬置、承认和控制阈值？被迫迁移如何产生等待状态、有条件到达和在不确定性下的集体生活？
AI.motivation: 将被迫迁移从危机下的决策制定研究转向流离失所本身的生活状态，揭示被迫迁移不仅是个体脆弱性的产生过程，也是生存与逃离之间新兴社会形式的生成空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈限理论、生命政治学、存在社会学，构建了理解被迫迁移作为存在阈限的分析框架。
AI.method: 基于阈限理论、生命政治学和存在社会学的定性和解释性框架。
AI.findings: 被迫迁移产生延长的等待状态、有条件到达和在不确定性下的集体生活；流离失所不仅产生个体脆弱性，还产生位于生存与逃离之间的新兴社会形式；到达后存在往往通过法律模糊性、行政控制和延迟承认再现囚禁状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将被迫迁移概念化为连接物理移动和制度容纳的存在阈限；为审视庇护、法律保护和避难所幻觉提供了必要的概念基础；发展了理解被迫迁移作为长期存在过程的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示到达后存在往往再现囚禁状态而非解决方案；暴露法律模糊性和行政控制如何延续流离失所者的困境；为政策制定者理解被迫迁移的长期影响提供分析工具。

title: AI-Powered Predictive Maintenance in Aviation Operations

detail.title: AI-Powered Predictive Maintenance in Aviation Operations
detail.abstract: This article explores the transformative impact of AI-powered predictive maintenance on base and line maintenance operations in the aviation industry. The study addresses the limitations of traditional maintenance practices by integrating advanced technologies, including machine learning, IoT sensors, and big data analytics, to enhance operational safety, reliability, and cost-efficiency. A mixed-methods research design was adopted, combining quantitative data from maintenance logs, sensor outputs, and cost reports with qualitative insights obtained through semi-structured interviews with industry experts. Analysis of key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), Fault Detection Rate (FDR), and Maintenance Cost per Available Seat Kilometer (CASK) revealed significant improvements in technical performance and operational efficiency. The findings indicate that AI-driven predictive maintenance can reduce maintenance costs by 12-18% and decrease unplanned downtime by 15-20%, thereby increasing aircraft availability. However, challenges related to data quality, integration with legacy systems, regulatory compliance, and high initial investments persist. The study concludes that strategic partnerships, phased implementation, and targeted workforce training are essential for the successful adoption of AI technologies in aviation maintenance. This research contributes to the growing body of knowledge on digital transformation in aviation, providing a roadmap for enhancing maintenance practices and ensuring sustainable operational performance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI驱动的预测性维护对航空业基地和航线维护的变革性影响，通过整合机器学习、物联网传感器和大数据分析等先进技术，显著提升了运营安全、可靠性和成本效益，但实施过程中面临数据质量、系统集成、监管合规和高初始投资等挑战。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的预测性维护如何影响航空业的基地和航线维护操作？这种技术整合能否克服传统维护实践的局限性，提升运营安全、可靠性和成本效益？
AI.motivation: 传统航空维护实践存在局限性，需要更先进的技术来提升运营安全、可靠性和成本效益。随着机器学习、物联网传感器和大数据分析等技术的发展，探索AI驱动的预测性维护在航空业的应用潜力和挑战变得至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字转型理论、预测性维护理论、技术采纳理论、运营管理理论，以及航空维护管理框架。
AI.method: 采用混合方法研究设计：结合定量数据（维护日志、传感器输出、成本报告）和定性数据（对行业专家的半结构化访谈），分析关键绩效指标如MTBF、FDR和CASK。
AI.findings: AI驱动的预测性维护可降低维护成本12-18%，减少非计划停机时间15-20%，提高飞机可用性。技术性能和运营效率显著改善，但面临数据质量、遗留系统集成、监管合规和高初始投资等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了航空业数字转型的理论知识体系，为预测性维护在航空领域的应用提供了理论框架，拓展了技术采纳理论在高度监管行业中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航空维护实践提供了具体的实施路线图，包括战略合作伙伴关系、分阶段实施和针对性员工培训。研究结果为航空公司降低维护成本、提高运营效率提供了可操作的建议。

title: Energy-Aware Autonomous Resource Optimization for Financial Workloads Using Deep Reinforcement Learning

detail.title: Energy-Aware Autonomous Resource Optimization for Financial Workloads Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
detail.abstract:
The rapid growth of cloud-based financial workloads, including fintech microservices, high-frequency transaction processing, and real-time analytics, has led to increasing energy consumption and persistent cost inefficiencies in modern data centers, raising concerns about sustainability and service-level compliance (autonomous cloud optimization; fintech reinforcement learning studies). To address these challenges, this study develops and evaluates a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based autonomous resource optimization framework designed to jointly balance energy efficiency, quality of service (QoS), and operational cost constraints in cloud environments (Li et al.; Gu et al.; Zhang & Ou).
The proposed framework dynamically learns optimal resource allocation policies by interacting with workload and infrastructure states, adapting to fluctuating demand patterns typical of financial applications. Experimental results demonstrate that DRL-driven policies achieve significant reductions in overall energy consumption and service-level agreement (SLA) violations when compared with traditional heuristic-based and static scheduling approaches (Malipatil et al.; Janjani et al.). These improvements are particularly evident under high-load and bursty transaction scenarios, where conventional methods struggle to maintain efficiency and performance. The study concludes that energy-aware autonomous DRL systems represent a viable and scalable solution for optimizing cloud-based financial workloads. However, their practical deployment requires careful design of the reward function and workload-specific tuning to ensure stability, interpretability, and consistent performance gains (Alkhatani et al.; Różycki et al.).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的自主资源优化框架，用于在云环境中平衡金融工作负载的能源效率、服务质量和运营成本。实验表明，相比传统方法，该框架能显著降低能耗和SLA违规。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个基于深度强化学习的自主资源优化框架，以在云环境中同时优化金融工作负载的能源效率、服务质量和运营成本？
AI.motivation: 云金融工作负载（如金融科技微服务、高频交易处理、实时分析）快速增长导致数据中心能耗增加和成本效率低下，引发可持续性和服务级别合规性担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度强化学习（DRL）理论，自主云优化理论，金融科技强化学习研究，资源分配优化理论。
AI.method: 开发并评估基于深度强化学习的自主资源优化框架，通过与环境交互学习最优资源分配策略，适应金融应用的波动需求模式。
AI.findings: DRL驱动策略相比传统启发式和静态调度方法，能显著降低整体能耗和服务级别协议（SLA）违规。在高负载和突发交易场景下改进尤为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将DRL应用于云金融工作负载优化的理论框架，扩展了自主云优化和金融科技强化学习的研究领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为云数据中心提供了可扩展的能源感知自主优化解决方案，有助于降低运营成本、提高可持续性并确保服务级别合规。

title: Formalising Value Without Institutions: NFTs as a Stress Test of Art Market Architecture

detail.title: Formalising Value Without Institutions: NFTs as a Stress Test of Art Market Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or commercial interests in NFT platforms, marketplaces, or tokenised assets discussed in this paper. This research is conducted in an independent academic capacity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The rapid rise and collapse of the NFT art market is commonly explained through narratives of speculative excess, technological immaturity, or cultural backlash against financialisation. This paper argues instead that NFTs failed as art markets for a more fundamental reason: they attempted to constitute a market for symbolic goods through technical representation and transaction recording without the institutional authority required to stabilise value across time. Treating NFTs as a natural experiment in market constitution, the paper shows that NFT infrastructures successfully solved several problems long identified as sources of art-market fragility, including asset standardisation, persistent provenance, public transaction histories, and frictionless global exchange. For a brief period, additional market rules-most notably enforced creator royalties-also introduced partial temporal continuity between primary and secondary markets, enabling predictable participation in downstream value and supporting the emergence of operator-like behaviour among some creators. However, these mechanisms lacked constitutional authority. Royalty enforcement depended on voluntary platform coordination rather than binding institutional mandate, rendering it unstable under competitive pressure. As marketplaces disavowed governance authority and shifted toward volume-driven competition, key constitutive rules collapsed. The resulting hyperfinancialisation transformed symbolic differentiation into liquidity abstraction, fragmented price comparability across platforms, and accelerated arbitrage behaviour. Secondary markets rapidly lost coherence, serious collectors exited or adopted short-term trading strategies, and creators were forced back into high-velocity dependence on primary sales-reproducing the structural fragilities of the traditional art market at greater speed and with higher burnout. The paper argues that NFTs did not fail because they over-financialised art, nor because artists, collectors, or builders acted irrationally. They failed because formalisation without authority cannot constitute durable markets for symbolic goods. NFTs thus function not as a speculative anomaly but as a stress test that clarifies the distinction between technical infrastructure and institutional constitution. Where authority is absent, increased visibility and liquidity amplify volatility rather than stabilise value.

AI.tldr: NFT艺术市场快速崛起又崩溃的根本原因不是投机过度或技术不成熟，而是试图通过技术手段建立象征性商品市场时缺乏制度权威来稳定跨时间的价值。NFT基础设施解决了艺术市场的某些脆弱性问题，但缺乏权威性导致关键规则崩溃，最终加速了传统艺术市场的结构性脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 为什么NFT艺术市场会快速崛起又崩溃？NFT作为象征性商品市场的构成实验揭示了什么关于市场稳定性的根本原理？
AI.motivation: 现有解释将NFT市场崩溃归因于投机过度、技术不成熟或文化反弹，但这些解释忽略了更深层的制度性问题。本文认为需要从市场构成的基本原理来理解NFT的失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场构成理论、制度权威理论、象征性商品经济学、技术基础设施与制度权威的区分
AI.method: 将NFT市场作为自然实验，分析其市场构成过程，考察技术基础设施与制度权威的相互作用
AI.findings: NFT基础设施成功解决了艺术市场的资产标准化、持久溯源、公开交易历史和全球流通等问题。但缺乏制度权威导致关键规则（如创作者版税）不稳定，最终引发超金融化、流动性抽象、价格可比性碎片化和套利行为加速，使市场失去连贯性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）区分了技术基础设施与制度权威在市场构成中的作用；2）阐明了象征性商品市场需要权威来稳定跨时间价值；3）揭示了在没有权威的情况下，更高的可见性和流动性反而会放大波动性
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为未来数字艺术市场设计提供警示：技术解决方案需要制度权威支持；2）帮助创作者理解市场参与策略；3）为监管者和平台提供市场稳定性的制度设计参考

title: From Existence to Effectiveness: Organizational Ontology from the Perspective of Value Stream -The Dynamic Coupling of CRS Three Systems

detail.title: From Existence to Effectiveness: Organizational Ontology from the Perspective of Value Stream -The Dynamic Coupling of CRS Three Systems
detail.abstract: Existing organizational theory has achieved rich results in explaining organizational structure, governance, and performance, but generally regards "the existence of an organization" as an unproven premise, and less inquiry into a more fundamental question: Why does an organization exist and rise and fall? From an ontological perspective, this paper presents an organizational existence explanation framework centered on the "value stream". That is, an organization is not primarily a collection of structures, institutions, or capabilities, but rather a process of value generation and realization that exists around a specific mission. Based on this, this paper argues that any organization that can continue to exist must be analyzed into three smallest and incommensurable functional subsystems: value Creation, value Realization, and internal Support, which form a dynamically coupled value stream system. Its significance lies not in the structure or efficiency that is usually talked about, but in whether it can enable value to flow continuously and smoothly in these three systems and follow the mission direction. The framework provides a more unified analytical grammar for understanding the essence of the organization and its health, and offers a more fundamental and progressive analytical starting point for further empirical tests related to it.

AI.tldr: 本文从本体论视角提出以"价值流"为中心的组织存在解释框架，认为组织本质上是围绕特定使命的价值生成与实现过程，而非结构、制度或能力的集合。组织持续存在需具备三个不可通约的功能子系统：价值创造、价值实现和内部支持，形成动态耦合的价值流系统。
AI.research_question: 为什么组织存在并兴衰？从本体论角度如何理解组织的本质和存在基础？
AI.motivation: 现有组织理论通常将"组织存在"视为未经证明的前提，较少探究更根本的问题：组织为何存在并兴衰？需要从本体论角度提供更基础的组织存在解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值流中心论的组织存在框架，基于本体论视角，将组织视为围绕特定使命的价值生成与实现过程，而非传统理论中的结构、制度或能力集合。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，通过概念分析和框架构建，提出基于价值流的组织存在解释框架。
AI.findings: 任何持续存在的组织都可分解为三个最小且不可通约的功能子系统：价值创造、价值实现和内部支持，这三个系统形成动态耦合的价值流系统。组织健康的关键在于价值能否在这三个系统中持续顺畅流动并遵循使命方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了理解组织本质和健康的统一分析语法；2. 为组织存在提供了更根本和渐进的分析起点；3. 挑战了传统组织理论将"组织存在"视为前提的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织诊断和健康评估提供了新的分析框架，帮助管理者关注价值流动而非仅仅结构效率，为组织设计和变革提供了理论基础。

title: From Attention to Agency: A Structural Failure of Digital Markets

detail.title: From Attention to Agency: A Structural Failure of Digital Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, professional, or financial relationships with any individuals or organisations that could be perceived to have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or the use of personal or sensitive data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The modern internet is commonly diagnosed as suffering from misinformation, polarisation, platform concentration, and declining public trust. These failures are typically attributed to behavioural bias, political extremism, or algorithmic amplification. This paper argues instead that the dominant pathologies of digital discourse arise from a deeper architectural constraint: the early internet lacked native, low-friction, trust-minimised mechanisms for economic exchange. In the absence of viable transaction and settlement infrastructure, advertising emerged as a proxy monetisation layer, structurally coupling public meaning systems to engagement-maximising revenue cycles. This coupling transformed attention into the primary economic substrate of the web, producing volatility, polarisation, and extractive amplification as predictable outcomes rather than aberrations. The paper further argues that recent developments-most notably native digital settlement and autonomous machine agents-remove the original constraint that made advertising dominant, revealing contemporary internet dysfunction as a problem of architectural lock-in rather than technological inevitability. The contribution is diagnostic rather than prescriptive, reframing the internet not as a failed public sphere but as a pre-constitutional economic and meaning system whose governing architecture no longer matches its capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文认为互联网当前的问题（虚假信息、极化、平台垄断等）根源在于早期互联网缺乏原生低摩擦的交易结算基础设施，导致广告成为主要商业模式，将公共意义系统与最大化参与度的收入循环结构耦合，产生了可预测的负面后果。近期数字结算和自主智能体的发展已消除原始约束，表明当前互联网功能失调是架构锁定而非技术必然。
AI.research_question: 互联网当前主要病理（虚假信息、极化、平台集中、信任下降）的根本原因是什么？这些问题是源于行为偏见、政治极端主义或算法放大，还是源于更深层次的架构约束？
AI.motivation: 现代互联网普遍存在虚假信息、极化、平台垄断和公众信任下降等问题，传统解释通常归因于行为偏见、政治极端主义或算法放大。本文认为这些解释不够深入，需要从互联网架构的根本约束来理解当前问题的根源。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 架构约束理论：早期互联网缺乏原生低摩擦、信任最小化的经济交换机制
2. 代理货币化层理论：广告作为交易结算基础设施缺失的替代方案
3. 结构耦合理论：公共意义系统与参与度最大化收入循环的结构性耦合
4. 注意力经济理论：注意力成为网络主要经济基础
5. 架构锁定理论：技术路径依赖导致系统无法适应新能力
AI.method: 本文采用诊断性分析框架，通过历史架构分析和理论推理方法，考察互联网经济基础设施的演变及其对公共话语的影响。方法包括：架构约束分析、历史发展轨迹考察、经济激励结构推理、以及新技术能力的影响评估。
AI.findings:
1. 互联网当前病理的根本原因是早期缺乏原生交易结算基础设施
2. 广告作为代理货币化层导致公共意义系统与参与度最大化收入循环结构耦合
3. 注意力成为主要经济基础，产生了波动性、极化和提取性放大等可预测后果
4. 近期数字结算和自主智能体发展已消除原始约束
5. 当前互联网功能失调是架构锁定问题，而非技术必然
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出互联网病理的架构约束解释框架，超越行为偏见和算法放大的传统解释
2. 发展结构耦合理论，解释公共意义系统与经济激励的相互作用机制
3. 建立从交易基础设施缺失到注意力经济主导的因果链条
4. 引入架构锁定概念，解释技术路径依赖如何阻碍系统适应新能力
5. 重新框架互联网为"前宪法"经济和意义系统，其治理架构与能力不匹配
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供诊断框架，理解互联网问题的根本原因
2. 指出技术发展已消除原始约束，为架构改革提供可能性
3. 帮助技术开发者认识到当前架构的历史偶然性
4. 为互联网治理改革提供理论基础，强调需要匹配架构与能力
5. 为评估新技术（如数字结算、自主智能体）的社会影响提供分析框架

title: The Influence of Leadership Style on Project Team Performance

detail.title: The Influence of Leadership Style on Project Team Performance
detail.abstract: Project team performance was examined as an effect of leadership styles in the IT, Construction and Consultancy sectors. A pragmatist mixed-methods approach was used to integrate quantitative and qualitative analysis to explore a greater wholeness of insight into effective leadership in a project-based organisation. Quantitative information was collected through fifty-one valid questionnaires' responses and was analysed using SPSS through descriptive statistics, correlation, and regression analysis. Results were derived that the transformational and democratic styles were most utilized by project managers and highly correlated with team performance for projects. The regression model established that leadership styles formed part of the most significant predictors of project success, accounting for some 63% of the variance in team performance. Seven semi-structured interviews were conducted and analysed against Braun and Clarke's thematic analysis framework. The analysis produced ten overarching themes that emerge to show adaptive, inclusive, and emotionally intelligent leadership. Adaptability, open communication, cultural awareness, and motivation were cited by the interviewees as essential factors that foster team cohesion and project success. They further observed that organisational culture and team diversity were moderators of leadership effectiveness, and therefore, such strategies must target the contextual environment of organisations and team compositions. This study endorses transformational and democratic leadership theories and confirms situational flexibility project management theory. Project leadership encompasses combining directive and participative behaviours, emotional intelligence, and data-driven tools, which the present study recommends that should be used in leadership development courses. The study provides valuable empirical data for project management and leadership because it can link leadership styles with team performance outcomes and illustrate howdiversity and culture affect the effectiveness of leadership in the dynamic world of projects. The study also contributes to the contemporary debate on evidence-led and emotionally intelligent leadership as fundamentally critical paradigms for project leaders today.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨IT、建筑和咨询行业中领导风格对项目团队绩效的影响。采用混合方法研究发现，变革型和民主型领导风格最常用且与团队绩效高度相关，能解释63%的绩效方差。研究还识别出适应性、包容性和情商领导等十个主题，强调组织文化和团队多样性对领导有效性的调节作用。
AI.research_question: 领导风格如何影响项目团队绩效？不同领导风格（特别是变革型和民主型）与团队绩效的关系是什么？组织文化和团队多样性如何调节领导有效性？
AI.motivation: 项目型组织中有效领导的重要性日益凸显，但现有研究对领导风格与团队绩效关系的实证证据不足，特别是在IT、建筑和咨询等不同行业的比较研究较少。需要更全面的洞察来指导项目领导实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变革型领导理论、民主型领导理论、情境灵活性项目管理理论、情感智能领导理论、适应性领导理论。
AI.method: 采用实用主义混合方法：1）定量部分：收集51份有效问卷，使用SPSS进行描述性统计、相关性和回归分析；2）定性部分：进行7次半结构化访谈，采用Braun和Clarke的主题分析框架，识别出10个主要主题。
AI.findings: 1）变革型和民主型领导风格最常用且与团队绩效高度相关；2）领导风格能解释63%的团队绩效方差；3）识别出适应性、包容性和情感智能领导等10个主题；4）适应性、开放沟通、文化意识和激励是促进团队凝聚力和项目成功的关键因素；5）组织文化和团队多样性调节领导有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）支持变革型和民主型领导理论；2）确认情境灵活性项目管理理论；3）为证据驱动和情感智能领导范式提供实证支持；4）扩展了领导风格与团队绩效关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为领导力发展课程提供建议：结合指导性和参与性行为、情感智能和数据驱动工具；2）提供实证数据帮助组织将领导风格与团队绩效结果联系起来；3）指导组织考虑文化和多样性因素来优化领导策略；4）为项目管理者提供实用的领导实践指导。

title: Doing Good Feels Better: Moral Appeals Shape Reward-Related Neural Activity for Pro-Environmental Gains
affiliations: Utrecht University, Utrecht University and Utrecht University

detail.title: Doing Good Feels Better: Moral Appeals Shape Reward-Related Neural Activity for Pro-Environmental Gains
detail.abstract: To address societal challenges such as combating climate change – people have to invest in collective goals rather than pursuing selfish objectives. However, prior neuroscientific research has often revealed that reward-motivation is enhanced for self-relevant gains. Here, we draw on social psychological research showing that people have a strong desire to be moral, to examine whether the motivation for investing effort towards collective goals can be increased by appealing to people’s desire to be a morally responsible person. We conducted an ERP study examining how a moral appeal influences motivated performance and neural markers of reward processing. After reading either a moral or a non-moral appeal about one’s responsibility toward climate action, participants (N = 70) completed a time estimation task where they could earn monetary rewards for themselves or a climate-friendly charity. We compared behavioral and ERP responses on self-gain, charity-gain, and no-gain trials between appeal conditions. Results showed significant interactions in both behavioral and ERP measures. Participants performed better on self- and charity-gain trails, compared to no-gain trials, following a moral appeal, whereas no trial-type differences emerged after the non-moral appeal. Confirmatory ERP analyses revealed no effects on the SPN or RewP. Exploratory analyses on the Cue-P3, Feedback-P3, and LPP, however, showed enhanced amplitudes for charity-gain trials following the moral appeal, whereas in the non-moral appeal condition, Feedback-P3 and LPP were more positive on self-gain than no-gain trials. These findings suggest that moral appeals can enhance the reward value of pro-environmental outcomes, potentially promoting positive behavior change.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过ERP实验发现，道德诉求能够增强人们对环保慈善收益的奖励价值，促进亲环境行为改变。
AI.research_question: 道德诉求是否能增强人们对集体目标（如气候行动）的努力投入动机？
AI.motivation: 社会面临气候变化等集体挑战，但神经科学研究显示奖励动机通常对自我相关收益更强。需要探索如何通过道德诉求增强对集体目标的动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 社会心理学：人们有强烈的道德欲望；2. 神经科学：奖励处理神经标记（SPN、RewP、Cue-P3、Feedback-P3、LPP）；3. 道德诉求理论
AI.method: ERP研究，70名参与者随机接受道德或非道德诉求，完成时间估计任务，可为自己或环保慈善赢得金钱奖励。比较行为表现和ERP反应。
AI.findings: 1. 道德诉求下，自我收益和慈善收益试次表现优于无收益试次；2. 非道德诉求下无差异；3. ERP显示道德诉求增强慈善收益试次的Cue-P3、Feedback-P3和LPP振幅；4. 非道德诉求下，自我收益试次的Feedback-P3和LPP更积极。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证证明道德诉求能增强集体目标的神经奖励价值；2. 扩展了道德动机的神经机制理解；3. 为道德诉求影响行为提供了神经证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为促进亲环境行为提供有效干预策略；2. 指导环保宣传设计；3. 为政策制定者提供基于证据的行为改变方法。

title: Smart Predict--then--Optimize Paradigm for Portfolio Optimization in Real Markets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Waseda University

detail.title: Smart Predict--then--Optimize Paradigm for Portfolio Optimization in Real Markets
detail.abstract: Improvements in return forecast accuracy do not always lead to proportional improvements in portfolio decision quality, especially under realistic trading frictions and constraints. This paper adopts the Smart Predict--then--Optimize (SPO) paradigm for portfolio optimization in real markets, which explicitly aligns the learning objective with downstream portfolio decision quality rather than pointwise prediction accuracy. Within this paradigm, predictive models are trained using an SPO-based surrogate loss that directly reflects the performance of the resulting investment decisions. To preserve interpretability and robustness, we employ linear predictors built on return-based and technical-indicator features and integrate them with portfolio optimization models that incorporate transaction fee, turnover control, and regularization. We evaluate the proposed approach on U.S. ETF data (2015--2025) using a rolling-window backtest with monthly rebalancing. Empirical results show that decision-focused training consistently improves risk-adjusted performance over predict--then--optimize baselines and classical optimization benchmarks, and yields strong robustness during adverse market regimes (e.g., the 2020 COVID-19). These findings highlight the practical value of the Smart Predict--then--Optimize paradigm for portfolio optimization in realistic and non-stationary financial environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文采用智能预测-然后优化（SPO）范式进行投资组合优化，通过将学习目标与下游投资决策质量直接对齐，而非单纯追求预测准确性，在考虑交易摩擦和约束的现实市场环境中提升风险调整后收益。
AI.research_question: 在考虑交易费用、换手率控制和正则化的现实市场约束下，如何通过智能预测-然后优化（SPO）范式改进投资组合决策质量，而非仅仅提高回报预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统预测-然后优化方法中，预测准确性的提升并不总能转化为投资组合决策质量的相应改进，特别是在现实交易摩擦和约束条件下。需要一种能直接优化最终投资决策而非中间预测指标的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能预测-然后优化（SPO）范式，将学习目标与下游决策质量对齐；投资组合优化理论，包含交易费用、换手率控制和正则化约束；线性预测模型与基于回报和技术指标的特征工程。
AI.method: 采用基于SPO的代理损失函数训练线性预测模型，整合投资组合优化模型（含交易费用、换手率控制和正则化），使用美国ETF数据（2015-2025）进行滚动窗口回测，每月再平衡。
AI.findings: 决策导向训练相比传统预测-然后优化基准和经典优化基准，能持续改善风险调整后表现，在不利市场环境（如2020年新冠疫情）中表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将SPO范式应用于现实投资组合优化问题，展示了决策导向学习在金融领域的有效性；提出了整合交易摩擦和约束的端到端优化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资经理提供了一种在实际交易约束下改进投资组合决策的方法；证明了在非平稳金融环境中，直接优化决策质量比单纯提高预测准确性更有效。

title: A Refinery-Wide Optimization Framework Integrating Dynamic Base–Delta Models and Nonlinear Programming with LLM-assisted Interaction
affiliations: SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd.,, SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd.,, SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd.,, SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd.,, SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd.,, SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd.,, SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd.,, SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd., and SINOPEC Dalian Research Institute of Petroleum and Petrochemicals Co Ltd.,

detail.title: A Refinery-Wide Optimization Framework Integrating Dynamic Base–Delta Models and Nonlinear Programming with LLM-assisted Interaction
detail.abstract: Driven by the national “dual-carbon” goals (carbon peaking and carbon neutrality), refinery operators must urgently integrate process intelligence with scheduling optimization to tackle the systemic trade-offs among energy efficiency, economic performance, and low-carbon operation. This paper takes a Sinopec refinery as a case study and develops high-fidelity process models for key units — including fluid catalytic cracking and continuous catalytic reforming — implemented on the Petro-SIM platform. Building on these mechanistic models, we propose a hybrid modeling approach that combines neural-network surrogate models with a Base–Delta structural optimization strategy to yield a computationally tractable representation of whole-plant complex behavior. The approach is further embedded within a mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) solution framework based on the PASO S-GROMS PLUS platform, and large language model (LLM)-based agents are introduced to enable natural-language interaction and dynamic mapping of scheduling directives. Case studies under representative operating scenarios show that the proposed method effectively reduces operation and maintenance (O&M) time, improves capacity utilization, and demonstrates strong cross-scenario adaptability and scalability. The results indicate the method’s promise for enabling intelligent, flexible, and lower-carbon refinery operations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对炼油厂在"双碳"目标下面临的能效、经济和低碳运营系统权衡问题，以中石化炼油厂为案例，开发了基于Petro-SIM平台的关键装置高保真过程模型，并提出结合神经网络代理模型和Base-Delta结构优化策略的混合建模方法，嵌入MINLP求解框架，引入LLM智能体实现自然语言交互，有效降低运维时间、提高产能利用率，展现了跨场景适应性和可扩展性。
AI.research_question: 如何在"双碳"目标下，通过过程智能与调度优化集成，有效解决炼油厂能效、经济性能和低碳运营之间的系统权衡问题？
